Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Well, we weren't really running from you! We just wanted to make sure you were alone.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Be good, please!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Encore and Uncle Aalto won't do anything bad to you...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: That's enough Encore, you're freaking our precious client out.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Encore just did as Aalto said! Encore is usually a good girl.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Don't be scared, Rover. We just have a few questions for you.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Anyway, we'll take our leave now.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Please stay safe...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Don't worry, we...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Into Woolies' belly you go!

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: So you don't have...

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hey, I'm Patroller Chixia. Sir, business license, please.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: B-Business license? Uuuhh... Oh! I'm Aalto, just a humble information broker. I've been travelling around, helping people out in my own small way...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: I see. So, no license. I bet you don't have a fixed business location either, huh?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: ...Business location? Why would I need that?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hmph, now show me your Organizational Accreditation, please.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Well... I am an honest broker of information, always open to negotiations at the right price! I'm the all-time intel champ, with more Best Seller certificates than I can count...

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: What did I say about calling me "Uncle" in public again? I am NOT that old!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Miss Verina, where did you meet this girl?

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: I ran into her near a cliff on my way home. She was eating a poisonous mushroom...

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: I managed to make her the antidote in time. Imagine what would have happened if I wasn't there...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Don't worry! Encore's had plenty of that mushroom already!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: But why did you go to such a dangerous place alone, little Encore?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: So you don't have...

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Unleash the fangs!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I never got the chance to thank you.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Thank me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The day the Eye of the Threnodian appeared, you drove it back and saved me.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Did I? …Sorry, I don't remember that.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (She doesn't sound like she's lying. Then how...)

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: A Synchronist… Rover… Hahaha!

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: It was the explorers who fell into the Voidmatter. They're the ones who mapped that data on me and the Exostrider inside the Threnodian's black hole. All I did was burn their findings onto a Cassette for you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And it was the people of Lahai-Roi who decoded the Cassette and forged the Drive Replica. That's what let the Exostrider finally cast the Threnodian out.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: So... this wasn't a story about heroes saving the world. It was the world saving its heroes. Right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yes. And now… we're home.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: You're back?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah, I'm back now.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: So what if they don't care about your contributions? If they actually want you on their side, they'll have to listen anyway. That's how leverage works.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If we lean on that kind of leverage now, we'll be held to it later. My experience has shown me that it's often better to act as an individual.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Since you're planning on the "savior" career path, I think you'll understand what I mean, Aemeath.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Hmm, makes sense. Kinda old-school thinking, though.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I need to figure out what Lucilla is really thinking. Then I'll play it by ear.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If I want them to protect the Synchronists when I can't, I've got to work inside their system. That's just how this game works.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: So don't act all shocked when we just show up one day, 'kay?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Everyone, thank you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well then... See you, Startorch Academy.

phone.speaker: Aemeath
phone.text: Who knows, you might even start hearing legends about "the one and only Aemeath" before we see each other again.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'll be looking forward to it.

phone.speaker: Aemeath
phone.text: All right! Get ready to be blown away!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Have no fear, Aemeath's here!

phone.speaker: Aemeath
phone.text: Hehe, just hearing you say that already makes me all giddy!

phone.speaker: Aemeath
phone.text: Anyway, if anything comes up, I'll just find you in WavesLine real quick. As a digital ghost, my ping is kinda off the charts.

A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You (Quest).desc: Aemeath appears to be waiting for you. You should go see her.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: The savior and the world, saving each other at last! A tale for the ages!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Hmm? What is it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: After you were sealed beyond the Stridergate... how long were you out there? Alone?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You've been dodging this. But I don't want you to keep choosing to handle this alone.

So as the Melting Snow Desires.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: The savior and the world, saving each other at last! A tale for the ages!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Hmm? What is it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: After you were sealed beyond the Stridergate... how long were you out there? Alone?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You've been dodging this. But I don't want you to keep choosing to handle this alone.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: By the way, why didn't you message me on WavesLine before coming all the way here? I could've picked you up.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Are you looking at where Lahai-Roi disappeared?

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Yeah... I don't know. I feel a bit conflicted about it.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: It's still out there, beyond the Stridergate. Guarding this world all alone, day after day. It's gotta be wearing down. Who knows how much longer it can hold on.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Can't help worrying... What if it just breaks down one day?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I think, before that day comes, the people of Lahai-Roi will find a way to cross the Etheric Sea.

Rust, Sword and the Sun.desc: Iuno has some reservations about the upcoming hunting operation and their plans due to the prophecy she saw, but Augusta assures her firmly that she will fight to the very end.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Fine. Go ahead. You'll come back to me sooner or later.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That, I can't deny.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Ha! I knew it. So you do need me for this hunt.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Thank you, Iuno.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: ...Why are you saying this?

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The storm is coming...

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: The sooner you settle this, the sooner I get to leave this boring place.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Iuno, one last question.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: For someone without an unwritten fate... is it true they can never break free, no matter how hard they struggle?

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: I... don't know.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That's alright.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Let's go, Rover.

By Moon's Fated Light.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Existence always leaves a trace. Beyond feeling, memory, and perception, is there anything that can prove this "Iuno" isn't an illusion?

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: After this, I shall likely sleep like I've never slept before.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Say, I heard the Montelli family imported some device that aids sleep. It's all the rage... Augusta, I trust you will acquire one for me? I wish to try it myself.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Scented candles are fine, though the scent of the forest is most pleasing. As for pillows and bedding...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That's enough. I allow requests... but only three.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Hmph. Apologies, but I need my rest if I'm to be at full power. Do bear with it. It's for your own good, after all.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Iuno. We know each other.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Alright then, Augusta. What's the situation?

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Theoretically, the Dark Tide flows here from the Blightcloud above the Plateaus. High Tides have always followed its movements.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: But this time, nothing. No Blightcloud anomalies. No frequency fluctuations near the Three Heroes' Crest.

Shadow of Glory.desc: During this time, you ask her about Ephor Augusta and Priestess Iuno.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The High Tide draws near. I want all warriors heading to the hunting grounds to remember this.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Hmm? That's interesting.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Augusta, look! Another two have earned Arsinosa's blessing.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: You've done incredibly well.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: May... your journey... be... smooth, my friend.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Come back soon! (I'm only asking for the sake of everyone else!)

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Such carnage...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: These tricks do not surprise me.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Avidius, take a response team and get that Anchor Obelisk functioning.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Rover and I will provide cover.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: As you command, Your Excellency.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Feels like just yesterday we were fighting side by side in the Colosseum. And now look at you, "Hero of Heroes" and all. Didn't see that coming!

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Rover, your arrival is appreciated.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Iuno. We know each other.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

Shadow of Glory.desc: Lupa announces to Ephor Augusta that her weapon was tampered with, but House Silva denies the accusation.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: In this very match, the Silvas stooped to underhanded tactics!

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Speak plainly, Gladiator.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: This spear… it was a gift from Domina Julia, head of House Silva, when I first joined the family.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Back then, I trusted the Silvas completely, never once doubting their intentions. That is, until I chose to leave them not long ago.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Now in today's arena, this spear spiraled out of control, nearly stabbing my own teammate!

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Of course. I'll leave it to you then.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Alright, I think I got the whole picture now... Oh Rover, how do you keep ending up in messes like this? This is one tough cookie, all right.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Let me tell you, the latest data we got from the Resonance Nexus isn't so pretty. Something's really off with the Dark Tide in that Sanguis place. I don't remember it being this crazy before.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Normally, the Dark Tide getting all freaky during High Tide is whatever, right? But now, I don't know what happened, cuz it's... it's turning into a person.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: So listen up, I'll give you Tethys's rundown. That humanoid thing, that "Sovereign," is gobbling up frequencies like a maniac!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: We won't last much longer at this rate...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The entrance is open. Now's the time...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: ...What are you doing?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: What I always planned to do―hunt the Threnodian.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The moment I jump into the Dark Tide, the Tidespawn will retreat to defend. That's when you seal the Anti-Corrosion Ward. Trap them in one stroke.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Jump into the Dark Tide? Are you out of your mind ?!

Utterance of Marvels: I.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Could it be the side effect of fighting that Tacet Discord? Baizhi, can we take Rover to do a check-up at Huaxu Academy's Resonance Medical Department...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Baizhi?

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Absorbing Echoes with the human body is not entirely unprecedented.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: With the human body...?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I remember Comprehensive Mirror for Historians mentioned this in the Huanglong section's opening...

Utterance of Marvels: II.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Myself included.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: I see. I agree that my phrasing lacked the attention to detail. Please allow me to reorganize my words.

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: This is not an ordinary leaf, but it doesn't seem to be a Tacet Discord, either. Based on the data we gathered, I believe it was sampled from an area struck with the Waveworn phenomena.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes. The anomalies that occurred after the Lament, including the formation of Tacet Fields, Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, and gravity loss... These are collectively called the Waveworn phenomena.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: And the Lament was the start of it all.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: As for the sugar pearl... It has been determined to be a type of oral vaccine.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: This sugar pearl expired over 20 years ago. The low-temperature storage life for this vaccine is about 2 years.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: A 20-year-old vaccine...

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Yangyang, Rover, what are your plans now?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Don't let Jinzhou weigh on you. Just focus on the problem at hand.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I understand. Thank you, Baizhi.

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Huh? Did I miss something...?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yangyang! Your avatar!!!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: What's with the new style?!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: You do look nice, I'll be honest. Hehe.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Oh, this... It's a long story...

Moonlit Reunion.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: With the Threnodian defeated, our Sentinel and the Jinzhou Magistrate have resumed their duties. Jinzhou will have peace and prosperity once more.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes. Oh Rover, and the Sentinel did give you certain insights about your memory loss. While there's still much to uncover, at least we're on the right track.

Utterance of Marvels: I.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Baizhi, you know, we... huh?

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: You are alright, it seems.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: You know, was super energetic! Handled a super big TD! Way more spirited than me!

Utterance of Marvels: II.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Given our lack of data on you and your unusual physical signs, I suggest absorbing another Reverberation with your Terminal when we find one. That being said, please be sure to proceed cautiously.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yeah, don't go too hard on yourself. You should get a check-up just to be safe. Besides, Yangyang's very worried about you.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: There you are, Rover!

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: The Academy has noted a concerning rise of Tacet Field activities. Please use caution when exiting the city.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Remember to check your Terminal signals, and wear the Academy's protective suit correctly.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: ...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Anyway! Rover, quick, tell us what happened!

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: She's right here. Still undergoing treatment.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yang... Yang...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: We should step outside. She needs rest.

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Aw, man... I could really use some sunlight. Breathe in that fresh air, and stretch my legs a bit...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Chixia, adequate rest is a more appropriate approach to your current condition.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: As I understand, profound moaning and groaning have no positive effect on your recovery, and such childish behavior will only result in your extended stay at Huaxu Academy for up to two weeks.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Uh... There's Baizhi being tough again...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Fine, I'll be a good girl and behave myself. Can't have everyone looking after me forever...

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: And you, Baizhi?

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Please come early if possible.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: People have been preparing for the Moonlit Fair for many weeks.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Rover, I just sent the coordinates to your Terminal! See you there!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Haha, get ready to be blown away!

Moonlit Reunion.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: She, um... She's not really into wishes.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Don't mind me, I tend not to make wishes. But if I did, it would probably be similar to Yangyang's.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: There, you're the last one left, Rover. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: So, sugar pearls like this were distributed at hospitals? Perhaps...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: The sugar pearl might be a type of medicine. Its sweet taste would've made it more palatable to children.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: I do have my theory as to what it is, but it still needs verification. I wouldn't proclaim any solid answers before confirming the chemical composition of this item with reliable data.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Seconded. Let's find out through actual testing, then.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: It will take some time before the results are ready. If you have other matters to take care of, you should go ahead. I'll let you know once we have the results.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Rover, I am currently monitoring the Tacet Discord attacks from the Academy to design a safer route for you.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: We just received word from our soldiers at the emplacement. A large number of Tacet Discords are targeting the Disruptor, and our troops are doing their best to defend it.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: The Disruptor has been surrounded by the Tacet Discords, with more of them slowly closing in.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: After we recapture the nearby emplacement, it will take some more time for the Disruptor to recharge. You may need to hold out a little longer.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Forgive me, Rover. After I heard, I also wanted to search for Yangyang immediately. But with Chixia in this condition, I had no choice but to...

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Rover, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Do be extra cautious, Rover. Xuanfang Hold isn't just any military stronghold. It's the pinnacle of what Automata Mechanics as a field can achieve today, and for the foreseeable future.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: It's the masterpiece of Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin. A mechanical city built for the sole purpose of trapping and eliminating Tacet Discords to keep wider Mengzhou safe.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Xuanfang Hold has stood at the border between our two states for over two hundred years now. Not a single incident in all that time. It's a "living" city in its own way that doesn't rely on people to run things. Instead, it uses creations called "Autopuppets" to fight off TDs.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I should be returning to my lab. I wish you a swift and successful conclusion to this case.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Yangyang, Rover, what are your plans now?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Don't let Jinzhou weigh on you. Just focus on the problem at hand.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.

Sail Day, Captain!.desc: What would the Captain of the Fool's Troupe normally do? Stage an impromptu performance or set out on a great adventure? Instead of speculating, why not hear it straight from Brant himself? A captivating journey surely awaits!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Thank you! Thank you!

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: That was a wonderful performance!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: To be honest, I came dangerously close to it…

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Take care not to overindulge again. We don't offer home delivery for humans, I assure you.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Alright, seems like we've got ourselves a lucky gentleman.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: How about an introduction first, and then you tell us where that coin is?

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Even in Septimont, folks claim they've seen Tacet Discords not of this land in the wilds, or the ghosts of their ancestors.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Thanks to all these oddities, the mood in Ragunna has gone sour.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Troupe performed today because Brant thought a new play to lighten the mood might give the people some hope.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: But here's the odd part. Only Rinascitans seem to be having these dreams. Visitors are spared... the same should be true of you.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Well... Not Brant or me. But someone in the Troupe has. They said they dreamed of sinking into an enormous, black ocean...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: The Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea have been more restless lately. And the "siren's" songs? Well, they've started sounding an awful lot like the Order's hymns...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Oh, it's Rover...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from Riccioli Islands to safety.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Compared to what you're about to face, that s torm was nothing.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Sailing into the unknown is never easy. Sailing through the Dark Tide? Even worse.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Pero stocked up on gadgets. You can take whatever you like!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: This is all we can do for you right now... Please come back safe, Rover.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: In the face of danger and adversity, the stage is set for our grandest act!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Brant, you handle the Tacet Discords. I've got the dragon.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Of course, but with all due respect... shouldn't the Captain be the one giving the orders?

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Just playing to our strengths. Take it, or I'll spill the beans about your wine stash.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Aye, aye, First Mate!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: It's time to pay for what you've done, Dragon of Dirge.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: The north flank's ours! Let's give 'em a grand show!

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: The Montellis greet you. We will secure this side.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: "Ghost" is just a dramatic name given by the Ragunnesi for Tacet Discords. They look nearly identical to Echoes, especially in the mist.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: With your help, Grandfather has thwarted their plan. No corrupted Echoes will appear at this year's Carnevale.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Order has allied with the Fractsidus to control the dragon... From what I saw when I connected with its frequency, they might be planning to command it to attack Ragunna during the Carnevale.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: After the Tacet Discords took over this isle, the Order used them as an excuse to forbid any entry. It might be their way of concealing the dragon's existence.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: But without the Lycoris, the Dragon of Dirge is now off the table.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: We're also waiting for your guidance, Primus.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Inded. The show is still missing a key character! The ceremony can't kick off in grand style without our beloved, ever-devout Acolyte!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: It's Cetus The Tidebreaker! Are you here to see our Rover off too? Haha, I remember the moment we met like it was yesterday.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Maybe it's more than just a farewell. I think the Tidebreaker wants to escort you on your journey.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Copy that!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Leave them to us!

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hey Buling, can you help me track down the Sovereign?

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: You got it. Gimme a sec to scan things.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Emm... Sorry, Boss. The frequencies around you are all over the place... I can't get a clear reading.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: This Sovereign's a slippery eel, eating up every little frequency like it's popcorn. Now the Tethys system's got nothing to work with!

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Hmph... it's playing hide-and-seek with us on purpose. What trouble.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Hold on. What if you bring me some pure Dark Tide frequency samples?

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Maybe I should try using the power of separation? I might be able to split the projection from the rift... )

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Hey, Boss! You zoned out again. Still thinking about the creepy rift, huh?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ... Something about this isn't normal.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The frequency data sent to the Black Shores, the coordinates pointing to this rift, this Sonoro of a ruined city... It's hard to make sense of the info we have. If only we could enter it ourselves...

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Would've been nice, huh? But this thing's got its doors shut tight to outsiders. But you Rover, you might be different! You're always full of surprises.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Still, are you sure you want to? I've "seen" it... That's a Death Gate, clear as day.

Shadow of Glory.desc: As you consider the connection between Lupa and the strange happenings in Septimont, Buling appears once more.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And you are...?

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Me? I'm a traveling Taoist from Mengzhou. Just call me Buling.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it! So Rover, you want to try your luck fah?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How did you know my name?

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: We've got history. Last time I went up to the mountain to see her, she mentioned you.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Into Woolies' belly you go!

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Don't be silly. Seeing you is always my No. 1 priority.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Cammellya, shouldn't you be on a mission?

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Got it done early. And I wouldn't finished it even sooner if someone had told me a city popped up off the coast of the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: So... you must be Chisa?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: ...Hello.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: I saw the report on Honami. Oh, it's such a shame I wasn't there for the excitement.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: If "the conflict is meaningless," why not have a little fun in the meaningless? Rover is having fun, see?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Fun int he meaningless...? It's true that I have never seen this side of Rover before...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I... I have never tried it myself either...

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Hehe... I can see you're starting to waver, Shorekeeper.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Even with all your computing power, you'll still end up choosing to have fun with us. So just stop resisting!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: It will be... my choice? Hmm... my own decision...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: So you don't have...

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Try not to let me catch you so easily next time~!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And she's gone... Huh, that was fast.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Photo time's over.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Do the honors, Acting Manager.

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Rising silently, cutting through the darkness… It's the only time it's glow is tender and soft.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So, you come here for the sun?

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Flowers thirst for light and water. It's their instinct.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: I'm no different.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: But I can't always linger here. Being a Bloom Bearer means I have my own responsibilities.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Like what?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Well then, Lady Cantatrella. What are your terms...?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms... naturally, there are some.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The family has an ancient blueprint for a ship. I wish to see it brought to life with your expertise.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Once completed, it may serve your transport needs. It was once the "ark" carrying our ancestors from disasters. Now, I hope... it will carry the future.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: That's truly... an offer one can hardly refuse. In that case, we will cover the funding and materials needed for construction.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: And should you ever return to Rinascita, know this. You will always be our most honored guest and dearest friend.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Not just us, but these little Echoes too. We'll hold this bond close, always.

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc: And now, with Tyrvine restored and fate uncertain, Cantarella poses a question to the distraught Cartethyia: "The real Blessed Maiden is dead.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Wait, I'm not ready yet!

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Ever the early riser. Did you call to say good morning?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Good morning...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Is something the matter, Cartethyia?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I just wanted to know how you're doing.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: ... Ah, so you do care. Good to know my efforts weren't wasted.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: So, I decided a little nap was in order.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Sorry, I've ruined the anniversary...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Cartethyia, do kindly cast your gaze upon me, Rover, and MR. "Most Powerful Resonator" over there. Have you noticed our smiles?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Despite the somewhat tumultuous proceedings and the rather crude stage, I'm certain that your good wishes, along with Abbowser's, have been felt by all.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: That's good to hear!

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Rover? What brings you back to the Inverted Tower so suddenly?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Something's come up. I need Cartethyia's help to deal with it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did something unusual happen here?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: I've only just arrived. For now, everything appears to be in order. I didn't come because of any disturbance.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: There are matters I, too, need to discuss with Cartethyia...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispersfor long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc:
With that in mind, Rover bids farewell to Ciaccona and sets off toward the Fisalia estate.

=== Cantarella and the Sentinel ===
The current head of the Fisalia family introduces herself as Cantarella. Drawing on prior information provided by Gilberto, Rover questions Cantarella regarding the Fisalia family's rumoured allegiance to the Threnodian.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: So, you'd do well to visit often.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Before I forget, Imperator left a message.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: ...Tell me, I'm ready.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: "From this day forth. You are free."

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: ...I'll remember that.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Will you tell the others?

Shadow of Glory.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Go on, what is it you wish to ask of me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I want to learn more about the archipelago before I set off to find her.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Ah, caution is indeed a virtue. Since you're in a hurry, I'll spare you the lengthy details.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: That archipelago is called Septimont.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It's another city-state within Rinascita. Like us Ragunnesi, its people were guided by the Sentinel across vast seas to settle there.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: But over time, Septimont and Ragunna's differences led to a rift. Each one forged its own path.

A Fleeting Night's Dream.desc: In the bustling event, you spot Cantarella in the crowd. After reading the strange message you received, Cantarella explains that the Night of Remembrance is centered around ghost-related themes.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That person does seem a bit extra...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It's understandable. Hearing a Laureate perform is an honor, a blessing for everyone in Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Even this music box should be humming along in admiration…

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Oh, so that's why this little thing isn't behaving… Someone must have silenced it, leaving it unable to sing.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If you look at this music box from above, doesn't it resemble a big apple?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Hmm, now that you mention it… Indeed, it does.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: The current Primus claims to be the Enlightened One, the Sentinel's Resonator. However, based on the prophecy we found in the ruins, this role is meant for the young maiden who is destined to heed the divine oracles during the Carnevale.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Carnevale is the only time humans can directly communicate with the Sentinel. Normally, it's the Primus who conveys the Sentinel's words.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: A successful Carnevale offers a chance for citizens to meet the Sentinel in person. But for the Primus, and possibly the Order, it poses a threat if they've been fabricating the oracles.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: To sabotage it while still maintaining their authority... they partnered with the Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Fractsidus will cause chaos during the Carnevale, and the Order will swoop in as the saviors, restoring public trust just as they did before.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: So far, you've helped us crush three of their schemes, but one remains...

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: P-please don't...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Hehe, Primus Phoebe... Now, that sounds like a wonderful investment!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh Lady Carlotta, not you too...

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Zani, status of the evacuation?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Eighty percent of Ragunna's residents have been relocated.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: But... the Troupe of Fools hit a storm while ferrying people from the Riccioli Islands. Rough seas out there.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Trust them to see it through.

lines.speaker: Montelli Member
lines.text: Miss Carlotta! We've cleared the depositories as ordered. Ready to receive incoming supplies.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Good. Rinascita's greatest treasure has always been the people who built it. The next Cloudpuffer Express is due at any moment. Be ready to offload.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: But really, such "technology" is our family's prodest "asset." Naturally, we brought what we could with us.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Septimont's Common Echoes use a different configuration than Ragunna's, but the underlying logic is compatible. Our tuning technique will still serve us well here.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I don't care about overtime in this case... If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Besides, Ms. Carlotta hasn't rested properly in days.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: In times like these, we cannot afford even a sliver of carelessness. We must do everything within our power... so that you can focus on what lies ahead in the Dark Tide without distractions.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Allow me to properly introduce myself. My name is Carlotta, Carlotta Montelli.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Montelli... You are the...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: The second daughter of the Montelli Family, yes. Please feel free to call me Carlotta.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Also, I trust the renumeration meets your satisfaction, Ms. Zani?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: It was you who tasked me with receiving Rover?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Surely a distinguished guest such as Rover deserves the attention of our most trusted employee.

The One that Impresses.desc: Zani politely declines Carlotta's offer to help pay off her debt and promises to assist you after work every day.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: You can go ahead now. I'll catch up after my shift.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If I were to help you clear your debts and find a way to make Abbowser forgive you, would you consider working for the family again, Zani?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Rest assured, the Montellis never settle for a bad bargain. I believe Abbowser has yet to realize Zani's true value.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: More importantly, Zani has been an indispensable companion for both you and me. No price is too high for a friend.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Lady Carlotta, this is... much too flattering. Wait, this isn't part of your plan is it?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If it helps put you at ease, feel free to see this as purely a business matter.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...He's headed for Thessaleo Fells.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: We've lost contact with Cantarella. The Beacon on her end appears to have been destroyed.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Dark clouds are gathering over Thessaleo Fells... Something is definitely wrong.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: ...Very well. We'll hold the line. Zani, call in the family's transport Echoes. We'll assist Rover where we can.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: But if the images on the stained glass windows were fabricated, why would the Order deface them and declare this tower forbidden?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There's only one explanation. These are not fabrications but buried truth.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If this is indeed the Order's doing... we must leave here immediately.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: North of this tower is an island.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: It should be beyond their reach. Once we get there, you will discover another truth the Order has buried—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Watch out!

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: At that time, the entire city was shrouded in mist. Ghosts roamed the streets, a dragon roared from the sky and a sea behemoth raged, summoning towering waves... Do any clues come to mind?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The mist might be coming from the Remnant Clouds in the Nimbus Sanctum. Lorelei has the power to purify and control them, but the Fractsidus interfered…

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Remnant Clouds corrupted by evil will disrupt Echoes' frequencies. If the mist had spread to the city, it would have stirred the Echoes into chaos.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: We are lucky that you and Zani, along with that Acolyte, awakened Lorelei in time. You prevented the mist from spreading and averted the Waveworn. The Fractsidus must still be licking their wounds.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Montelli traitors used Lycoris in experiments to turn Echoes back into Tacet Discords... If they were successful, the "ghosts" seen ten years ago may have also been created this way.

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc: Along the way, Rover encounters Ciaccona, a wandering bard dispatched by Carlotta to assist in the journey.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: I'll call you as soon as I find anything.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Got it.

If On a Rainy Night a Family.desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Now, Cat's Eye, will you stand with me to catch the traitor within our family and avert this looming threat?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I understand decorum is important to the Montellis. But among friends, can't we be a bit more... informal?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: What made you say that?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Hmm, you're curious who I am beyond my role, is that it?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Hmm, I just might entertain that thought.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: But for now, my agents just sent me the address of Benett's residence. While his body has been found, what he left behind is still out there.

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: At the Margherita's Restaurant, you meet Carlotta. Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: We should also share these findings with Ciaccona. As a poet, her insights would be much appreciated.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's strange, she was just there a moment ago.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: ...Just like when we were children. Gone without a trace.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: When she and her family disappeared without even a goodbye.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Ms. Margherita, have you seen Ciaccona?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: That scene was delightful. You've presented another precious opportunity to me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Opportunity?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Yes. an opportunity to explore something yet to be assessed with you. Speaking of which, how do you feel about a future collaboration?

The One that Impresses.desc: Zani politely declines Carlotta's offer to help pay off her debt and promises to assist you after work every day.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: It's been a long time since Ilast sat down with the Order's doctrines... I didn't expect this many changes while I was "gone."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The Codex has been revised serveral times over the past decade...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Wait, "Flying Ragunnesi" was banned? That play is a masterpiece! And civilians aren't allowed to perform at the Carnevale anymore?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: ...Such harsh decrees should all be struck down!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: O-okay, I've noted it down. Actually, I think this one should go too...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: And this—"Acolytes must avoid close contact with Common Echoes"? That's beyond absurd!

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Understood. I will help as much as I can.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: No need to worry about all that! I've already taken care of everything.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Lollo Logistics has already packed it all up! Mission accomplished!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: But we haven't counted everything yet...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You two really have... very different personalities.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, (Righteous One).

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Farewell, Laureate! I hope that someday, I might stand on stage with your troupe.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Are you alright, Rover? Some family members mentioned you were speaking to a wall... I'm worried you might still be under Phrolova's spell.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: See who? Are you truly alright?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Cartethyia... I'll make a note of it.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If she was indeed here, she is likely still in Ragunna. I will have my family start searching.

Flames of Heart.desc: You begin to piece together everything you've learned about Septimont, Lupa, Cartethyia, Mya, the Dark Tide, and Arsinosa. Lupa arrives at the flooded Old District, the waters stirring memories of when she once walked these streets with Cartethyia.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I once believed the Threnodian sought to use the Fractsidus to regain power, but Its true goal is the Central Hub. I believe it's due to this secret the Sentinel has hidden.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: That direction... It leads to the hunting grounds.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The Blightcloud still lingers there. When the High Tide comes, Septimontians hunt and cull the spawning Tacet Discords.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: The Dark Tide... connects everything.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I cannot pinpoint where the Sentinel's message lies. I'm afraid you must go there yourself, Rover.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: But the worst of the storm has passed. Let's take a moment to rest.

Shadow of Glory.desc: You sense a faint trace of Cartethyia's frequency on Lupa, but she denies ever meeting her. Meanwhile, Lupa's departure from House Silva sparks retaliatory rumors, but she appears unaffected, focusing on helping your search for Cartethyia.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Come forth, and face my blade.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Welcome to my city, Gryphon's Fortress of Capitoline Hill!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Who are they...?

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Oh, some minor noble houses that didn't make it into the Agon.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: But in Septimont, strength and power go hand in hand. Nobles get more, but they better prove they're worth it and pull their weight for the city.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The Agon isn't just about fortune. It's a way to find the capable. For nobles, the ability to command and control Echoes is a basic responsibility.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: The safest option is for me to go in person.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: ...Very well.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Since we are already mid-game, I will let you decide our next move.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: This time, I shall be a pawn in your hand.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Remember I will always stand by your side, in this crisis or any other.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: ...Am I a player or a mere pawn? I suppose there is no difference at this point.

Truthseeker's Pass (Quest).desc: According to Xinyi, Hongzhen's Mayor, Jinhsi has gone off to Truthseeker's Pass, or the Court of Savantae Ruins. The Cipher Key stored in the heart of Truthseeker's Pass is a precondition to opening Mianloong Chamber and the audience with Jué, the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: You...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Don't worry. Rover is special. The Temporal Dusruption can't hurt .

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Shh...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I gave my word to be your pawn and I intend to keep it. As your teacher and courtier, it is only right for me to do so.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: And let's not forget, without me playing the Wayfinder for Rover, we wouldn't even have here.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Abbowser just vanished into thin air!

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It probably moved deeper into the labyrinth.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: We'll explain later, Rover.

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Ah, Passengers! You're back!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: ...What... How are you—?!

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Hm? I'm brewing tea for you.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: But you said... "this is as far as I go"?

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Uh... yes. It was as far as I could go because I had to go back to the cafe first...

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Something's probably broken inside. I'll take a look.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Namipon, was that a live signal from Lahai-Roi?

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Yes, it was. That cassette we put inside lets it receive radio signals from the rift.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: With the right tweak, maybe I can track it. Like I did with Neon Tower's—

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: It sounded like the Academy's radio talk show... But why did I hear my mother?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Does that mean she's at Startorch? Why is she there? Is she... looking for me?

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Oh, don't get all serious! You can visit during your holidays.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: ...Alright. I promise I'll visit often.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Well then, Rover, I'll see you at the Academy.

Stranger Things in Honami/Story.desc: After the end of Honami's looping crisis, Chisa heads to the Black Shores to recover. Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City. Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to help rebuild the Shashou Cafe.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Lives that were never meant to meet all found a connection in the cafe. And slowly, this place became the central station for it all.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Maybe… that is why you, the symbol of Honami, appeared here in the first place.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Beats me. At the very least, this cafe is proof that the Honami of the past existed.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Then, as the Shashou, you have to take good care of it, Namipon.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Don't you worry. The story of Shashou Cafe is just getting started.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Next time you get the chance, remember to bring more of your friends over to visit, Rover, Chisa.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Very good lah! My reading for you said visitors from all around, wealthy coming in thick and fast. Super lucky day for an opening!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: You must be Buling?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I've heard about you from Rover. You're the one who helped pinpoint Honami's rift. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: It's no biggie. Me and Boss, we go way back. Just treat me to good meal and we're even.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I see you're all waiting here. Could I be mistaken about the time?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: No, not at all. We're glad you made it, Shorekeeper. Shasho Cafe welcomes you aboard!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Mmm...

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Hmm...? If only that were true.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: My apologies. I'm late.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: It's time to set out.

Utterance of Marvels: I.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: You made a couple kicks and that thing vanished into thin air!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: That's strange. This place isn't known to be so dangerous...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Anyway, come check this out!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Oh, this is... an Echo.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Wow! An Echo of the Elite Class... Someone got lucky today!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: My apologies. We got a little carried away. Does "Reverberation" or "Echo" ring a bell to you, Rover?

Utterance of Marvels: II.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: It may take some time, but there won't be too much paperwork.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Then I guess I'll take Rover over to the Nexus Tower for registration first, and we'll just hang out for a while.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Being new to Jinzhou and all, can't be left standing outside the City Hall with nothing to do.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hospitality is our local speciality, you know!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Then I'll leave you in Chixia's care, Rover. Is that alright with you? I'll give you a call once the paperwork is done.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Leave it to me!

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady Sanhua", and they were compelled to leave.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: What kind of description is that? sounds like they've met some snake-haired lady, and got turned into stone.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: She's the Magistrate's personal bodyguard.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Oh, I've heard of her before. She's the "All-round Death Glare slash Terminator Ice Beauty."

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: ...That's what the rumors say, at least.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: There is a small chance she's not in the City Hall, but it is very unlikely for her not to be in Jinzhou.

Echoing Marche.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: So it only took us one trip to the Academy to solve half of our problems. Either Rover's really smart, or Madam Magistrate was gonna make it easy for us to begin with.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: What's our next plan of action, Rover?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: As for the mangosteen, we've got people selling these at the market nearby. Might find some clues there.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Mangosteens are not from Jinzhou. These fruits are usually brought in by boat. Should we start from the harbor?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Do you think the token is guiding us outside the city?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Those wackos are hellbent on making their own Resonators. Said there's no right or wrong when it comes to Resonance powers and everyone should have the right to them.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: They use mechanical manipulation to integrate parts of Tacet Discords into human bodies.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Seeking power with such gruesome acts... I cannot bring myself to understand them.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: That Scar guy you mentioned sounds like he's on a whole other level. How did the fight go?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: He... It seems he didn't intend to kill us. I would say he was even pulling his punches.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I don't know what he wants from us. But Madam Magistrate may have intended to hint something by letting us run into him.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Uhhh... Maybe the Sentinel had its own special ways of picking candidates?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Or maybe it is their incomprehensible ways that set these divine beings apart from us? Their thinking tends to be elusive to the average person.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yeah, true. Wouldn't be surprised if Jué decided to make me the Magistrate one day, not gonna lie!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I understand your concern, Rover.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Madam Jinhsi was only a teenager, and she was suddenly selected to be the Magistrate. It must have been so difficult for her...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I remember people were skeptical when she first took office.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: You're injured... Please go get yourself patched up first!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Chixia is right. Please leave it to us. We'll help deliver these supplies.

lines.speaker: Weary Patroller
lines.text: Huff... Okay... Thank you!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Rover, Yangyang and I need to get these stuff delivered.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Director Taoqi should be at the northern pass. We'll go meet you there as soon as we're done!

A New Companion.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Seems like you're trying to boost your ego a bit!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Oh, actually... While those aren't Baizhi's exact words, that is what she meant.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: She mentioned highly intelligent Echoes that can act on their own in other countries. Said they are involved in every aspect of human life, with unique abilities beyond our imagination.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Those Echoes are rare though. Neither I nor Baizhi, an Ecoacoustics expert, have ever seen one in person. But this little thing here... It could be one of those foreign Echoes.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yeah, makes sense! Now we just gotta figure out where it came from. Who knows, we may find other cool Echoes in that place!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Ugh! Why, you little—!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Chixia—! Are you all right?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: I'm okay. Just a scratch—I can still—

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...Chixia—

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yangyang?
