lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: One of us has to make it back—

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: You do look nice, I'll be honest. Hehe.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Oh, this... It's a long story...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: How about I tell you the full story after I'm back in Jinzhou?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Ohhh... Now you've really piqued my curiosity! I'm gonna hold you to that.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Enough about me. How have you been?

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Before we hang up, anything you wanna say to Rover, Yangyang?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Me? But I'm not ready...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Okay, erm... How're you doing today, Rover?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I'm looking forward to enjoying the Moonlit Fair with you tonight.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: And you, Baizhi?

Hidden Between the Waves.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...Rover! Finally got through...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hey, you scared us to death!!!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Glad to know you're all right.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...Rover! Finally got through...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yeah! Just so you know, we got the Black Shores' warning, so we cranked up the defenses in Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: The Midnight Rangers are preparing to secure the Port City of Guixu, and...

Moonlit Reunion.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: That's right. Remember what I told you about wishes made under the Wishing Tree coming true?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: There are stories of it flying around... Especially in recent years, the wishes people make on the eve of the Moon-Chasing Festival seem to come true in one form or another.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: A few years ago, Jinzhou had endless rain. Yangyang wished for clear skies for the Festival and a perfect Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: And guess what? The rain stopped, and the moon was full and bright.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Exactly. I thought I'd try my luck, but it actually happened.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Perhaps just a pleasant coincidence? The Moon-Chasing Festival does have a history of such coincidences. Maybe there's something to the Wishing Tree's magic after all.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I've got a hostage, you see?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Whoa! You-you... Don't move!

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: I wouldn't try anything stupid if I were you. Can't risk the VIP of Jinzhou getting hurt, now can we?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Ugh, fine... Lower your weapons guys!

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: "Trust me... Come this way."

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: The Fractsidus again? Ugh, those jerks!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...

A New Companion.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: I thought Yangyang said you had a super cool lil' buddy to show us. Where is it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Uh, I don't know...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Did it just... pop out of your Tacet Mark...?

lines.speaker: Little One
lines.text: Mmm... smells good!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the Norfall Barrens?

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yang... Yang...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Fine, I'll be a good girl and behave myself. Can't have everyone looking after me forever...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You can worry about that later, Chixia. Just focus on recovering for now.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yes,

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Think of it as taking some time off. It's not every day you get to let loose a little bit.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Good point...

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hello? What's up, Chixia?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hey, Rover! You've been to the Wishing Tree, right? What did you wish for?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Did it come tru— Oh wait, it can't be that fast...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Gotcha!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Still busy with the preparations?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Almost finished! It's crazy here with all these people bustling around!

Solitary Path.desc: Chixia contacts you to say that several Jinzhou citizens have recently gone missing. You realize the place is connected to the Séance Society, so you use the communication panel you found earlier to send the coordinates and details of the situation to Chixia.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Chixia just called me. I wonder what's happening...)

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Huh? Is that your first reaction? Come on!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Anyway! You know, we could really use your help with this ongoing case!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Here's the thing, we could really use your help with this ongoing case...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: We've been getting a lot of missing persons reports recently.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Nobody ever saw those people assaulted or anything, they just vanished.

Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jin.desc: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I can confirm this lady isn't Chixia. Aside from the red hair, they have nothing in common.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: See? Told you! I'm not Chixia!

lines.speaker: Sen
lines.text: I-I see... But if you're the real Rover, then who's the missing one?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can you give me more details on this case?

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery. Carlotta sighs that Ciaccona has never changed since childhood, always vanishing without a word.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Rover, Carlotta, it's been too long!

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: You really must adore that song. I remember hearing you sing it when I was little.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Oh, I remember it well! Those two guards of yours were like giants from Septimont, easily two hundred pounds of pure muscle!

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Back then Ciaccona's family conducted the Order's choir.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: How should I put it... Well, as they say, families are always rising and falling.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: By the name of Imperator! We'll protect the Obelisks here!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: I have an idea! If Leviathan found Its Anchor of Reality to summon the Tidespawn into our world...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: We follow suit and find an Anchor of Hope to find a way out of the world of the Dark Tide!

Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilog.desc: The Crisis at the Skyworks has come to an end, and Danjin has found her path. It is a treacherous one, but with the light pulsating in her jade pendant and your words in her heart, she no longer fears what lies ahead.

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: Rover? Are you planning on training here too?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Didn't you say you were looking for hobbies outside of combat? Why are you here?

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: Hehe, one thing at a time. Training is different. Besides, here I can fight all kinds of powerful enemies I've never even heard of…

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: It literally gets my blood flowing.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Normally, this isn't meant for solo training...

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: Huh? Really? But I've already had a few rounds.

phone.speaker: Danjin
phone.text: Rover! The Battle Shade Shroud is something else!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Well, that came out of the blue. You're there already?

phone.speaker: Danjin
phone.text: It has all kinds of features, perfect for daily combat training!

phone.speaker: Danjin
phone.text: And the scenarios are all right up my alley. I'll be coming here every day until Suyu is back on her feet!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Don't forget to make Loong Whiskers Crisps...

Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall.desc: You encounter Suyu, an injured Midnight Ranger, in Xuanfang. She tells you that she is here on a mission as an Oversight Officer, accompanying a unique Resonator. Seizing the chance, you join this Resonator in investigating a crisis unfolding in the Skyworks, and along the way, uncover the burdens she carries in her heart...

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: My blood... it had turned into blades. It carved through the Exiles. The floor, the ceiling, the whole warehouse was covered in crimson slashes...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did you Overclock?

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: I've always been at risk, and I must've come very close that time. But luckily, the Patrollers found me when they did... And this jade pendant.

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: It was the last thing my family left me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Were they… by Exiles?

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: They're all the same. Bandits. Murderers. No difference.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Danjin performed well. Her mental state was stable, and she kept her Forte under good control during combat.

phone.speaker: Danjin
phone.text: It was still a bit risky, though. Good thing Rover and the big robot were there to help out.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Danjin sliced the Myriad Snare clean in half at the entrance of the Skyworks. One strike, and our problem was solved.

phone.speaker: Suyu
phone.text: Huh? Of course Danjin... Whoops, I meant to say, of course, Danjin the Great crushed it out there!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Hehe. We took it a bit far, but you did great out there, Danjin.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: After we took down the Myriad Snare, the chaos in the Skyworks subsided.

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: You should leave here. You don't smell like "them." Take this as a token of my gratitude, and I wish you a safe journey.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Smell?

lines.speaker: Danjin
lines.text: Greed, wrath, envy...

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Okay then, we should find a quiet spot...

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Go see the Divinator. I'll get you tickets.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Good idea! I can pick up the new riddle while we're there. You're the best, Nia!

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: It's Denia.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Now off you go. Bye-bye.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Alright, alright. Let's head to the Divinator's place. See you later, Lynae!

Beneath a Melting Night Sky.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Sigh... Speaking of Nivora, I wonder how she's doing now.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: ...Siggy.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Let's take another photo together.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Really? That's a first for you!

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Come on, Rover, you too. And... can I borrow your camera?

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: No... don't—

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Is she stopping us of her own will?

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Pfft! Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: ...That last part? Who said that?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: What I'm trying to say is I really don't know what happened! (But I do know who's responsible for this!)

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Let me make this clear. (I'll keep telling the truth anyway.) This candy's effect is very serious... (And I know you're not going to go easy on me.)

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Rover, anything else fun to show?

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Cosmos! Cloudy! You saw anything fun?

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Reporting in! Cosmos saw nothing!

lines.speaker: Cloudy
lines.text: Cloudy saw nothing either, Baa.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: What?! Go! Go look again!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Baa!

Small Wooly, Big Adventures.desc: While in Jinzhou, you run into Encore on vacation. She extends a special invitation to you— The adventure is about to begin! As Encore's closest friend, will you join the Wooly Warrior on this exciting journey?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: And among these people, there's a small adventurer that goes by the name of "Wooly Warrior." When asked about her desires, she replies:

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: "I do not seek wealth or honor. Baa."

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Fairy Cloudy, greatly puzzled by this reply, goes on to ask:

lines.speaker: Cloudy
lines.text: "If you desire neither wealth nor honor, why do you choose to venture to the Gateway of Wishes?"

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: "I have but one wish, to be reunited with my family."

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Fairy Cloudy nods in approval and offers her guidance to the little warrior.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: Oh, please watch out... It's dangerous to run like that...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Here you are! Hurray!

Small Wooly, Big Adventures.desc: With Verina's guidance, you and Encore set out to find the perfect flowers that represent your feelings, weaving them together into a beautiful wreath.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: The flower typically blooms in pairs, representing companionship and support. Perfect for conveying friendship.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: And these. These are Encore's picks!

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: That's quite the selection, Encore. What do they all represent?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Have a look at this one. It's gold and shiny, and it matches the color of your eyes, Rover!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Encore picked flowers that resemble everyone. If we put them together, they can represent our whole team.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: That's pretty special! I'm sure it'll look really nice once they're all together.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hello, little one. Is your name Encore? Do you know this person?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Yes! Encore knows him!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Uncle Aalto sells stuff without a license, he listens in on people for commercial secrets, and he loves pulling pranks on us kids... But he's not a bad guy, really!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: You bear the Dark Tide's power, but you are no Harbinger.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Good, we can avoid the lengthy explanation. If you're looking for the Harbinger too, you must've seen it. The apocalypse Leviathan will bring forth.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It was meant to remain restrained by the Sentinel. But I feel It stirring again. I followed Its frequency... and found you.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Most of Leviathan's power resides in me. But a fragment escaped. I've been tracking the one who carriesthat power.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: That Gem was cast into the Dark Tide. If this is where things are at, that leads to only one conclusion...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: But that's all theorizing best kept to caffeinated hours. For now, we'll need to wait until Tethys completes its analysis before drawing any conclusions.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Well, I'm glad it helped. I'll be on my way then.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Hey, Rover... She's got real skill. Moves like she's already part of our rhythm. This kind of synergy doesn't come knocking twice. What do you say...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Everyone in the Black Shores has made it their mission to stand against the Lament. Our goals are the same, and we've been walking the same path from the start.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I know you're not the type who likes being tied down by titles. But just remember this... You're not fighting it alone. So...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Go after it. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Come on. We've still got work to do.

The Flaming Red from Tomorrow.desc: After the Dark Side incident comes to an end, Lucilla meets with Hiyuki at the auditorium. Lucilla suspects that the Fractsidus may be plotting something far more dangerous behind the scenes...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Have you swallowed it?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Umm-hmm. A bit sour… and my tongue's tingling. Not my favorite.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Huh? No reaction at all? That's odd. When Sigrika and the others ate theirs, they…

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You're no fun.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: saw me. Does that affect your plan?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: What are you looking at?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah, there you are. Nothing really. I've just been wondering... if I wanted to land another astronomical investment to study all the Exoswarm coming off this giant mech...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: What kind of pitch would it take to make every major player in Solaris nod along and funnel Credits into my pocket, year after year?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Have you figured it out?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Not yet. My conscience won't let me think that far. Luckily, the man who can figure it out is back.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: ...The old man who promised me the blade? The head of the Spacetrek Collective?

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Should you lose yourself in the Voidmatter, it will also guide you back.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Hiyuki is part of Startorch Academy's Special Response Force. She works from the shadows, she's been an incredible help to us all.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: If, in your fight with the Threnodian, you require aid...

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: ...You may make a wish to me.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: How about I go first? I wish for peace and safety across the Dimmr Plains.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Hehe, Hiyuki is the strong and silent type. Spend enough time with her, though, and you'll find she's rather fascinating.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Suoming...

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Should the tide become irreversible, then you may exercise my authority in my stead.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: You... What has happened?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Qingxiao accepts your charge.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: With you here, I am at ease. Perhaps soon... you will find the answer to that which you have asked the heavens.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: ...Where will you go now?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Shh. That is still a secret.

Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: "But the Arbiter already acknowledged me as the Sentinel. So no matter what, I won't doubt myself again!"

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Hahaha, you and the Moon Fox are so alike, it's adorable!

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: But here's what I want you to know. The choice you made… it fulfilled the Moon Fox's wish.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: The Moon Fox's wish?

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Just as Hsin the Moon Fox defied the laws of the Sentinels to build Xuanfang Hold and shelter all beings...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: What is that in the center? An opening? Something inside is sending them frequencies to recover!

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: The Tidespawn are still hiding in there, ready to strike again... Damn it. There's no end to this...

Shadow of Glory.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: That's Iuno, the Priestess of Septimont. She rarely leaves the Temple and only shows up accompanying Ephor Augusta.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: The heroic spirits of the moon and stars have long seen through it. These hollow lies taint Septimont's sacred arena.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Guilty.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Augusta, banish the Silvas from Septimont!

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The Priestess can foretell fate and has the power to make final calls here. Most people trust her judgment.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: But... Iuno is a bit extreme in our line of Priestesses. Not everyone agrees with her behavior, despite her capabilities.

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Whether the Priestesses can't foresee the fate that awaits, or whether the true prophecy is meant to remain hidden... Is indeed a question worth pondering.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Our would-be Hero of Heroes, lost in daydreams again? What is it this time? Staring at an empty wall, hoping one day it'll bear your name?

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: I happened to wander by, passing the time as one does. No need to trouble yourself with someone as inconsequential as I, Priestess.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Inconsequential? Come now. Everyone knows you're the Senate's golden child. Those old loons wouldn't spare me a glance, but they hang on your every word.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Have you been waiting long? Ugh, I can't believe he got to you first.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Isn't paying respects to the Heroes fairly commonplace? Surely, we needn't allow rivalry to come between us, Priestess.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Rinascita will not falter just because a few of its leaders are gone. Its people will rise.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: We'll meet again in the Paradise and end this together... Leviathan will fall

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: While he was running his mouth at you, I gave him a little love tap in the back. Shame he slipped away behind a wall of Autopuppets.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: I see... that's why Muyu's phantom vanished so suddenly.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Whoa. So that's the Moon Fox's relic from Fogveil Pagoda? Figured it ended up with you.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Ruoyun?

lines.speaker: Ruoyun
lines.text: ...Yes. Sword Transcendent Qingxiao... It has been... a very, very long time.

lines.speaker: Ruoyun
lines.text: Uhh... How was I supposed to know the Sentinel's relic would reveal my true form like that?!

lines.speaker: Ruoyun
lines.text: Wait, this Prism of Fate, the Xuanfang Resonance Beacon, and the Sanctum... Are the knowledge restrictions lifting?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Now this is something. Have you two heard the legends about Xuanfang's Celestials?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Sanhua.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Yes, Madam Magistrate.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I will be going on a temporary leave. During my absence, please help me handle my responsibilities in Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Understood. Should I continue protecting that Rover?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more paperwork for you to handle.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: I'm afraid... We're already running out of time.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Report the situation, please.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Madam Magistrate, the barrier has been fully repaired and we have evacuated all residents. We've successfully minimized the damage.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Well done, Director Taoqi.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Indeed, it's been a while, Rover.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: It's been going according to plan, if I may say so. I was made aware of this in advance, and planned out our defense beforehand.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: May victory prevail the lasting night. I pray for your safe return.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: ...Thank you for your trust, Madam Magistrate.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: No need for that, General. We've always shared the same goal, you and I.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Attention, all units. Do everything you can to assist. You are authorized to use the Disruptor.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Target, the Norfall Barrens.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: We... ate it.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: All of us.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Wait... Are you...?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: It's nothing. Just some scratches. Compared to what I've gained from this trip, this is merely a small jest from That One.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I do. And I understand the urgency of the matter. Now that Rover is here, I'll brief you both directly.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Rover, Yangyang. Glad to see you both safe...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I had a feeling it was you.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Hehe. I had planned to wait until Changli returned from Mingting, but I found myself growing a bit restless.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I've already spoken with Commander Qiuhong regarding the current situation in Xuanfang Hold. Rover, I assume you intend to stay in the region to search for Sentinel Hsin?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: And you, Yangyang? What is your plan?

Mianloong Chamber (Quest).desc: According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: The Sentinel is telling us... We need to find the three Flare Stones corresponding to the Flare Crest, then we will be able to lift the confinement set by the Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I'm not seeing any Flare Stones. Or any kind of entrance to another chamber.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: There seems to be something underwater. Let's start with the Chronosorter here.

Road of Pilgrimage.desc: Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Changli...

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. Rover, don't worry. Changli has her plans.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Jinhsi. It brings me great joy to see you, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I hope I'm not talking to another projection.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: To show up as a projection again would be ill-mannered of me. Please rest assured, it is a real human in the flesh you're speaking to. Despite Huanglong's advanced technology, such a realistic projection is still impossible.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Or perhaps you would like to verify it?

Forever Fest and Lollo Party.desc: At Lumi's invitation, you come to an unending party...

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: But in one of the rounds, I confess I may have gotten a little reckless...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't worry, Jinhsi. A game at a party is meant to be fun.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: You're right. I do have a habit of overthinking.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't forget to breathe, Magistrate. Oh and, I'm looking forward to seeing you back in Jinzhou someday.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Very well, I'll be waiting.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Jinzhou is in the midst of a bustling festival, and if all the key leaders are trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, I must consider whether our emergency plan remains operaitonal.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't worry, those outside won't be affected.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: If that's the case... No, while Jinzhou may be safe for now, the cake crisis we face still demands our attention.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: No need for such formality. You are both the distinguished guest and savior of Jinzhou, Rover. I will always do my utmost to aid you.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Once the crisis is over, perhaps we can take a stroll together?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Winter shall come to pass, and the spring thaw will bring all things back to life. Perhaps that is the moral of the play.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Your goddess cameo in the final scene was spectacular.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Because you helped me rehearse. Would you like to have a stroll with me later?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Keep your guard up. I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: We... ate it.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: All of us.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about Changli...

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: I'll leave it to the professional to explain in details.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Greetings, General Jiyan, Rover.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: How's the preparation going on your side?

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: We've got good news and bad news. Good news is, we've established connection to the Disruptor and we're ready to go.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Bad news is, the Disruptor's electric capacitor is damaged.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Simply put, it's out of power.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: It's someone you know. Baizhi. She specializes in Ecoacoustic research, and the Sonoro Sphere is her field of expertise.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Yes... Whatever you do, please keep it safe.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: What now, you don't trust me?

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Rest assured. You should know how careful we are with our samples... Especially such a valuable one.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: This should be our wake-up call. The Waveworn Phenomena is more complicated than we thought.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I don't want to spoil your fun, but I'm afraid we need to suspend the race for now.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Can you fill us in on the data?

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I checked the monitoring data as you asked, and I found unusual fluctuations near the upper waters to the north.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Why didn't the nearest Beacon pick up on this anomaly?

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: The Resonance Beacon is functioning properly, but we still don't know why it didn't issue a warning this time. I will investigate this further at a later time.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Animals are often the first to detect signs of danger.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Please update me on the situation in Jinzhou city.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Under Madam Magistrate's command, the barrier has been activated and citizens are being evacuated to the safe zone.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Huaxu Academy and Ministry of Development are on standby for further instructions. Bazhi is overseeing operations at the Academy while Mortefi has arrived at the Ministry. Rest assured, we are all safe in the city.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: And that Rover... He/She is heading over to meet you. Yangyang is coming with him/her.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: I see. We have successfully contained the Outbreak here at the base.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: I will go pick them up as soon as possible.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: ...Begone!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: We did it!

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: The Thundering Mephis is a blend of countless fallen soldiers' Reverberations.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: As long as more soldiers are still dying here, it will always return. Not to mention...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Countless souls of our brave soldiers remain trapped in this rain, to this day.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...General.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: I'll send you the coordinates of the Disruptor and its backup energy port. We wish you the best of luck.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: I trust we all understand the situation now.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Rover, Yangyang, please go secure the Disruptor and fix its backup energy outlet.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Jianxin, please stay and guard the base. I'll draw those Tacet Discords away.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Let's get moving.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Gotta run, Professor!

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Rover, let's try to channel that enthusiasm into listening. Do come see me in my office after class, okay?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Assistant Nivora, if you would? Pick up from the Twilight Epoch's Unending Winter, please.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: It's another brand new "beginning" that belongs to us.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: The Academy is just a stop along the way. A cradle for dreams.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: The way I see it, everyone here already knows the path they should take and just needs a little more time to sprout.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: (Now then—)

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Dr. Herssen. Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Must you always assume the worst, Lucilla? Can't I just call to chat?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I find that highly unlikely, Doctor. Let's skip the preamble. What is it?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Rover.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah. So this is about "Aemeath." was so tight-lipped with me about what happened in the frostlands, yet spoke to you.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That promise is what keeps this Academy standing.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: We will not sit back and watch the Fractsidus exploit that. And let's not forget, the knowledge these students hold can shape the future of Lahai-Roi itself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Which means we're in a race against time. That Tacet Discord was feeding on energy. If the Dark Side is a vortex of emotion, then that thing is the eye of the storm.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We have to find it.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You may want to stock up on the candy, Dr. Luuk.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Can I apply for reimbursement?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: I've only been gone a moment, but I'm sure there's already a line forming at my door...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Phew! It's been so long since I've had this much fun!

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Students rarely invite me, you know. Most scatter the second they spot me. I stopped showing up to keep from spoiling their fun, hmph...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I'm teasing, of course. Only the ones with overdue essays have anything to fear. And on a day like today? I wouldn't dream of rushing them.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Alright, I should get back to work. I did play hooky to be here, after all. Now it's your turn to shine.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Go set some records, Rover. I have high expectations.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Every emotion leaves a mark. The fan meeting you held not long ago left the students with plenty of happy memories. That song helped guide you right through that thing's blockade.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: It's no ordinary Tacet Discord. What exactly is that thing?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I want to know what I saw in there.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Please trust me, Professor… and you too, Senior. I really want to help.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: What we can confirm is that the Tacet Discord was sent by the Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: The Fractsidus?

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: It's the most heavily contaminated area. If this is because of what happened to the Exostrider—

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Then, then...Please give me your hand, Rover!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Use this. It will guide you to other Royan runes.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Oh, and take this one too! It's for protection. With it, you'll definitely come back safely!

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Uh, what's all this?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Professor! We heard a very important visitor is coming to tour the Academy. Don't worry, we'll make a good impression!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yep, we even threw together a little welcoming thing.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Oh, you rascals... Alright, but follow my lead. If this auditor is a by-the-book type, then we—

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: And yada, yada, yada... I'll spare you the speech. Ready, everybody?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: President Lucilla, d-do we have to?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Happy graduation, Senior!

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That is exactly what the Fractsidus wants to dig their claws into.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Here you are, Siggy. Where's that new friend of yours? Let me guess... they're off planning something big, but didn't want you in on it?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I just wasn't good enough.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Here. Dusk Honeypot flavor. I know it's your favorite.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: What if we just dropped the whole riddle thing? Or... is it about proving worthy of being a future Heliodic Six successor?

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: ...Even if I did, it wouldn't fix anything.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: I get it.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: ...I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Lucy...

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: We're in the clear now. The evacuated researchers were unharmed. Are you feeling all right?

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: I'm fine... Just need a sec.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The students you protected have been sent for treatment. They asked me to send their gratitude.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: ...Didn't do much.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I'm Lynae. Nice to meet you, Rebecca!

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: Lucy. We're tyin' up some loose ends here. Try to stay outta your hair.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Sure, make yourselves at home!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: By the way, I haven't seen you around before... New students?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Ahaha, look at you, all conflicted. Fine, I won't pry.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: Prolly a good call.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: ...A train? What's a Night City train doing behind a door?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Night City?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You don't have to explain if you don't want to.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Somnoire is where dreams gather. It's a place where anything can happen.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: Anything? Sure, makes sense...

Shadow of Glory.desc: To avoid lingering too long, Lupa laughs and takes your hand, pulling you away from the arena. After coming to Septimont, you learn from Lupa just how important the arena is to the city.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: We team up and fight together in the finals?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (That's Cartethyia's frequency... but how?)

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Huh? Rover, is that your way of saying yes?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm sorry. Lupa, have you ever met a Ragunnesi girl by the name of Cartethyia?

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Cartethyia... No, never heard of her. What's going on with her?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She's missing. I'm looking for her.

Flames of Heart.desc: The Lioness of Glory Arsinosa gives you and Lupa her blessing. You begin to piece together everything you've learned about Septimont, Lupa, Cartethyia, Mya, the Dark Tide, and Arsinosa.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: But... she is still an Echo and can't talk.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (These sounds...)

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: What is it? Did you feel something just now?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I only heard strange sounds. Tell me, what direction did the Lioness just look toward?

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The Vale of Glory.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: It's where all heroes, blessed by the glory forged in iron and fire, find their rest.

Falling Stars.desc: Return to Forever Fest to see which companions have shown up today, and see if Lumi has uncovered something new.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: You're finally here, Warrior!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Come on! You're the one who was a no-show yesterday.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Haha! I wanted to come sooner, but I had a match I couldn't back out of.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: A total knockout, of course!

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: As long as you're rooting for me, losing isn't even an option.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The world's full of fights waiting for us! And with a partner like you, we're unstoppable!

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: I know! But it's so funny that I just had to share!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where is Chimera?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It's right here.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Lupa gave me a piece of that candy. I just shoved it into Chimera's mouth.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The effect is lingering, so it'll be stuck in this shape for a while.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So, Warrior! Where are you heading next?

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: …The incomplete form of the Threnodian of War? So you stopped it from hatching, but its vanguards still gave you and that Jinzhou general a right proper fight, hmm...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah. But without Abby's help, we wouldn't have been able to hold the line and defeat it.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Huh, if I'd been there, I'd have fought alongside you. Threnodian or anything else.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: The Carnevale in Ragunna…? I heard you claimed the title of Laureate there, but I never knew the full story.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: What the Fractsidus did to Rinascita is unforgivable. One day, they'll pay for that. I'll make sure of it.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: What incredible stories! Each of these battles shines with its own glory...

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: The snow... It's so beautiful.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: What a coincidence to run into you here, {PlayerName}. This is a pleasant surprise.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Oh… it's Dr. Luuk. When he's around, just pretend I'm not here. Otherwise, you look like a weirdo talking to thin air.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: You should hide too, okay? This is our secret journey.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You know him?

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: He's the school doctor. All the students know him. I didn't super well, but I do know that he's been in Lahai-Roi for a long time, and… you can trust him.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Pfft! Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: ...That last part? Who said that?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: What I'm trying to say is I really don't know what happened! (But I do know who's responsible for this!)

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Let me make this clear. (I'll keep telling the truth anyway.) This candy's effect is very serious... (And I know you're not going to go easy on me.)

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: How to put this... I think you can have more faith in yourself, Sigrika.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Faith in myself...

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: You see, people can be more perceptive than you might realize, including those you care about. So try not to take everything to heart. Go a little easier on yourself.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Good or bad, true or false, these things have a way of coming to light. And as your friend Denia said, sometimes a little distraction is good for your health.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Yeah… I'll give it a try! Thank you, Dr. Herssen.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: You're welcome. Again, don't push yourself too hard.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I think that's the answer to the final riddle.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: I'd say this calls for the special candy.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Are these... Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: With an improved formula. Not on the market yet.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: So the one who makes these is—?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Shhh... Our little secret.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Upperclassman Lynae! You're back! I'm so glad! And this is… huh?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You're the upperclassman now, Sigrika. Rover and I are just lowly freshmen.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: M-Me? But I...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: By the way, this is Rover, the one I told you about.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Wait—you're the Rover?! I can't believe you're still a freshman…

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: It's so great to finally meet you! I'm Sigrika. Lynae's told me all about you. I can't believe you're the one who took down the Voidworm!

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Don't worry. I have my runes. They'll help me drive back any contaminated Exoswarm! The Soliskin will guide me too.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I'm coming with you. Finding people is one thing, hauling them back is another. It'll be faster if we take my motorbike.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You didn't know, Rover? Everyone's saying the board is looking to shut down Rabelle College.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: No, not the college. Just the Synchronists. A professor covering our Royan History class told us the Spacetrek Collective wants them out of the Academy!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yeah, well, the rumor mill says Rabelle eats up two-thirds of the Academy's budget, and the Collective's investors have strong opinions 'bout that.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You weren't gonna just shoot us a WavesLine and dip, were ya? That'd be cold!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Oh, Senior! Come back and visit us when you get the chance, okay?

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Whoa whoa, don't gotta be like that with us!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I think this is more of a "celebration" moment than a "sorry" one!

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Sooo... any idea what this shard's doing here?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Maybe... David felt that someone was missing him, and it just... appeared?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Ooh! That's the version I'm choosing to believe.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: We'll make sure this special gift is kept safe.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: ...Yeah. Oh, Rover, just between us. On the corner of the tag, Sigrika totally...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hey! We swore we'd keep that a secret, Lynae!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Oops. Sorry. Slipped my mind.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: A secret?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: You'll just have to figure that one out youself, Rover.

Ode to the Second Sunrise.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You want me to testify against Professor Warren? That's practically perjury… Sure, I could work some verbal magic, but honestly, I don't even know who I'm dealing with on the other side...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It is a dirty tactic, but it's effective. I'm confident in my analysis of those devices, but we'll need the university's verification to use them as evidence.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: In the limited time we have, the quickest way to detain Warren is your testimony.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Professor Mornye...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: You can keep this recording. If I'm wrong, it'll be your guarantee later.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Or... you can refuse.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: The whole server bank's going nuts! Every screen is flickering!

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The data volume is far beyond the Cassette's capacity. It's as if thousands of people left their records in it...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The storage system has destabilized. It's now flooding data into every archived Cassette in the room.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: But this isn't memory data.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Aside from the corrupted junk, the compressed mass consists of coordinates.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Coordinates? From beyond the Gate? Are they... locations inside the Threnodian's black hole?

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: We just finished the weapon's analysis. I've arranged for remote configuration. Lynae and Sigrika, your attacks should be effective now.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Oh yeah, it's working! Great, now it's showtime!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Gotta earn back all those Credits I just blew... Catch you later!

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Facility readings are stable and within safety parameters. No abnormalities detected. Very good...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I did assist in designing several attractions. Monitoring their operational integrity is a logical extension of my responsibility for student safety.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Once you understand the mechanics, getting a high score is a breeze. But when it comes to games that test your rhythm or reflexes... I'm not so good at those...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Could that be a bit unfair to the students? Maybe I should delete my high scores from the server...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I always used to watch the students celebrate from my lab in the Research Institute. Being here with you, Mentor, actually participating... I think... I like it.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Easy-peasy! If anything comes up, just gimme a shout.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: And me.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Rover! Perfect timing! Here, take this.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: It's a souvenir ticket for the New Solar Celebration.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: My hand feels so warm. Incredible, it's like magic...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Huh... so this is a Royan rune...

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Happy graduation, Rover!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Congratulations on your graduation. I'll do my best to catch up to you as soon as I can.

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's... far beyond what I had imagined.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Didn't get to introduce myself. I'm Lynae, by the way.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I saw your acceptance letter, so... freshman? What's your name?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Oh okay, Rover... I got it.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: It's not totally safe yet. Let's keep moving while we talk.

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: Lynae, still concerned, mentions that where you fell was right in the middle of an active Voidworm zone. Not far away, Lynae quietly shuts off a machine that seems to be monitoring you.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Thanks… for speaking up for me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What was that device you had when Hyvatia went berserk?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Straight to the point, huh? I thought you'd let it slide, like they did.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Highly unlikely.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Good... you're still you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's your real purpose?

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Is everything going alright?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Just got inside the Institue.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: That's good

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'm lost...

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: O_O?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: It's so quiet here...

Ode to the Second Sunrise.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Figuring out who she is and what happened to her will be the next big task.)

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Rover? Rover—Hey, stop spacing out!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: To celebrate Professor Mornye waking up and the crisis being averted, don't you think we should...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Go for a ride!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Nothing beats the wind on your face, especially when—

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: The three of us still don't have a group picture!

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Why are you hiccuping, Sigrika?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We just had some Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks. Want to try?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: No way! Your voice is totally different! Gimme one, I gotta try this!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Oh, that's "awful"!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Wait, that "is" what I meant...? Everything is "the same as" what I want to say... Huh?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's making you say the opposite of what you're trying to say...

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Everything's felt so heavy at the Academy lately. Teachers are stretched thin. Even the nearby Exoswarm seem restless...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lynae, are you nervous?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: ...Eh?! Okay, fine. Is it that obvious?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Look, after I aced the entrance exam, I thought, "Sweet. Life's gonna be packed again. Non-stop." Like it used to be.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: But just when I was ready to finally be a student... my bubble popped. My brilliant student life, "Poof" and done.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: The Threnodian, Voidmatter, the Fractsidus... They're breathing down our necks, and I can't do anything to help you fight them.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: What's your status? I saw you dash straight into the most contaminated area when I passed Bjartr Woods.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: So far, so good. How's it looking on your end?

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: My section is pretty far out. On the bright side, they gave me a permit to ignore all speed limits!

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Catch you on the other side!}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Someone want to tell me what's happening?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You didn't know, Rover? Everyone's saying the board is looking to shut down Rabelle College.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: No, not the college. Just the Synchronists. A professor covering our Royan History class told us the Spacetrek Collective wants them out of the Academy!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yeah, well, the rumor mill says Rabelle eats up two-thirds of the Academy's budget, and the Collective's investors have strong opinions 'bout that.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about you, Chisa? What have you heard?

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: So, Rover! You have a good time here at the Academy with us, yeah?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It was short, but yeah. I'm glad.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If there's one thing I'll take away from my time here, it's all of you.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: But I'm sure I'll find the answer here. I'll let you know once I get there!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Looking forward to it.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: By the way, since you've already been to so many places...

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: That means... you'll end up in the New Federation sooner or later, right?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Yeah, probably.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: If I need to.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I mean, I have been slacking on training to chase credits... but that's not it, is it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It happened to me, too. There's a unique Tacet Discord on the other side of that door. It resisted all standard attacks.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: These aren't normal Tacet Discords. Lynae, can you report this directly to President Lucilla? We need her insight.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: After that, I'll go with you to see Mornye. When you deliver the data, I'll brief her on our guests.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Copy that. I'll grab the data samples first, plus an extra copy for the President!

A Free Lunch?.desc: Amid the lively bustle of the New Solar Celebration, students are busy pairing up for the festivities. Lynae—the very first schoolmate you met here—reaches out with an invitation of her own! Don't miss the chance to share a festive lunch and celebrate the once-in-a-lifetime event together.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So the volunteering job is pretty tough, huh?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Hmm... It's all right, I guess? Mostly it's just helping people with lost belongings. So far we've received over a hundred requests. Ugh, still got no idea where to start for thirty of those...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: ...Plus those twelve equipment malfunctions I fixed for the Department of Engineering. And you know what? Over a dozen glitches on the same little projector. That was a real eye-opener!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: And counting supplies, painting stage props, hauling people who passed out from overworking to the infirmary, patching up the accidental injuries, yada, yada, yada...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Well, it's my first Celebration after being "officially accepted" to the Academy. Of course I have to make it worthwhile!

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: How's it goin'? Enjoying campus life so far?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Not too bad.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Great to hear! Ever give the New Solar Celebration another go?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: It's been very productive.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Well... Wanna make it more exciting?

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Come hang out at the New Solar Celebration when ur free!

I'll Show You the Mech.desc: Lynae finally pins down the mech's signal. It has already left the Academy. Why did the student install unauthorized modifications? Where is the patrol mech heading? And what truth awaits at the end of this pursuit? Head to the Academy's main entrance and meet Lynae.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: That was the first time I realized the danger of the Void Storm, and it really stuck with me. So she was his... his mother.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did he modify the mech because of his lost mother?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Well... maybe he wanted revenge, or maybe... he was just trying to prevent another tragedy like the one that took his mom.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Its core programming prioritizes "protecting human escorts" above everything else, even over securing the survey data.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Now that we've found it, we should…

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Managed to track its signal, but the coordinates are way off from the Academy.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: How did you do that?

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Just tweaked the tracker's frequency range a little.

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: It's running around in a circle now. We gotta get to it before a Void Storm hits.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: You can leave campus grounds now?

phone.speaker: Lynae
phone.text: Did 30 mins of forms for 30 mins of investigation time. The volunteer's green channel!

When the Known Thrums!.desc: An unmistakably "unordinary" emergency request arrives! An unstable prototype patrol mech has vanished without a trace! Concerned for campus safety, Lynae asks you to help track it down. Once again, the merry duo of the Voidworm Knight sets out on a new adventure! Head to the square with Lynae and speak with the student who lost the patrol mech.

lines.speaker: Lynae
