lines.text: So we gotta find it ASAP!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Roger that. What's the rally point?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: The fountain by the square. I'm with the student who needs help.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Be there in a minute.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Perfect! Joint ops with you are always fun!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I'll get some more details from the person first. See you soon.}}

If You Catch Up to It....desc: A new lead emerges. To recover the missing patrol mech, Lynae invites you to investigate the lab together. One unusual trace after another points toward something far from ordinary. Is a real threat waiting ahead? Or just a false alarm? Work with Lynae to uncover the truth.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Hmm... it seems this student secretly modified the patrol mech under the teachers' noses...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...and then it went out of control by accident.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: If the Academy finds out, he's gonna face disciplinary action for sure. Or worse yet, he could get kicked out.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: If he wanted to do this kind of research, he'd definitely get the chance after making it to the Department of Engineering. Why's he in such a hurry...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I thought the same at first. But after digging into his research logs, I found a lot of clever optimizations and impressive designs. He just needs more experience to pull them off...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: If he had some shady motives, why would he even bother with all this...

Where the Iridescent Rain Falls.desc: The emergency has been resolved. After the Celebration, life at the Academy has settled back into its familiar rhythm. As your days find their balance between calm and chaos, Lynae's message pops up on your Terminal as usual. She wants to catch up and fill you in on what happened after the incident. Meet Lynae by the fountain in the square.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Got a moment? The incident's resolved without a hitch.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How's everything?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Hmm... Can we meet?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Maybe a walk? Need some time to talk about it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: (ゝ∀･) Meet me at the square fountain!}}

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: —Hey, Rover! Over here!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lynae? Don't tell me you're skipping class again…

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Don't stereotype me! I'm not playing hooky this time. I've actually got business here.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: See this display? The Academy teamed up with Lollo Logistics to share some vehicle tech for hauling cargo over rough terrain.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Ahem, that's not the point! Anyway, the demo vehicle started acting up during testing, and some of the custom parts weren't ready in time.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: If this keeps up, the Academy's reputation could take a real hit. So, to keep things on track and make sure the partnership goes smoothly…

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lucilla mentioned the Academy approved your request to keep the graffiti.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yep. Totally thought they'd shoot it down. But it sailed right through every system review...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Could that have been... Lucy?)

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Looks like someone gave us a secret helping hand on their way out...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: We'll make sure this special gift is kept safe.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: ...Yeah. Oh, Rover, just between us. On the corner of the tag, Sigrika totally...

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Done. Using Sundermere as the origin, the distribution looks like this.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Everything matches. I'm spotting every Royan rune site in Bjartr Woods on this map.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Returning to work with this "emotional parameter" boost should correlate to higher efficiency. Thank you, Mentor.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: We've had campus-wide events before, but this New Solar Celebration energy is on another level...

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Is it because it's the inaugural event? The students poured everything into this. Their passion is great to see, but a little more caution wouldn't hurt.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Patched up a handful of scrapes and bruises just getting here. Ah, the passionate, painful privilege of youth.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Heh, not at all. Time flies when you're having fun, and this was... memorable.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: I should head back to the infirmary. Enjoy the rest of the celebration, and watch your step.

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: ...My apologies. Did I startle you?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Mr. Mortefi, please pardon our intrusion. We are friends of Baizhi, and we're here to look for her.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I see. I hope I didn't cause any offense earlier.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Not at all, it was us who bothered you...

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Baizhi should be in the Data Analysis Room. I'll go tell her you're here.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Thank you, sir.

Old Man and the Whale (Quest).desc: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: That's why it didn't want to fight her earlier. After teaching her a lesson, maybe she'll know better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Tidebreaker. I... I have something to ask you!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Have you fully recovered?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Of course it is! Look at it live and kicking. It's never been better.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You were tricked and deceived during the Carnevale... I know that an Acolyte like me is in no position to represent the Order...

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wow... are they all Echoes?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Yes. Most newcomers to the city are amazed by the spectacle.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Now we're talking! This is what the Land of Echoes should look like! I thought all of Rinascita's Echoes were like that grumpy poker face we met at the docks...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...Hmm?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Eh... Hi! I'm Abby. Nice to meet ya!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ah! Hello, I'm Phoebe! Nice to meet you, too.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Wait, Brenno's right here. Then who's poking me in the back? Beppe, you better have a good expla—

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: —Not Beppe. It's me. Abby!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Eek!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's enough, Abby.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hic...! Lame. I was just trynna have some fun with her.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, it's you. Pardon me, Rover.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: To meet and part... is a part of life. So please, accept this blessing I offer in my own name: May your eyes always shine bright with clarity, and may love and light guide you on every step of your journey.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: This wide, free world has always been your stage. Wherever you go, I believe you'll always shine as its brightest star.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Inded. The show is still missing a key character! The ceremony can't kick off in grand style without our beloved, ever-devout Acolyte!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I... I see.

lines.speaker: Abbowser
lines.text: Lady Primus?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rest assured, Mr. Abbowser. I'm only leaving for a little while. I'll be back once I've heled them.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'll also pray to the Sentinel that They will watch over every obedient good Cube!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Rover, remember not to overdo it. Eat when you're supposed to, and don't forget... Life is meant to be enjoyed.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: To meet and part... is a part of life. So please, accept this blessing I offer in my own name: May your eyes always shine bright with clarity, and may love and light guide you on every step of your journey.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ms. Zani and I have been assessing the damage to Averardo Vault and the Cathedral of Mercury.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The Vault is all right. As Lady Carlotta instructed, we just had to throw a few collections away.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The losses are nothing compared with the safety of our people.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I think I saw him by the square.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Hard to miss someone from Huanglong in the crowd.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I also noticed quite a few friends from Septimont there discussing the rebuilding. Maybe you could ask if anyone's seen him.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: Zani and Phoebe stay behind to watch over Gilberto until the Montelli members arrive.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I thought you were at Ragunna City. Didn't expect to meet you here. Oh, uhh... Sorry, I don't think we've met.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Greetings, madam. My name is Zani. Averardo Bank.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I don't think we've met before.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Well... It's probably because I haven't been to church much... Ahem. Please don't stare at me like that. There are more pressing matters.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: We're investigating the Echo incident from the Carnevale rehearsal at Whisperwind Haven, as requested by the Montelli family. One of our clues led us here.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: The Echo incident... Yes, I've also heard of it. I even heard you were caught right in the middle of it, Rover.

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Striking with an appropriate level of force clears the mind, enhancing one's purification.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Well, well... since when did our Acolyte start cracking jokes? Looks like Rover's humor is rubbing off on you.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Uh... I wasn't joking.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...Could you leave a good review in the survey, please?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Working.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: A bit rough.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Are you all right, Ms. Zani? This is too much! Mr. Abbowser promised me he would treat his employees better!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: It's alright. I asked for this.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: But if you wish to try again, I remain at your service.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Tell me, how much of It remains within you?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Not much, but enough to make use of.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: ... I've fulfilled my promise to complete your finale. Let this be the last note of our symphony.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: As you wish. My sincerest gratitude for your wonderful performance, Lady Phrolova. May you find the strength to create the Beyond you once envisioned.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: I discovered that a small piece of the Threnodian's essence within Mya was reawakened with the tower's resurgence into our world.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Sounds as though you've found new inspiration.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Yes, Septimont will host the Great Agon soon. I've come up with a rather intriguing idea.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Before her death, Mya also attended the tournament. I'll use that as the fictitious anchor to craft a play to rewrite reality itself.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: I've already discussed terms with It and reached a modest agreement.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: ...You spoke with the Threnodian? Has Leviathan already awakened?

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: I think you should leave your secluded mansion. Take a walk and listen to the voices scattered across the world.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: ...Perhaps.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: From Huanglong to Rinascita, has indeed added a few unexpectedly beautiful notes to my symphony.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: I am certain that, even without any direction, will walk the path that destiny has laid before .

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: All things ascend towards a singular point of convergence, and what awaits at the end is... immortality.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Before the tides of fate, we are all but...

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: Phrolova ends up falling into the nearby water while Cristoforo, with the help of Scar's abilities, takes the Gem and escapes.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Manipulating reality behind her back, reviving the Threnodian's lingering power within her through the progression of a tale... That's now nearly impossible.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Ah, but at the very least, we have affirmed her resilience and stability after the merging. That alone offers invaluable insight into our research sample.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: If we allow the story to unfold, we may have the chance to further destabilize Cartethyia and mold her into the Threnodian.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Do you not hear Rover on our heels? And you're willing to gamble everything on a mere "chance" to deliver what the Grand Architect desires?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Heh, so eager to witness the Beyond's completion at the seabed.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Why not nudge Septimont's plot just a little? Use your original plan to mask our true purpose.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: We carry the Dark Tide's memories.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: We command both light and shadow.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Did you really think you could stand against us alone?

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: In Phrolova's third flashback, you see her and Scar in Jinzhou, standing before a hatching Ovathrax. Phrolova ends up falling into the nearby water while Cristoforo, with the help of Scar's abilities, takes the Gem and escapes.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: It's only a matter of time before its eyes open.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Oh? So, 's made her move.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: No wonder...

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: 's in Gorges of Spirits. Care to witness it firsthand?

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: No need. For now, has nothing to offer me.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: I will remain here and listen to what the "people" have to say.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: This play shall be torn from its author's hands!

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: A wrong note in the shifting score.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: O Golden Star, full of mercy,

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Pray, tell me.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: As past and present intertwine,

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: What fate,

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Muyu... he's probably hiding in that one.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: The assault grows fiercer by the moment. My sword formations will not hold long. We must end this quickly.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: If you can find the one pulling the strings... go. Strike the root of this evil.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Ovathrax...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Only a small group could come, but they're elite Rangers. They will make a difference.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: We can manage the Tacet Discords within the Hold. It's just... some strange mechanism parts have appeared nearby. Look—

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: It's like they spilled over from somewhere else into the Hold. The Ministry's Artisans examined them, and so far, they don't pose any danger.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: I will complete the Sanctum investigation quickly. Once the situation is clear, I shall return at once.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: In an epic play such as this, I refuse an early exit.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: My orders were to bring you back. Dead or alive.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: ...Death.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I accepted this long ago.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You've already been touched by the Dark Tide. Even the Sentinel's power cannot reverse it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's why we're not arguing over who goes in first. Anyone else would just suffer longer.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You've been resisting the Threnodian's corruption this whole time, suppressing your Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface. Everything you said was just to hide the truth. Deliberately.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You're prepared to walk into death alone.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You have come.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Leaving so soon?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: I've lingered long enough. My work isn't done.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Scar and the other Fractsidus operatives got away...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Our Grand Marshal likely expected as much. They always have a way out.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Pity. Would have liked to see if I could sever that goat head in one strike.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Picked the color scheme myself. Preem, right? Totally screams my style.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: For sure, it's got your vibe all over it!

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Hehe, keep the compliments rollin'!

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Speaking of, your piece is killer, too... Lemme see?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Sure! Here you go.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Whoa, sick... Adorable AND tuned to perfection...?

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It will take a while to study your weapon, Ms. Rebecca. Do you have something to do in the meantime?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: You can stop callin' me "Ms. Rebecca." Ain't my vibe, like, at all. Just Rebecca's fine.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: ...I see. Then what do you plan to do now, Rebecca?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: I'll be bored outta my gourd just sittin' here. Think I'll take a stroll 'round the Academy.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Yeah, I can run this spray can back to Lynae. And hey, shootin' the sh*t with Sigrika over some video games sounds pretty chill.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Ah... I didn't realize you were already acquainted with Sigrika.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: We were able to reach a compromise. I agreed to give her access to the Academy's database while she receives care.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Tch. That gonk ain't the patient type. Her and David, both.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Whatever. So long as she's in one piece. Gonna go suck some fresh air, holler if ya need me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Something else on your mind?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: She's vulnerable to external frequency interference. That unique Tacet Discord you mentioned seems to be targeting that weakness. Pouring salt in the wound.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Runes? Sounds like a fantasy sim to me... 'Sides, they all look the friggin' same. Can't tell 'em apart!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hmm... What if you tried imagining them as stars?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Pass. Don't wanna fry my circuits with that stuff.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Mercwork suits me better than classwork!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: That's a special-looking gun... Is it yours?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Yep, custom job. Don't feel right walkin' around 'thout iron in my pocket.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Lemme be clear. If you're here to drag me back for an exam, I'll delta so fast you'll get whiplash.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Relax. I'm here to give you this.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: What's this weird doodad?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Dr. Herssen helped you apply for a Terminal. Now I can ping your location and contact you whenever.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Oh, nice. Thanks, choom.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I just got a message from Lucy. She needs more time digging through the archives. Says to wait.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Not bad, you little turd. You're growin' on me!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hehe, just helping out Rover. Someone's gotta.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: But you've never heard of an Echo? What about a Tacet Discord? Do you know what those are?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Nope... Ring any bells, Lucy?

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: If I had access to the Net, might be able to dig up something...

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: Yeah, no Net access is weird, I'll give ya that. But another world? C'mon. Am I right, Rover?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Echoes of Rinascita can sense human frequencies. When we reach out in hope, they answer us with hope.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: But even with their help and the potion, we're still far from our goal... We fought through the illusions, but we still need an Anchor to open a path to the Journeying Paradise.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: She intends to use those Lycorises to summon and control the Tacet Discords. If we destroy the Lycorises, we can neutralize them.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Everyone is in position. We'll manage the west plaza.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Phoebe is stationed at the east plaza, keeping an eye on things.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The main stage is all yours for the grand performance.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: I'll take care of the lighting and create the mood to make the performance stand out.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: This will not do. This will not do at all. You need to eat more, darling. How else am I supposed to enjoy hugging you?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Sister, please! I'm not a child anymore. And I've been eating perfectly fine...

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Oh? Since when has my little Yangyang been so shy?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Sui—sui—

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Mm... All these years, and you don't hang on to me anymore. I find that rather crushing...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: That is not how it was! You were the one who dragged me everywhere. I missed so many of my vocal lessons...

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Sister?

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: I ran into Rover back in the city. told me I could find you here, so here I am!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I see. I'm waiting for my Spectrum Test results.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: You know, when you came back with Rover, you looked so different it actually gave me a bit of a fright...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Haha... I'm not quite sure how it happened either. By the time I came to, the change had already happened.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: But I'm still me. You don't need to worry.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Take care of Yangyang. If you let her get lost... you'll have to answer to me.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Sister... I can hear you, you know...

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Well then, let's say goodbye now. One of these days, I'll give you both a proper tour of Mengzhou!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: That qin music... I think I've heard it before.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: What seems to be the trouble? If there's anything I can help you with...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: We're looking for a special flower...

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: Hmm... It's an unusual flower indeed. Pure black flowers are rarely found in nature. We can't rule out the possibility that it's been dyed.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: When looking at the structure, there are a few types of flowers that seem similar.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: Take Iris, for example. Its petals are similarly oval-shaped, but it has double petals.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: It's not Viola, either, since Viola has notched petals.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: Come on, Verina, you can do it...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: No way? That's amazing, seriously! It looks exactly like the flower in that picture!

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: T-thank you, it's nothing... I'm glad I could help.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: It's friggin amazing! Could you do that again? Please! I love it!

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Rover, did you see that?

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Now it's almost identical to what we saw three years ago, during the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: I'm afraid... We're already running out of time.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Report the situation, please.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Madam Magistrate, the barrier has been fully repaired and we have evacuated all residents. We've successfully minimized the damage.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yinlin!

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Rover, you came because you were worried about me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's take them down together.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Hehe, no rush. They'll be leaving soon.

Solitary Path.desc: During the conversation, you discover that the woman is actually a Patroller named Yinlin. Yinlin is on the trail of those responsible and invites you to meet her outside the city if you want to learn more about the case.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Acknowledged... Is that our only option...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Yinlin seems to be on a call with someone.)

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: But... I believe it's unnecessary...

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Yes... Understood... I'll have it taken care of.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Yes... It's my contact from the PSB.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: They'll be sending people over soon. We can leave Lirong and Yuanyuan in their care.

Operation: Lunar Duo.desc: Enforce justice and cleanse the crimes lurking in the shadow before the Moon-Chasing Festival is around, now! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The person you're after... Is he an Exile?

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Exactly. Exiles aren't allowed in Jinzhou. To sneak in, he disguised himself and didn't wear the Exiles' uniform.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: His name is Lei. He used to involve in petty crimes and just got out of prison a few days ago.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Used to be my informant before I became an undercover agent myself, but he fled at a critical moment.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Something feels off about him being here... It seems he's talking to someone. Let's find out what he's up to.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: It's been a long time, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Are you in the middle of some urgent mission?

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Mission? Not at all. But sure, proper code words and disguises are essential for an undercover agent. Especially at a party with such a mixed crowd.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Heh, relax. I've already scoped the area. No one's listening in on us.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Besides, like I said, I'm not here on assignment. I'm simply "Yinlin," on vacation.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: It's a long story. Remember Yangyang, the Outrider? She told me about what you went through after Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Rover. We really have to stop "running into" each other like this.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I've got about a hundred questions. But first... It's been a minute, Yinlin.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Sure has. Gotta say, after everything that went down at Xuanfang Hold, I can guess your questions well enough.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: I'll give you a straight answer. Just one, though.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Heh. That's a sly one. All right, then.

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Ciao, Zani! Knocking off early today, huh?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Not really... still on duty.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Is that so? You seem alright, considering. So, what will it be today? The "Adios, Workdays" or the "Thank Goodness It's the Holiday" platter?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...The last one. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: And this here... A visitor from afar? It's a pleasure.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: I see. You certainly have the air of someone who matters.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The Echo ships are still undergoing repairs. The family's shipyard is also operating beyond capacity and cannot free up berths for new ships anytime soon...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Perhaps the lower decks of Porto-Veno Castle could alleviate this issue.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I have heard the Fisalias first secured their standing through deep-sea fishing...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Well then, Lady Cantatrella. What are your terms...?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms... naturally, there are some.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: But even with their help and the potion, we're still far from our goal... We fought through the illusions, but we still need an Anchor to open a path to the Journeying Paradise.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: I have an idea! If Leviathan found Its Anchor of Reality to summon the Tidespawn into our world...

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Strange... I clearly sensed the Dark Tide's presence around here. So why does everything seem normal?)

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Gunfire. We've got intruders.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (But at the same time...)

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Lady Carlotta, we've finished tallying all our losses. Here's the full report for your review.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: They are all mad... So this is what they've been planning all along.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We have to do something.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: You two go ahead. I'll stay here and watch him until the family arrives, just in case he gets any bright ideas.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'll stay with you. After all, this could provoke outcry from the Fisalia family. If I testify about Gilberto's misdeeds on behalf of the Order, they can't deny the facts or exploit the situation.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I agree. But what about you, Rover...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: All right. There's a port nearby where you can catch a Gondola. It can take you close to the Atrium of Reflections.

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Ahem. Sorry, too much. I'll do my best to meet your needs during your stay here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't worry about me, I can handle myself without involving the Montellis. I'm not one for formalities, so let's keep it relaxed.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...If that's what you want.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Thank you, Rover. All that formality was starting to feel like exercise.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Let's go get something to eat, shall we?

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Now, try the Nectarwine from Egla Town. It's aged in oak barrels from the Fagaceae Peninsula, known as the "Harvest Spirit" or "Gocce di Divino" for its exceptional flavor.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So this is the Gocce di Divino.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: To you, guests from afar...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...and my vacation that never seems to come.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: So here I am, working part-time… on my vacation. Tch. Guess that's how it goes when you're too damn good at what you do.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So, I take it things in the Black Alley are wrapped up?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Yeah. The Chamber of Discipline and the Family took down Talos and everyone colluding with her.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Turns out, the folks in the Black Alley were just stuck in the mess. Those who weren't too deep in it, like Colleen, were pardoned.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I helped them apply for the Family's support fund and set some stalls up here. Should give them a shot at starting fresh.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Ahem. Don't worry. If I can find a decent sofa and sit for a while, I'll be fine.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Rough day at work?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Not really. Technically, I'm on vacation.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Ragunna's been quiet, so Lady Carlotta's promise of paid leave finally came through. I'm just here to breathe a little.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: It's true, I swear by this year's bonus. No work piling up, no sudden comms dragging me back to the Vault.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Haha, it's hard to believe, I know. How should I put it…

The One that Impresses.desc: Zani politely declines Carlotta's offer to help pay off her debt and promises to assist you after work every day.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: ...Could you leave a good review in the survey, please?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Working.

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Let's go check it out!

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: P-please, I'm not photogenic...

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Scar, you are now under arrest for committing multiple felonies in Huanglong. Do you have anything to say?

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: What do I want to say, huh? While I'd love to tell you another story... I guess that's not what you want to hear.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Let's cut to the chase, "Madam Magistrate". I'm getting bored already.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Very well. You will answer only our questions from now on.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: A Sentinel such as Jué can predict and "correct" future events. It gets in our way of achieving our sublime vision.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: What is the truth you've uncovered?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock found out the truth but chose to be his accomplices, and they willingly offered the black lamb as another sacrifice.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Hahaha, that's right!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. They were deceived into believing the black lamb was the culprit.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Almost there, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. Someone came to their rescue, and they all made it out alive.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Til we meet again, dear friends.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're not going anywhere!

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Rover, care for a wager? I know you've been searching for answers about your past, and I've got news for you—

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Watch out!

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: You are one of us, the "black lambs", and you have been chosen to join us ushering in the new world...

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Once you discover what you really are, you will come to us with no hesitation.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: The Fractsidus awaits your arrival with open arms.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: And I look forward to that day in sincere anticipation...

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: This wave of TD attacks should be over now.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: We knew this was coming and we were ready, but oh boy, the amount of TDs is insane.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Thanks for coming in time, Rover. It would've taken us much longer to handle this.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Oh, Director Taoqi is here too. For a better run down of the situation, you can find her near the city gate!

To Mt. Firmament.desc: In the pouring rain, you encounter Changli, the Wayfinder, at the ferry. Changli speculates that your dreams might be a glimpse into your past and a light guiding you into the future.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Weren't they concerned about losing lifespan?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: For those fanatics, nothing mattered more than the truth.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: To live every moment with overwhelming passion... How many can claim such a tenacious drive and unshakable determination?

Truthseeker's Pass (Quest).desc: According to Xinyi, Hongzhen's Mayor, Jinhsi has gone off to Truthseeker's Pass, or the Court of Savantae Ruins. The Cipher Key stored in the heart of Truthseeker's Pass is a precondition to opening Mianloong Chamber and the audience with Jué, the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: "With one of the Temporal Programs lost"... It no longer had the power to restore time, instead it could only stop and rewind it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So the Sentinel protected Hongzhen with its power, but it couldn't return things back to normal?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It would seem so...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: According to their theories, the Sentinel's injury would worsen over time. And if the Sentinel perishes... the Temporal Disruptions will spiral out of control, engulfing all of Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: So the Fractsidus just added a pinch of salt to the already gaping wounds on Mt. Firmament...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: There is nothing we can do. At least that's what it says on these records.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How did you know they killed Jing?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: No child would go in thin pajamas in such freezing conditions.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So you realized it was orchestrated by the Fractsidus...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You know this is a dream, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Then why didn't you try to escape?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: To win a game, you must first play it.

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Oh? And what makes you think so?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Those tokens from Jinhsi... It was your idea, was it not?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: *chuckle *...So you've guessed it.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Sorry, Rover. Jinzhou faced multiple threats back then, and we had to be cautious. We did not intend to inconvenience you. I regret our lack of hospitality.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Still, I owe you an apology in person.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: This time... *chuckle* I just wanted to see you. The brilliant mind that always understood my unspoken words.

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I wasn't really there for you. Not in the real past. If there isn't a Secret to Immortality, what about you...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: The incorporation of so many nostalgic elements makes me wonder who the director is.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well, you have a good eye for detail.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It doesn't really matter anyway. What matters is the joy of people he wished to see with this play. Don't you agree?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about Changli...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Worry not. It doesn't affect my moves. I just need to maintain a safe distance from you.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: At least... for now.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Should you call for our strength, we'll be there for you at any time.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (In the south....)

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: They are unharmed. Please rest assured.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: As you anticipated, Scar did not try to kill them... Yes, I stayed out of it like you asked.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Is everything alright on your end?

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: ...Please be sure to stay safe, My Lady.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: I'm afraid... I cannot grant your request.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's been a while, Sanhua.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Rover!? You... you've returned?
(And who might you be?)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can you take me to Jinhsi?

A Brief Respite.desc: Jinhsi entrusts you with a letter to Sanhua. What could it possibly be about? Unlock a new Companion after completing thing quest.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Oh, here you are, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: No, I'm here for work today. Madam Jinhsi entrusted me with this letter for you.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: As you're involved with the Moonlit Fair, she may have something important to discuss with you.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Have you finished reading it, Rover? Do you have any messages you would like me to convey?

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Indeed, I have many affairs to attend to, but I think Madam Magistrate was exaggerating.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: It was you who made this gathering possible, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm also surprised to see you acting as Asura in the play.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: The lead actor had an unexpected issue, so I had to fill in with only a little time to rehearse. Fortunately, I managed to get most of the lines correct.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That dance of blessings was impressive.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Glad you liked it. I wonder what our guests from Rinascita think about the play.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: The play is over, but not the festivaL Why not enjoy the festive moments with others?

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It seems there may be hidden dangers lurking in Jinzhou...)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If it were you, Yangyang, what would you do to make sure the recipient gets what you mean?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...I would emphasize my true message by repeating it, again and again.

Echoing Marche.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I was worried... You just stood there and gazed into the distance. You were unresponsive when I tried talking to you. What did you see?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a Qingloong... The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: The front lines are not far from here. General Jiyan must be there, fighting alongside our soldiers to keep the Tacet Discords away.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: It doesn't seem like a coincidence. We arrived near the battlefield right when General Jiyan was leading an attack against the Tacet Discords...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: A woman in red who can control the Tacet Discord...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: The Fractsidus is likely behind it all.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Fractsidus?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes. I don't know much about the Fractsidus, but as an Outrider, I've worked on related cases.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: It's a group of extremists obsessed with fusing humans with Tacet Discords. They've caused terror attacks of various scales around the world.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Fusing humans and Tacet Discords...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: We've seen signs of their presence in Jinzhou, left by lower-ranked members called "Artificers".

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (But that also means...)

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: But that also means...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: In countless tomorrows lie countless possibilities...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Where our paths intertwine.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hello—! Yangyang! You comin' or what?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes, I'm coming.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: If it is, it's far too...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hey, relax. Feel that? I'm right here.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes... You're just much earlier than I expected.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And yet, much later than I'd hoped.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I'm sorry. I couldn't stop him.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: No, we couldn't stop him.

The Chant of Unseen Ties.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yangyang, Huaxu Institute is asking for you.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes, I know. I received their message as well...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Rover, I should go. It's only a routine Spectrum Test. Shouldn't take long.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...How have you been feeling the last few days?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Well, nothing out of the ordinary... I'm still trying to get the hang of this new Forte.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I can undo altered frequencies and restore them... But which frequencies it works on, and how much I can actually undo... that, I still don't know.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: That's good. We don't know what awaits in the Sanctum, so conserve your strength.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is everything all right here?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: The surrounding defenses are complete. Many civilians volunteered to help. And another wave of reinforcements from Jinzhou just arrived.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Ovathrax...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Only a small group could come, but they're elite Rangers. They will make a difference.

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: Rover, are you free right now?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What's going on? Did something happen?

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: My sister...

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: She's about to go back to Mengzhou City!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Where is Suisui now? She hasn't left yet, has she?

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: She's with me... We're almost at the checkpoint to leave the Land of Xuanfang.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: If my messages get through, send something back. A line or two is enough.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yangyang, your messages came through.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Things inside the Sanctum are complicated. There's a lot going on below the surface. But don't worry, I'm doing fine.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Once I've handled things in here, I'll be back.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Mm...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I see.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (And Promeus. Why would a Sentinel be mentioned in something like this? Could It be connected to the war Jedediah spoke of?)

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Well then, Rover... until the Black Shores takes over, I'll keep an eye on him for you.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: You were thinking about Promeus and the Resonator War, weren't you? I can tell something about it is bothering you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah. From what I know of the Somnoire, things that happen there can't just be brushed off as dreams.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I have things handled here. You should go ahead and look into it.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I'm glad to help. But remember, you're just one person. Please be careful, and contact me if you run into anything unexpected.

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: But actually... I don't think I'll be staying in Jinzhou for long either.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Yangyang, what are you thinking...

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: Lately, the Streams have been bringing me more and more voices. I can feel them... urging me to do something.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: So where will you go next?

phone.speaker: Yangyang
phone.text: Funny enough, it is a place I know well.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Let me guess. Mingting?

Silence of the Guilty.desc: The matter of Muyu has come to a temporary close, but the crisis of the rogue Autopuppets is far from over...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I didn't realize being a Xuan Watcher meant carrying this much weight… I should help her shoulder some of it.)

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Rover? No… You've already exhausted yourself protecting this Hold. Please, rest a bit. I'd feel better that way.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Don't worry. I can manage the work on my own.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yangyang, you've done more than enough already. I'm fine, and Xuanfang Hold is short-handed right now. Let me share the load.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Alright... Thank you, Rover. With you here, I do feel a little more at ease. Speaking of which, there is something that might be just right for you.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Mr. Huihuan from the Ministry of Development reported that Muyu, under the alias "Shenyuan," had been working inside the Ministry for years. In case he tampered with other Autopuppets as well, Huihuan has already isolated and contained a large number of suspicious units.

Riddle and Reunion.desc: Riddle Twiddle is offering a limited special prize! Join Yangyang and try to win it! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Done! The answer is... 5 rabbits and 9 chickens!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (First, suppose that all of them are chickens, then calculate the difference in the number of legs, getting the amount of rabbits... I see.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There are 5 rabbits and 9 chickens.

lines.speaker: Xieyang
lines.text: Correct! You figured it out even faster than Mr. Bosong. I'm impressed.

lines.speaker: Xieyang
lines.text: For the last riddle, how about we change things up a bit? You two can pick one from any of the lanterns.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Umm... I don't really see any riddles...

Utterance of Marvels: I.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: This is... a holographic message to all of Jinzhou from the City Hall.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: My fellow soldiers and citizens, I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: As the Moon-chasing Festival approaches, our city welcomes visitors from around the world. The festivities are highly anticipated by our people, and I, too, share in this joyful sentiment.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks, safeguarding Huanglong. We have a heavy responsibility on our shoulders with no room for retreat or failure.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: It is the dedication of our warriors, along with the diligence of our citizens, that has allowed us to thrive in peace and prosperity.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Despite the challenges of Tacet Discord, we remain steadfast and hospitable to visitors, upholding our enduring traditions.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: And the Retroact Rain falling... Rover, maybe this is "the right time" Madam Magistrate was talking about?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...If it means I can help everyone, then yes.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Then it is settled. I will speak with General Jiyan and arrange for your temporary transfer to the Xuanfang Ministry of War.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Rover, I trust you to look after Yangyang on behalf of us here in Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes. And when that time comes, we'll bring everyone together for a celebration.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: A wonderful idea. We'll be waiting for you to come home.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Ah, it's you...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I shattered Scar's illusion. That should've injured him.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Hehe, should I thank you for showing me mercy?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Stay away from him/her!

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Ugh. Didn't you promise to leave me some alone time with Rover?

Echoing Marche.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: It's so busy here... Looks like they don't even have the time to catch their breath.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Supplies, medical care, equipment maintenance, personnel management, and logistics ... They must carefully manage these matters to provide vital support for our fighters.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: So this is what a real war looks like. I had no idea it could get this bad.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Most people would never have the chance to witness any of this. It's natural for you not to know.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I think this is exactly what our military strives for—to ensure peace and safety for our citizens. It's a sacrifice made so others don't have to live in fear.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: Greetings, General.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Master Jianxin? Didn't know I'd be seeing you here...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: General, you flatter me.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: Master once told me life and death should follow a natural course. The heavens and earth form a vast chamber, where spirits freely depart and return.

Echoing Marche.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men,and abandons none."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Watch out!

Professional Inheritance.desc: Uncle Dong has found a treasure left by an ancient person. This could prove to be a must-see of his stall, "Thus Says the Moon". Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: There are so many stores on the commercial street... I guess we have to search them one by one.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall", we can probably cross out large stores from our list.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: Good point. We should focus on the small vendor stalls, right?

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: General, you flatter me.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: Master once told me life and death should follow a natural course. The heavens and earth form a vast chamber, where spirits freely depart and return.

lines.speaker: Jianxin
lines.text: Countless brave souls have been trapped here by the evil powers of Ovathrax. I want to help set them free.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Please follow me.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Where should we deploy the ranged units?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Our main battlefield will be at the valley's bottom, where space and vision are limited.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Placing ranged units behind infantry can slow their aim, making it counterproductive... This may not be the best strategy.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Mixing ranged and infantry units may seem versatile, but it wastes the advantage of ranged units... This may not be the best strategy.)

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Deploying our ranged units high above the valleys in advance...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: This way, they'll provide cover for our close-combat forces while staying safe themselves. We'll use their range advantage to the fullest. It's a smart move.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The fallen soldiers... They must have held on to those memories dearly. That's how they resisted merging with the Tacet Discords...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Yes... They have been silently fighting for us all these years, or we would've faced a TD Outbreak...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Yes... We fought together.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: They probably didn't want it to happen again. All those deaths and losses...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: ...And so they called out to us for help.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Evaluating the Genesis Nexus for potential adoption is also part of my duty.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So strictly speaking, this is a work trip?

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Correct. Our itinerary included this place, in part to establish new ties with Lollo Logistics.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Come to think of it, as long as I've known you, you've barely left the border.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Oh, except that one time in Taoyuan Vale for the Riverside Games.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: The situation back then was volatile with the Threnodian's resurgence. Remaining at the border to safeguard the city was my responsibility.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about Changli...

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: The Threnodian's current state looks to be more complicated than we assumed. Contact Huaxu Academy. Send them this round of data.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: General Jiyan speaks true.

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: Rover? ...That'll be all. Go on ahead, all of you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds like the Threnodian has retreated back into its corner?

lines.speaker: Jiyan
lines.text: It has. While this disturbance did not herald disaster, Overthrax stirring in response to Xuanfang's instability sits heavy with me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: No amount of caution is too much where a Threnodian is concerned. If there's any sign of danger, send for me immediately.

First Resonance.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Rover! Can you...¥%Hear...#¥%... &*

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The comm line is dead... Something's wrong. Gotta be cautious.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Now, where is the exit...

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Rover, you have arrived.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Baizhi, how's Chixia...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: She's right here. Still undergoing treatment.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Yang... Yang...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: We should step outside. She needs rest.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: ...Done? Good, back to bed.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds like quite the scene over there.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Well, you heard her. No need to worry about Chixia. A few more days, and she'll be bouncing around like nothing happened.

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: Yangyang, Rover, I don't know what you've faced in Xuanfang Hold these past few days...

lines.speaker: Baizhi
lines.text: But knowing that you are both safe is more than enough.

Unsettled Aftermath (I).desc: Mortefi has contacted you. He seems to be quite interested in Autopuppets and wants to speak in person with someone who has had direct contact with them...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Any idea of what might've happened, Mortefi? Should we check the last location first?

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: That won't be necessary, the Ministry of Development will prioritize their search in that area. Repeating the search will have little gain.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I have a theory...

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Follow me. Let's pay a visit to the Hundred-Span Corridor.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There!

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Just as I suspected...

phone.speaker: Mortefi
phone.text: Baizhi mentioned you came into contact with a substantial amount of Autopuppets in Xuanfang Hold. I'd like to hear about them. The more detail, the better.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: This'll take a while...

phone.speaker: Mortefi
phone.text: It appears to be a significant amount of information. Going back and forth over WavesLine would only waste time... You'll be staying long at Xuanfang Hold, I presume?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Well, let me get everything sorted out first.

phone.speaker: Mortefi
phone.text: This will take too long. You'll be staying long at Xuanfang Hold, I presume?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Huh? Me? I mean, as far as principles go... I don't know much about them either.

Unsettled Aftermath (III).desc: Mortefi seems to have received clearance to handle actual Autopuppets. One wonders whether the research on Autopuppets has made any new progress...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Any update on the application, Mortefi? The one about the rogue Autopuppet data...

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I'm currently in Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: Zhuo Shanyue's application was approved.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: I obtained some internal materials and was granted access to the Autopuppet specimens.

lines.speaker: Mortefi
lines.text: With the restriction being that the specimens must remain within Xuanfang Hold grounds. But this will suffice for the current stage of my research.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mind if I join you?

Shadow of Glory.desc: In your dreams, you see Phrolova floating in the air with pages swirling around her. Phrolova tells you that Lupa will be the one to trigger the Dark Tide's surge in Septimont, and it will happen within three days.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: As of now, you and that Blessed Maiden from the tower are deeply interwoven in the fate he has spun.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So you're not the only Overseer active in Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Scar, your nameless ally, and you... The Fractsidus seems to revel in the company of those with twisted obsessions.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: It's not as you imagine. You've already met my associate, you see. He trusts what he sees, not the words of others.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I've already crossed paths with him since arriving in Rinascita…?)

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: As a creator, he always hopes his characters will craft twists and turns that he himself cannot foresee.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty.
