At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Have you chosen?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hesitate not, warrior.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You are the protagonist I have chosen.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Only you can shatter the script.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And jump to the next page.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Write.

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: You find yourself in a strange place beneath the sea, realizing it was Phrolova who had saved you. With Phrolova injured and your surroundings unknown, cooperation seems to be the best option for both of you.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Keep your eyes sharp. The mist is another trap they've set for us.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So let's avoid it. Which way is faster?

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: The left one.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Still in doubt?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The right one seems closer and safer.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Is that why you've returned? How unexpected.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'd also like to know whether listening to past melodies allows me to hear realms that I once went through.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: You wish to listen to past stories? Ah... It seems I have an audience for the songs I've collected throughout history.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Go ahead. Every song kept in this room is at your disposal. There's a seat by the window.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: The people here are of no used to you. Don't try anything. I will protect this place.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Heh, an empty and graceless threat. After all, you are not one to harm commoners.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Is that why you've returned? How unexpected.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'd also like to know whether listening to past melodies allows me to hear realms that I once went through.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: You wish to listen to past stories? Ah... It seems I have an audience for the songs I've collected throughout history.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Go ahead. Every song kept in this room is at your disposal. There's a seat by the window.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: The people here are of no use to you. Don't try anything. I will protect this place.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Heh, an empty and graceless threat. After all, you are not one to harm commoners.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: It's our defense system against the Retroact Rain. It does a good job of keeping the city safe from the rain's effects.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: What's more, the current TD Outbreak we're dealing with is directly caused by the Retroact Rain.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Once the protective barrier breaks down, Tacet Discords could manifest from inside Jinzhou city...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Rover, remember what I told you earlier?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: The Retroact Rain is essentially condensed droplets of Remnant Energy that fall from the Etheric Sea.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: This Remnant Energy makes it a magnet for Tacet Discords.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Please stay safe...

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: That's all we've gathered so far, Rover.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: The TD Outbreaks won't stop before the end of this rain. We must stay alert.

lines.speaker: Staff from Ministry of Development
lines.text: Ma'am! There's another wave of them ahead!

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Sigh. Speak of the devil...

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: I'll NEED to take a very long nap after this.

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: Hehe, as you can see. Everyone's ready to defend our city.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Rover, Yangyang, safe travels!

lines.speaker: Taoqi
lines.text: I've informed General Jiyan that you're heading to his place. He will be meeting up with you soon.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: May victory prevail the lasting night!

Grand Warstorm.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

lines.speaker: Verina
lines.text: Me... Me too!

lines.speaker: Lingyang
lines.text: Don't forget us Liondance Troupe!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How's everything going?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Good news and bad.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: The Threnodian's Gem has been successfully contained. Tethys is already running a full-power analysis as we speak.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: However... the Gem we've recovered was incomplete.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: We're still investigating the cause. But look, successfully containing a Gem infused with the Threnodian's power? No small feat. It's already a huge step forward in our fight against the Threnodian and the Lament.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: If the Threnodian is truly bound to civilization, who's to say another one won't return to Rinascita in some new form...

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Meanwhile, the Executive Committee moderates have promised to stay out of it, as long as their nation's Synchronists are covered. With either guaranteed support back home or a smooth transfer somewhere else.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where does Lucilla stand?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: She wants to continue the Synchronist Program.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Continue?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Yep. Confusing, isn't it? Speaking of which... how well do you know her, Rover?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Hm. I see.

phone.speaker: Aalto
phone.text: Be at the square by 8. The one we passed earlier. Got some intel to share.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: OK.

phone.speaker: Aalto
phone.text: Any recs on what to order? Lucilla went back to her office to take care of something.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Just order everything on the menu.

phone.speaker: Aalto
phone.text: Gotcha!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Get the cheap ones so you can toss them without feeling guilty.

Rewinding Raindrops.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Don't worry! Encore's had plenty of that mushroom already!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: But why did you go to such a dangerous place alone, little Encore?

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: We've got your back, little one! No worries! Just tell us what you know!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Because... Because Encore must keep an eye on him/her!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Ahahaha... Kids can have such wild imaginations sometimes, haha...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Hey, Aalto? Didn't you send Encore there? Wait... Why are they all giving you the side eye?

Small Wooly, Big Adventures.desc: Soon, you cross paths with Encore, who is searching for the legendary Gateway of Wishes. After Ying leaves, Encore reveals to you the true origin of the Wooly Adventure Squad story—it was a cherished gift from her own mother.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where am I...?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Hey, hey! Over here!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Is that Encore? I should go check it out.)

Encore's Steaming Adventure!.desc: Xisha asks you to make him the legendary fireworks. Seems like an easy job... maybe? Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: So we just set it on the ground, light it here... and ta-da! It's a fireworks show!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Something's not right... Encore, throw that thing away!

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Aha! I knew you'd join my team!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Of course! So, where is that thing you mentioned?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Oh, no rush. Before that, do you know someone's celebrating their very first anniversary today?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: It's Second Coming of Solaris! Happy first anniversary of the beta test!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I remember it was developed by the Pioneer Association. What makes you part of this?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: It's an assigment Miss Shorekeeper gave me. During vacation, Encore needs to help Tethys prepare a special surprise in the game world!

A New Companion.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: W-what's going on? I... I'll try again! Just you see!

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Uh... What? Did something happen?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: J-Just a little slip, that's all! I can do it! You gotta trust me!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Back then, I just stood in front of , and that big bad Threnodian monster thing just... just... left.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: So... you didn't really do anything?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh? No, I... I definitely did something!

Moonlit Reunion.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: There, you're the last one left, Rover. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yawn... Who's there...? What's going on...?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Make... A wish...? I'm tired... Just make one for me...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I want... lots of goodies to eat... I don't ever want to be hungry again...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Phew... Huff...

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Well, what did Abby say?

A New Companion.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I'll make it clear. I am to stay with Rover.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I agree. Abby cannot leave Rover's side, but we can't just trap here for research.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Where did you absorb Abby, what are Abby's powers, and what exactly happened between you two... There are so many questions we can't figure out yet.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Now that the Threnodian crisis is over, perhaps you can consult our Magistrate and our Sentinel again. I’m sure they can offer you some more useful guidance.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Relax, relax! You have me now, remember? Meeting up with that Jinhsi person? Getting your memories back? I've got you!

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Looky that!

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: This word puzzle... Is the answer "Friend", maybe?

Rust, Sword and the Sun.desc: While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh... that reminds me, aren't we supposed to meet her today?!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: A messenger came this morning. Augusta is dealing with an emergency, so our meeting's postponed... looks like it'll be a while.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: An unexpected change. It's throwing everything off course... I don't like the feel of it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And why me for this hunt? If it's about the Great Agon... the messenger said none of the other Gladiators were invited.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Who knows? Maybe she just wants to test her strength against you. Typical Septimontian, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You think so?

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Abby? Abby? Wake up.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: ...Whaaat's going on...?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I'm sooo sleepy... Ugh, that dark spooky stuff I ate earlier is still gurgling in my belly...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sorry to hear that. But if my clever, brave, stylish, and sweet Abby could help me out, that'd be amazing.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Aww, you're making me blush! Okay, okay, your best buddy Abby's on the job. Go on!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So... that thing we tangled with before has gone into hiding around here.

By Moon's Fated Light.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She didn't even get to finish her sentence. What was she thinking? Why did she do it... If this is the end, maybe I'll never know.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yeah, I know what you mean... Like, we didn't even get to have a proper goodbye!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I don't care if Iuno foresaw her fate and chose this path for herself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: All I know is I won't let it end like this. Not with her fading into oblivion.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why did Iuno choose this? Did she truly believe this was the better ending?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm the one she entrusted with her bracelet. The exception. So it's on me to find the answer.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Mmm—mmm—! Can you smell that? Sweet o' Margherita's Restaurant. C'mon, c'mon, let's go stuff our faces already!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's take care of important matters first. You'll eat well soon, I promise.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. We're here to find Cartethyia!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I still can't believe Tethys couldn't unlock the Sentinel's Relic we found in Septimont...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: At least now we know it's called the "Civilization Capsule." It probably holds key legacy data left behind by the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Like some ancient data recorder, right? But Tethys said to unlock it we'll need... the Leviathan's power.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We made a call when it mattered. I asked you to absorb the Dark Tide. We couldn't have known what it would become. You didn't do anything wrong.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I see... I-I can go hungry if I have to, but you, Rover, you better not get hurt...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The real threat is Leviathan. If we want to end this for good, we kill It and destroy Its Paradise.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...From what I know, Leviathan manifests Its kingdom by flooding Rinascita with the Dark Tide. That's how it turns the real world into the Journeying Paradise.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But we've already secured Ragunna and Septimont. The Fabricatorium and the hunting grounds are both stabilized... So why is this Paradise still there?

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Abby?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wahh! Wh-why didn't you answer me?! I waited outside forever! I had to force my way in to find you! Seriously, I thought you were—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This Sonoro was sealed off from the outside world. But it looks like it's reopened now.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yup! All thanks to our pals at the Black Shores! They've been working nonstop to install all kinds of devices. And with the connection getting stronger, I finally managed to slip through when the rift popped back up and... Wait...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: A new face! Hiya! Is she coming with us?

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Come to think of it, this is the first time I'm here at this cafe while wide awake.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You sure it's not because you've been putting in more nap hours lately?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Says who? I got locked out by the Sonoro Sphere right before the start, remember? I couldn't even get to you. And don't get me started on all the wacky frequencies that I got mixed in with...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You did a great job. Welcome to Shashou Cafe, Abby.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: ...Whoa, why the formality all of a sudden? Ahem. So you asked Shorekeeper to invite the Black Shores gang over for a party. They should be here pretty soon, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yep. Let's go check on Chisa and see how the decorating is going.

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (It stole your frequency! I'd know that stink anywhere!)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Now isn't a good time for a face-off. We'll settle the score later, Abby.)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Fine, but it's not getting off easy!)

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: That Voidworm must've snatched it! It smells like a Threnodian, just like that big eyeball!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Academy's been here a long time. They must have ways to deal with the Threnodian. We might even get some help.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And that girl who appeared out of nowhere... Her voice was like the one I heard over the radio in Honami City. Maybe it was her.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Really? Maybe she's in Lahai-Roi now. Should we try to find her?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's focus on fixing my fading frequency first. We can keep an eye out for her in the meantime.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (As for Lynae, she's hiding something, but I've got bigger priorities right now.)

Ode to the Second Sunrise.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I... saw someone's memory.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Whoa, you scared me! And just now, a frequency jumped into your Tacet Mark! It felt like... some kinda connection?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can you trace where it came from, Abby?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Sniff, sniff, sniff...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I smell it coming from over there!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Good. Let's go check it out.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It stopped... it stopped... for now. I gotta... I gotta rest...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You did great, Abby. Go get some rest.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Maybe that's what President Lucilla wants to discuss.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Makes sense! But what's with the "one from afar" bit?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Probably a riddle.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's go see the President and find out what she's planning.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: So, we're finally going to where that giant eye is hiding?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah. And Abby, if you think it's stronger than you, don't try to be a hero, okay?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I've got this! But uh... We don't know how much strength it's hiding behind that Gate, huh...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Our priorities are the data and Aemeath. A direct fight with Aleph-1 can wait until the Drive Replica is ready.

Beneath a Melting Night Sky.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover... Will we ever see Denia again?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We will.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Okay... But, what about the thing you didn't get to say, Rover?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: "If you feel you don't belong here, then some day in the future, would you be willing to..." And? What about the rest?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Secret. For now.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh? A package from Huanglong? What is it, what is it? Someone sent you snacks?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's a letter from Yangyang.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ohhh... from Yangyang, huh? Yeah, that time of year, I guess...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There's a whole box of treats for you.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Whoa! Yangyang's the best!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ahem... I-I know that. Hello? You're looking at the maestro of sharing here! But hey, what'd Yangyang say in her letter?

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Bleh... That tasted awful.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What did you "taste"?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Well, I'm not sure how to put it... The frequency was messy, like a billion math formulas all tangled together. Looking at it makes my head hurt.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It's weird... On top of that string of numbers, there's a ton of... emotions.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rage, regret, disappointment...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: A machine... isn't supposed to have emotions.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Prism of Fate isn't responding either...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Oh, I found where that smell is coming from. This way!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's this...?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Its frequency is a lot like that weird-smelling Autopuppet kernel from last time.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, what's that ya got? Smells kinda scrumptious.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This is for someone else. Don't you be getting any ideas.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Aww—what crummy luck!)

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (What's wrong?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Got jolted awake by some huge frequency wave! It was kinda like... that Prism of Fate, but with all these extra nasty, funky smells. Ugh...)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Is it coming from that Fox Shadow on the horizon?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Uh-huh! Whatever's there has been giving me the willies since we got here. Like something's spying on me... Creepy. So I'm staying inside. If things get hairy, just holler!)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Okay. Got it.)

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Is that a form of human connection too?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sort of.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Are we sharing that kind of connection right now?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'd say you've been haunting me. Like a ghost.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Haunting? Hmph! No way. Admit it, I'm just living rent-free in your head.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey! Rover? Rover... What happened?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It vanished. What was that just now?)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Abby, did you see that white cat? Someone seemed to be impersonating it, using it to guide us here.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: No. As soon as we arrived, our connection got cut off. Next thing I knew, I was already here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Was that just another one of the Somnoire's illusions? Or is someone pulling strings behind the scenes?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I don't know what happened, but we gotta be careful going forward. I smell something rotten...

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc:
=== Meeting Ciaccona ===
As Rover contemplates how to locate the Inverted Tower referenced by Imperator, Abby proposes an aerial approach, suggesting the cliff near Egla Town as a suitable launch point.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You there, Abster?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Yawns)... What's up...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's taking longer for Abby to react...)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, there's nothing to worry about... I'm just a little beat, that's all... Oh! Earlier when I was half-asleep, I came up with this great idea for finding the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's hear it.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Didn't the Sentinel say They're locked up in some kind of tower in the sky?

Shadow of Glory.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can you tell where these traces lead, Abby?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Over there. But the traces are kinda messy. They feel unsteady too...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That way… That's the archipelago across from Ragunna.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The traces are still fresh. We should follow them to find Cartethyia before they fade.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Should we go now?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yes. With the Threnodian's will gone, she wouldn't lose contact unless something's wrong. Really wrong.

Dreamweaver's Ascent.desc: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Also... In my dream, I wasn't affected by the slowed time and could freely move in and out of the barrier.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It's no shock that you have awesome powers, being friends with me.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hmm... What was that place you dreamed about called?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure I heard it correctly, but in my dream, the Sentinel mentioned a place called Mt. Firmament.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Mt. Firmament? Never heard of it...

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (...You've been hiccuping for a while. Do Echoes get indigestion as well?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (H-how am I supposed to know? I haven't had anything to eat since we left for Rinascita. So hungry...)

Through the Sea Thou Break.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh... Wait, what's that huge shadow under the water?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's getting closer.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Watch out!

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: So... was it all part of your plan?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We were improvising.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Then you two sure have great chemistry... Anyway, those bad guys are still after us, so let's get out of here.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Didn't Carlotta say something about an island up north? Let's go check it out!

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I can't wait to explore! Oh, by the way, it's been a while since we last saw Zani and Phoebe. Wonder what they're up to right now...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Alright, let's go. We should also keep an eye out for anything unusual along the way.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Phew! Finally, I can stick my head out! Rover, are you okay?!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm fine, Abby. What happened to you earlier?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I… wait, we're already in Septimont?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I was just talking to you, and then boom! It felt like something just... covered me!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: First, it messed with my frequency, then... I just passed out. Wait! Cartethyia? And a girl I don't know?!

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm picking up on more of the abnormal frequency... Abby, are you alright?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ugh... Just a little dizzy. My body's startin' to feel so heavy...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't push yourself. If it gets too much, let me know.

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (A ring, she wrote... Should be this ring-shaped ancient structure, I guess?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wow, it's really huge now that we look at it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Next, hanging eaves... If we look from here... Is it that pavilion?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It does look quiet. Should be a nice place for meetings... *yawn* Ugh, getting 'eepy again...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That must be the place, then.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll get going.

A Fleeting Night's Dream.desc: The twisted frequency within it affects both you and Abby. The lingering influence over you and Abby is lifted, and everything returns to its usual calm.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (And this message… Is it a prank? Or is there more to this?)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ugh, what's this smell?!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Nope, I can't take it… Gotta take a break…

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ew, why do I still smell it down here? Wait, this weird frequency… It's coming from that message!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ugh, my head… so dizzy… I'm gonna lie down. Just... just holler if you need me…

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Looks like we've been hit by the weird frequency in that message. I should check out what's going on in Egla Town.

Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: That's the first time anyone's ever said something so nice to me. Hehehe, I wouldn't go that far, but... teehee...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I remember the Simulacrum Nexus is cut off from the outside, so how does she know about recent events in Xuanfang and Qingxiao's school? She's also with a Myriad Snare, but her clothes don't match any Celestial I've seen.)

If On a Rainy Night a Family.desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Anyway, I'll leave this to you then. But hey, if you ever need my help, just give me a shout, okay?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hm, to locate me so precisely and deliver the invitation right into my hands... this Capollo Montelli knows what he's doing.

A Chill Day Out.desc: Rover and Abby decide to take advantage of a promotional deal at Yuan's Flavor on their day off. Whilst Abby was participating in a spicy food challenge, you overhear someone arguing and head over to see the commotion.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: And one of (him/her)!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Uh, that's alright, I'm good.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: See, (he/she) said it's alright! Good, even! I guess we'll have to take an entire set, please!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Thanks, Suisui!

The Adventures of Plushie Squad.desc: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What are they saying?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: They really like the picture you took, and they never knew such a large area existed behind the clouds. Hmm, you mean you guys couldn't see it before?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Maybe the Sonoro Sphere chooses who can and cannot see.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, the Plushies want to get a closer look. They want to take a clearer picture to share with everyone back in the village. Let's go!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: A Wingray. Up there! Maybe we can fly over there.

Quest of Faith.desc: Ruins litter Penitent's End where the shadows of knights wander among the crumbling walls. A faint voice floats thought the sea mist, guiding your way. "Seeker, follow in the footsteps of the knights from long ago. Uncover the long-buried truth." Hidden rewards can be found in this area.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Oh, so this was the end of their quest. Did they really find the relic after all?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, why are you looking up like that?

Heart of Repair.desc: Ask King Auto about the situation.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Seems like a little boy stayed here for quite a while...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Could it have something to do with him?

Mummer's Wish.desc: You rescued a weak Aria Mummer near Septimont City. It entrusts you with four Melody Boxes, each carrying a piece of music. What story might they tell?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let me know if you spot anything, Abby.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I see it! Right over there!

Silence at Last.desc: The Sunken Warren was originally a prison for Tacet Discords, but voices of the living can be heard from deep within.....

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: You hear that, Rover? Someone's in trouble!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's anyone doing here? Did they just stumble in by accident? Let's check it out.

Dreamweaver's Ascent.desc: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: I have sent the coordinates to your terminal. Thank you for your kind help... I pray you will both return safely.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, did you notice how the mountain has a strangely pleasant smell? It doesn't look edible though...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Not that I'm hungry or anything. I just tend to doze off easily. Feels like my body can only process what I consume while sleeping.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Well of course I'm reliable! Even if I do happen to fall asleep and can't hear you...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Of course you can! When I'm already so cool. you must be pretty amazing too!

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: C'mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Rover? Did something happen?

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Now that's much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn *... I'm getting sleepy again.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: Rover?

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I know my limits.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Rover, Lady Changli...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: After all, it's been almost five days...

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: I never properly thanked you for bringing me back to Hongzhen. I heard about the attack by the Fractsidus in the mountains. I... I'm so sorry...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: *chuckle* No need for that. I understand.

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: I've found a way to slow down your illness. No more pain, my love... We can finally be together, forever!

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: You mean... that legend? It's real?

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Fuling... Are you... Are you not happy?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: No... I am... I'm so glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Haha... Yes...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...Wuli!

Tales of the Past and Present: Averardo.desc: Fuling in Egla Town is collecting these pages of scattered books. Go and deliver the pages found in Averardo Vault to her.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: These seem to be the advertising brochures from Averardo Bank...

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Some notes on them are really interesting. Fuling even marked them.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: But it seems that the name Montelli holds a special meaning for them.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: These brochures are quite intriguing. Thank you, Rover.

Tales of the Past and Present: Whisperwi.desc: Fuling in Egla Town is collecting these pages of scattered books. Go and deliver the pages found in Whisperwind Haven to her.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: At that time, I truly felt like the clouds were within my reach... Sadly, that life is now behind me.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Fuling...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: You're right. And I'm deeply grateful that you and Changli helped me find the courage to start again.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Once I get the goldsmith's reply...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Hm? Did you say something?

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Oh... nothing at all!

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...Wuli.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Y-Yes?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: I'm really looking forward to it...

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Once I get the goldsmith's reply...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Hm? Did you say something?

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Oh... nothing at all!

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...Wuli.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Y-Yes?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: I'm really looking forward to it...

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Fuling... are you feeling all right now?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Mhm, don't worry about me. The new medicine is actually working really well. I feel surprisingly energetic now!

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: That's a relief... Kuiren mentioned that anyone who watches the Carriage Procession will be blessed with good fortune.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Just let me know if you get tired, okay? I can carry you back.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: I-I'm fine, really... The doctor said I need to walk and stretch my legs anyway—Ah... look over there, Wuli! Isn't that beautiful?

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: Mm. Very beautiful indeed.

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Once Wuli wakes up, I'll explain everything to him.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: If you have any other ideas, just tell him.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: But if you keep it all to yourself... No one, even those closest to you, will know how you really feel.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...Yes. I understand.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Rover, things are taking a turn. We should probably tell Lady Xinyi first.

To Mt. Firmament.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: ...And then she left.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: There's still one thing that doesn't add up—How did the Fractsidus kidnap our Sentinel?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: The Mianloong Chamber was once renovated by the Court of Savantae. Do you think their research could be involved somehow?

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: I'll look into what you said, but once we have the Cipher Key, the Mianloong Chamber will be left vulnerable to the Fractsidus' potential retaliation.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: We must keep them at bay...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Rover and I are headed to the Truthseeker's Pass to meet up with Jinhsi. We'll distract the Fractsidus main forces, giving you an opportunity to stage your ambush.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: There's more to this case than meets the eye...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: How about we start by investigating the missing person's home?

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Master Xuanmiao's records show that this is where the game record last appeared. This is also where we found that explorer.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: ... As Changli mentioned, this anomaly may indeed have something to do with that legendary game record.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Exactly... If this were to be the case, then we are not the only ones searching for its whereabouts.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: The explorer did not tell us about his source of information.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: But his knowledge of Mt. Firmament far exceeds that of a first-time visitor.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: You mean...

Immortal Blaze.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: My eventual departure may be unavoidable, but I want to give it my all until the very end.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I know you have already looked past death, but remember... There are people who care about you. They want you to live on and be happy.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Sometimes, I wish...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...we could stay together a little longer, if only for a while...

Potential Risk: A Road to Riches II.desc: Jianji and the funds he collected under the foundation's name have suddenly gone missing. Did he run off with the money, or is there another reason?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: To claim he'd scheme to steal everyone's money... Not just me, anyone who actually knows him would tell you that's pure slander!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Take a deep breath. Do you have any idea where he might have gone, or noticed anything unusual about him lately?

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Anything unusual... Well, the strangest part was definitely that merchant caravan. They claimed they were stranded here before the crisis, yet no one ever saw them trade a single item.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: I thought it was bizarre at the time, but Jianji insisted he trusted them... so I didn't pay it much mind.

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: Let me think...

lines.speaker: Fuling
lines.text: ...Actually, this morning when I walked past his house, I heard him arguing with someone.

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: So, please... just stay by my side a little longer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's Fuling and Wuli.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (The last time I saw them was back in Rinascita... Their journey is still going strong.)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Aww, look at those two lovebirds... Should we go over and say hi?)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's fine. What matters is that they're both safe and happy. Let's just leave them to enjoy the view.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (If fate permits, our paths will cross again someday.)

lines.speaker: Wuli
lines.text: So, please... just stay by my side a little longer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's Fuling and Wuli.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (The last time I saw them was back in Rinascita... Their journey is still going strong.)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Aww, look at those two lovebirds... Should we go over and say hi?)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's fine. What matters is that they're both safe and happy. Let's just leave them to enjoy the view.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (If fate permits, our paths will cross again someday.)

A Brief Respite.desc: Jinhsi entrusts you with a letter to Sanhua. What could it possibly be about? Unlock a new Companion after completing thing quest.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: You know, when I learn how to make it, I spent three whole days just memorizing the recipe!

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: You can count on me. I just observed the baking process a bit more, and I have memorized it all.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Alright, I'll let you use my stove.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Thank you, Rover. Please peel the lotus seeds for me.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Lotus seeds...? No, these are...

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: Twin Lotus Seeds, freshly picked. Baking them at high temperatures brings out their fresh fragrance. I'll be using them to enhance the taste.

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: One points to an unknown location. The other... points here, to the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Whoever left that message knew exactly where to find the Black Shores. And if they do...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll check it out.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Understood. I will send the coordinates to your Terminal. I must remain here to continue isolating and tracing embedded messages in the surrounding frequencies. I entrust this to you, my star.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: That I tried. Encore kept insisting she finish it, even remarking, "Your time has come, big bad homework!"

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah, that's Encore alright...

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: You may set out whenever you wish.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: This? Chisa taught me how to make this beverage. I find it tastes better with more milk and sugar...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I just made a cup. Would you... like to try it?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Hm, very well.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Were you worried about something just now?

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: ...Is the situation in Lahai-Roi that dire? You look exhausted.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: My frequency loss has been resolved. But Lahai-Roi is under imminent Threnodian threat. I need your help, Shorekeeper.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Understood. For this purpose… both I, and the Black Shores, exist.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Any additional intel on the Exostrider within the Tethys System? Verified or not, I need everything you have.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I trust Luuk. You can speak freely.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Records confirm that Luuk Herssen has been providing critical assistance and intelligence to the Black Shores. I trust your judgment.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: The Federated Army, led by ordinary citizens, ultimately prevailed over the Resonator army. Since then, Resonators in the New Federation have faced unequal treatment.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How did ordinary people without Resonance Abilities win that war?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: At first, the Resonators had the advantage. But then a substance called Inverse Tacetite appeared. It suppresses a Resonator's power.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Once that came into play, the scales began to shift. Eventually, the government forces gained the upper hand.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Goldrunner mentioned the name Promeus. I'd like to know, whose side was It on?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: One moment... That's strange. There's only one note about Promeus in Tethys's records.

phone.speaker: Shorekeeper
phone.text: Rover, I just sent the coordinates of the Somnoire's gateway to your Terminal.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Yes. I'll contact you if there's any progress.

phone.speaker: Shorekeeper
phone.text: All right, I'll go over the Tethys System data again and see if I can find anything new.}}

Through the Sea Thou Break.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: It remained hidden until the core leak in the Tethys System was finally resolved.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (That message... I think I should trust it.)

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Imperator is Rinascita's Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Rinascita, also called the Land of Echoes, is renowned for its Echo technologies. It's home to many like Abby who have physical forms.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Rinascita? I may finally learn who Abby really is...)

Advance toward the Future from Today.desc: To deter you from rescuing the Shorekeeper, who is on the verge of becoming its core, the Tethys System reveals three potential futures in its absence: and ice age, a cataclysmic disaster, and the total reconstruction of civilization. The Shorekeeper and you return to reality, landing on the very beach where you first arrived in the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That sounds familiar. I feel like I heard it before.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: A long time ago, you taught me how to play it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I see. But I... I have no memory of it.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I'll teach you...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Just like you did for me before.

Legacy of the Lasting Night.desc: The Shorekeeper asks that you retrieve the Necrostar and restore balance at the Modulation Hall. With the Shorekeeper's assistance, you successfully retrieve the source of the chaos—the Necrostar.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Grasping desperately for a tomorrow that never dawns.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But why?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why is this burden yours to carry?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I am the guardian of the Black Shores, the core of Tethys.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I was created for this purpose.

Lost Taste.desc: Yuan's Flavors welcomes the pickiest diner in its history, and the Fillet Fairmaiden resolves to bring back Xuanfang's finest, freshest taste. But reviving the old recipe and tracking down the ingredients leads to one surprise after another...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: As for taste preferences… "Yuan Fortress lies at low elevation, shrouded in fog year-round. Its people favored spice, to ward off the cold and damp." Dishes of that era were spicier than what we know today.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So other dishes and tastes changed with the times, including Yuan's Flavors and its customers, but the Immortal's Medley stayed exactly the same.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Thank you, Shorekeeper. I think I found why.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I am pleased to have helped you, Rover.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's this?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: This looks like some kind of data overflow. With access to the Abbowser Castle network, we should be able to make use of it.

Blessed Be the Moon.desc: As the preparation for the Moonlit Fair is nearly complete, the whole venue exudes a vibe of joy. At this point, Jinhsi, the much anticipated Magistrate of Jinzhou shows up... Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Alright, thanks for your advice. I'll adjust it based on your suggestions.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: This is merely our personal preference. It may be helpful to get others' input as well, Uncle Li.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Haha, don't worry. I take every single customer feedback seriously. That's how I get the inspirations for new flavors.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Here, take these snacks and enjoy them while you explore the fair. It'll be lovely to walk under the moonlight and snack on something delicious, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Come grab a bite if you get tired and hungry anytime. You'll enjoy the fair more on a full stomach!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Thank you, Uncle Li. If you need any assistance, please let me know. I'll be sure to help.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Anyway, let's go find Yangyang and the others first.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Rover? Is that really you? You're back?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Oh, thank goodness. Now that you're here, Rover, everything is going to be all right. You must've come back because you heard what happened to Yangyang and Chixia!

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Huh? You haven't heard? Chixia's still unconscious, and Yangyang... she's gone missing. And now...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Can you be more specific, Zhezhi?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: O-okay. I-I only found out recently myself. There was a commission that passed its deadline, but nobody came to follow up on it...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Do you remember when you painted the first Winter's Serenade in Bloom?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You worked really hard on it.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: And... that hard work should be noticed.

Chasing the Moon, Here and Now.desc: Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: That's... that's okay. I prefer quiet places... Plus, I live right here in Jinzhou, not too far away...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Leaving her alone here... doesn't sit right.)

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Me? I'm not really that hungry—

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Really? Thank you... But I still haven't finished my painting—

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: You're right... Don't mind if I do!

Wish You Were Here.desc: Dianxiao is finally opening her Fan Drawing Stall. Go visit it. Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: No, that might make it too blurry. The customers at the Moonlit Fair prefers more realistic detail...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Zhezhi seems deeply focused. She should have no problem working on the painting. I'll get going and do Dianxiao's request...)

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Uh... Did I just see someone out of the corner of my eye?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: felt... familiar?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Nevermind... I'm probably just seeing things after staying up too late.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: S-sorry! I, um... I didn't mean to be SO LOUD!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Zhezhi?

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Huh? Rover?!

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: I'm so sorry! I was just... in a hurry...

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: I already delivered his commission! I really did!

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: We agreed on the final payment, but he kept making excuses, dragging it on and on! He even claimed he didn't speak the Huanglong language, and then he just... DISAPPEARED!

Mianloong Chamber (Quest).desc: According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I cannot bring myself to ask for more. All I seek is the truth.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Mt. Firmament is in grave danger... Regarding the Temporal Mandate and your injuries... Please, do not keep the truth from me any longer.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: One understands your concerns. The timing may not be optimal for this disclosure, yet in the midst of crisis, one must act with expedience.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: For one will soon perish.

The Commander of Time.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: What do you think of this world?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: A guiding light is not easily lit.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.

The Commander of Time.desc: As the dust settles, Jué meets with you as promised. You learn that you were once Jué's master and established Jinzhou with its assistance.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: Rover, this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: Correct.

Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Que.desc: You found Cosmos, Encore's wooly companion, by a mysterious gate. Some kind of test seems to be running behind the gate and it needs your assistance. During the test, Cosmos will provide Echoids to significantly boost Resonators' combat power. You can complete the task with your friends.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Ahem, I um...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Did you say experiment? What experiment?

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: It's a stability test of the dream links. This is the entrance to the experiment zone. You will conduct the testing on the other side, Rover.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, I smell something fishy about his offer.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Of course I... Wait, why that look?

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: I-I… Please, Rover, I have no one else to turn to. What can I do to make you accept? I'll do anything within my power.

Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epi.desc: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epilogue

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I think we deserve an explanation.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Somnoire? Sorry, not my thing.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: You're not deceiving me!

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: That's why I hate sharp people...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: What were you murmuring about?

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Now you have all the rewards I promised and you must be tired after all these battles so maybe you should get some rest oh and I still got something to attend to so bye!

Encore's Steaming Adventure!.desc: Xisha asks you to make him the legendary fireworks. Seems like an easy job... maybe? Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: What's that, Mr. Li? Looks really yummy!

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: It's called the Plumpcake. A traditional dessert passed down in Jinzhou for thousands of years. Try it, you'll love it.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Thousands of years... Then there's gotta be cool stories about it. Right, Mr. Li? Do you know any?

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Hmm... Actually, I do. Let's see...

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: This is a story that dates back to the two Sentinels of Huanglong...

From the Echoes of Destruction.desc: The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: You, er, brought it up before.

lines.speaker: Youhu
lines.text: Aw, Yangyang's got a soft spot for you, huh? Are you her SPECIAL someone?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Oh, come on. I-I just know it means a lot to you.

lines.speaker: Youhu
lines.text: Relax, I'm just teasing. So Rover, you're tracking the Black Shores too?

lines.speaker: Youhu
lines.text: Since we're on the same trail, how about teaming up?

lines.speaker: Youhu
lines.text: Let THIS master be your guide! You and me, dream team. Nothing is going to slow us down.

Hidden Between the Waves.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Youhu
lines.text: What? Ro...ver...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Comm's dead? Don't worry. It happens a lot around here.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: The Black Shores sits atop a massive Tacetite, wreaking havoc on standard communications.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Once we reach the Greenhouse, you can patch them in near our beacon.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Only our beacons can cut through the Tacetite's interference.

Hidden Between the Waves.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: No... I'll miss seeing my friend in action again.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Maybe that's why you saw the other you in that vision?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I... I'm so sleepy...

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I'm glad to hear that. Your vitals are also within normal parameters now.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: ugh, this part of you feels completely empty. Let me check that out for you.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: How can that be...? The readings tell me your vitals are within normal parameters now.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, I'm still wide awake ya know, just a little beat. And this part of you feels completely empty.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: The connection between your frequency and the rift has been cut off. You are out of immediate danger.

Legacy of the Lasting Night.desc: The Shorekeeper, meanwhile, appears deeply concerned about you and Abby's unique symbiosis.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: This looks awful! Ugh, like the worst stew ever made!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: This frequency...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: W-what are you staring at?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: It's the one.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: This frequency has dwelled within you for millions of years.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I'll keep an eye on it. We have more important matters at hand.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Communications will be affected once inside. From here on, you will be on your own. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Relax. Rover ain't alone. I still count, don't I?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Of course... I hope you both return safely.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Again with this Somnoire thing? I always feel like there's something weird staring at me in there.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Don't get all twisted up about it, though! It might just be my imagination.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Yes, just happened by. Seems you two managed to find each other, Rover. Though... I hear you've stumbled into fresh trouble at Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Really...? I'm sorry that I can't personally assist with the investigation. But if you need help, contact Huaxu Academy at any time. Everyone here will do their utmost to help you.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I should be returning to my lab. I wish you a swift and successful conclusion to this case.

Wish Upon the Moon I: Cry of the Soul.desc: Following the clues in the wish, you uncover the true identity of "Xiaosheng", and what he has to tell...

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I hope this data can be of help to you. Once I've wrapped up here at the Academy, I'll meet you as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well then... It's time to look for some Echoes.

Wish Upon the Moon II: The Elder's Promi.desc: The wish that finds difficulty making a choice and seeks an answer starts to understand the weight of "choices" after you listen to it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What was that about?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Hehe...It was just a little trick to get Mrs. Heying to join us at the Lodge. You probably sensed it after hearing her story.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: The promise between Mrs. Heying and her son wasn't just about seeing his wish granted but about finding peace in her life.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: In her grief, Mrs. Heying overlooked what her son truly wished for.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I believe he wanted her to see Jinzhou uniting to defeat the Threnodian and the joy and security he sacrified himself to safeguard.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: His wish for his mother represents not just life's simple joys, but also the courage to keep living.

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Isn't that...

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Hello, Rover. Can you come to the Moontree Lodge?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hey, you done deciphering that fourth wish?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Yes... As I suspected, Patty's malfunction was caused by something else.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Understood. I'll be right there.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Thank you. I'll see you in the usual spot.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Unusual volume or distinct visual changes are both caused by it. Mm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Then the effect on you is...

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: ...A sudden verbal disorder involving the strange use of modal particles. Mm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: That said, these changes won't damage your persona. They only affect your movements and combat styles until the effect expires.
