lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: If you stay and explore further, it may be easier for you to adapt to these changes and uncover the clues you need. Mm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: How do you see it, Rover?

Moonlit Reunion.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: It does have its challenges, but everyone's hopes and dreams for the festival are in these wishes. I don't intend to let them down.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Yes, Yangyang and the rest... have set their hearts on this festival.)

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I appreciate the gesture... but I wouldn't want to trouble you.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: I see. Thank you, Rover. Well, then... The Moontree Lodge welcomes its newest member!

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Seems we have a new friend now, Patty.

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: The Waveworn gobbled up and then spit out some weak frequencies, but this one smells... strange. Was it affected by something else?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Pascar, It's me, Xiangli Yao. Do you recognize me?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh? Didn't he set it off in the first place?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Calm down, we are safe here. No Waveworn or Tacet Field around.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Nothing's happening to me. See?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Yes, I'm listening.

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Chixia
lines.text: Hey, Rover! Over here!

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Your friends are calling out to you.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Go. Don't keep them waiting.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: But I...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You have a promise to keep, remember?

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: ...Yes, I do.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: ...I am sorry. I made everyone worry.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Don't blame yourself. Consider it a blessing to have so many people holding you in their thoughts.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Principal Investigator Xiangli...! You're there too.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Yes, just happened by. Seems you two managed to find each other, Rover. Though... I hear you've stumbled into fresh trouble at Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: Really...? I'm sorry that I can't personally assist with the investigation. But if you need help, contact Huaxu Academy at any time. Everyone here will do their utmost to help you.

Operation: Lunar Duo.desc: Enforce justice and cleanse the crimes lurking in the shadow before the Moon-Chasing Festival is around, now! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Uncle Li…? Stay put. Let's listen in first.

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Sorry I kept you waiting, Lei.

lines.speaker: Lei
lines.text: Ha, no way. We just got here. Hurry up, greet our boss, Uncle Li!

lines.speaker: Exile
lines.text: We're ready, boss!

lines.speaker: Uncle Li
lines.text: Hehe, youth. If I were a few decades younger, I wouldn't have needed to bother you lot.

To Mt. Firmament.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: To get inside Mianloong Chamber, we have to find the Cipher Key in Truthseeker's Pass and unseal it with the Keyforge.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Understood. I will go bring back the Cipher Key.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: You are injured... Please rest and leave it to me.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: The Fractsidus will most likely attack this place once I leave. You must stay here and guard it.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: ...Yes, I will, Madam Magistrate.

Road of Pilgrimage.desc: You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.

The Commander of Time.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: What do you think of this world?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...

The Commander of Time.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: Wherever the tides may take us, you will bear witness to our fight.

lines.speaker: Xinyi
lines.text: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: What do you think of this world?

The Commander of Time.desc: Jué notices something usual about your Tacet Mark just as Abby appears and the two confront each other. Even Jué is uncertain of Abby's origins, but suggests that you visit the Black Shores, the starting point of your journey in this world.

lines.speaker: Jué
lines.text: Your Tacet Mark... There is something unusual.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Whoa... What... What's wrong?!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, who's bullying you?!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Is it you, big thing?! Huh?! How dare you, I'm gonna teach you a le...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hmm? Wait, pause... I don't think it has any bad intentions... It smells like the "unnatural" smell I smelled in Jinzhou before...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ooh, so you must be that Sentinel! Hehe, hello there big one!

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: P-please, I'm not photogenic...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Hahaha... Dat-tat, dat-tat, dat-tat, dat!

Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Hahaha... Dat-tat, dat-tat, dat-tat, dat!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Oh wow! Let me try! Lemme!

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Because I turned you into one! Miss Shorekeeper could only grant me a tiny bit of Tethys' computing power, so this Cube is the best I could manage for you.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ah... I'm so dizzy! What's going on?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Look, it's an Abby Cube!

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Uh-uh. Only you and me are real here. The rest are replicas based on the scan results.

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: I followed Miss Shorekeeper's instructions and made 12 different Cubes! They should all be here... Huh?

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Where's the cake?

When the Night Knocks.desc: In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: I didn't notice anything unusual lookin' around, but...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Ah, it's my coworker. Sorry, I need to take this call.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Yes? What? She's back at work already? But she's injured! ...Okay, please take care of her. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: It's one of my team members. She crashed while delivering an express package.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lumi! Thank goodness you're safe!

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Rover!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's deal with it first and go find Tangtang.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Let's do it!!!

Forever Fest and Lollo Party.desc: At Lumi's invitation, you come to an unending party...

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: I stumbled into this Sonoro a while back and found this extravagant place inside! And it's full of all these... "special folk."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Special? They look pretty ordinary to me.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: We checked with HQ. Turns out this place was created by a Resonator's rare ability. The folks here sense it, kind of, but most just stop askin' questions and lose themselves in the Forever Fest.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: But nothing really lasts forever, does it? Even this Sonoro. See? It's already startin' to fade.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: They all know it. Even a "Forever Fest" won't last forever. But they've grown so used to the happiness here, they'd rather the endin' be a happy one, too.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Before this place vanishes, they want to know what's weighing on the host's heart. They asked me to look into it.

Message from Lollo Logistics.desc: I.R.I.S. seems to need your help. Maybe you should go check on her.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Rover, you must be a wee bit tired lately! How about a breather?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You read my mind.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Aye! I was hoping you'd say that. Official announcement: Lollo Logistics is throwing a proper luxurious bash, and you're on the guest list!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You mean a luxurious party? Don't tell me it's at the Distribution Center?

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: No, no! It's somewhere you'd never expect!

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Plus, you'll get to hear a mysterious legend while you're there.

You Outshine the Fireworks.desc: The Forever Fest has yet to end, but the Lollo Party is already drawing to a close. Moments of joy never last long, but beyond them lies a brilliant river of stars.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: I want to go somewhere I've never been before. Take my time, see the sights… and then, travel to places even farther. Of course, I'll be back before the holiday is over.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's a great idea, Lumi.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Hehe, let me get a plan together first.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: I haven't decided yet, hmm... but if I can't decide, I'll just keep movin' forward!

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Who knows… maybe what's waitin' for me... is where a river of stars falls.

phone.speaker: Lumi
phone.text: There's one last wee thing I need your help with, actually.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What is it?

phone.speaker: Lumi
phone.text: It's really a teeny, tiny thing. Maybe just an excuse for everyone to see you again.

phone.speaker: Lumi
phone.text: Anyway, we'll be waiting for you at the Lollo party!}}

The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Fal.desc: Return to Forever Fest to see which companions have shown up today, and see if Lumi has uncovered something new.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What are you looking at, Lumi?

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Oh hi, Rover. I was just watchin' this pigeon.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Looks like Mr. Copo's lapel pin.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Yes! I had the Pioneer Association do some diggin' for me. They told me there used to be a magician named Cobb Copo in Rinascita, and his most famous trick was creatin' illusions.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Apparently, at one of his fests, a boy saw right through his act. That boy's name was Geisel.

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: They say that Geisel cracked the illusion when he noticed a two-dimensional pigeon that was obviously out of place.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Nyarla, you do have a flair for dramatics. Ahem! Anyway, why don't you unwrap it?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Th-this is...!

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: I took the liberty of having Nyarla custom-make this mask based on my impression of you. I hope it suits your taste.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: I'm pleased you like it.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: The Montelli family shares its wealth and opportunities freely, but I see your stage lying beyond the cutthroat games of power and fortune—toward a world that's far more boundless and free.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: I'm pleased you like it.

Lollo Campaign: Comeback (Quest).desc: Your old friend Maji is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan. You guess it... a friend indeed is a friend in need.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's the all-new approach?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Sure, it's just like last year, except we swap out some buzzwords on the slides to make them look impressive for the bosses.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Why are you looking at me like that? I have to report, you know. Besides, I've just been transferred to headquarters — I still need to put food on the table, right?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: However, I've initiated an optimization plan for the entire Lollo Stamps exchange feature, making it easier to acquire Lollo Stamps without having to detour through the finance department for approvals.

Morning Star II.desc: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Boy, am I glad to see you. My friends over at Ragunna told me they were sending some help over from the Order. I never expected it would be you. I'm relieved.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Didn't you get promoted to management? Why are you still out in the field?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Come on, let's not put it like that. I'm still a courier at heart. When duty calls, I answer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So what kind of problem are we dealing with today that's got our Senior Regional Chief Advisor in a tight spot?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: One of our construction material convoys was attacked by TDs while crossing Mournfell Canyon. The Gladiators in charge of escort said they came across "undying monsters."

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: That's right. They said those monsters would come back from the dead no matter how many times they killed them. They just wouldn't die.

Lollo Campaign: Navigation I.desc: The Day 1 Campaign content has been updated. Maji is ready for you to join forces and take on the new tasks.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Couriers can provide real-time feedback on road conditions to the "Lollo Navigator," which means the map is constantly being updated.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So your plan is to combine the map with the various services mentioned earlier?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Exactly. We also have other new services currently running in their trial phases. You've done a great job today. Let's try out the rest of the features some other time.

Lollo Campaign: Ice Savior.desc: Your old friend Maji swears he's found his break in Septimont with yet another one of his "genius" business ideas. But whether it takes off or crashes depends on your help.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: You don't get it! Lose freedom, you lose a lot. Lose perfectly-aligned workflow, you lose everything!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (...Pretty sure that's now how the saying goes.)

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Anyway! I jumped right into putting the plan into action.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: But as I said, no matter what I try, I can't outrun melting ice!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Not even with coolers or ice packs?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: No! Friend, no cooler and ice pack can withstand the blazing passion of the crowd!

Lollo Campaign: Verification (Quest).desc: The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's career, and to keep those convenient services running, help him verify the reliability of Lollo Campaign!

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: I bet you liked it, right? But that'll be the last of it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Whoa. First time seeing you give off a face like that. Didn't realize it'd be that big of a blow.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Don't you worry. There's always a silver lining.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Our accounting says there are a few things I need to iron out first. Things like, lacking user incentives, not enough granularity in the work flow, and not being able to capitalize data in private domains.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: That's what happens when you're a cog in a wheel. Stuck spinning for life.

Lollo Campaign, Set Sail V.desc: Bakethoven's dream is to belong to the Echo Depository of Averardo Vault. Can you help him out?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: I see… So, what should we do now?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's head to the Vault tomorrow. You said you'd prefer to live a short but meaningful life, right? From where I stand, making food for others seems like a pretty meaningful thing to me.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Alright then! Let's meet at the Vault tomorrow! Thanks as always, Rover!

Lollo Campaign, Set Sail II.desc: Go to Maji's place and check for new errands.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Rover! Rover! Something's off here... PLEASE SAVE ME!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds like Maji is in trouble... I'd better go lend a hand.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Ahh?!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is everything alright? You looked like you were somewhere else just now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh... I was just thinking how the Blessed Maiden's voice sounded just like the heavenly voice during the Carnevale...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: So I was wondering... about the Sentinel's messages we heard before... Was it... Do you think Their advice... "Consume healthy food, such as the Laurus Salad..."

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh?

Where All Fish Converge.desc: Here, all fish gather—and since whales are also considered "fish", then...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Quick, let's check if anything was lost!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Nothing's lost, except now we've got this...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What a strange fish...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How about we take it back to Planck? Maybe it knows what this is.

Old Man and the Whale (Quest).desc: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Rover...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We're safe now.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thank you, Cetus the Tidebreaker...

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face - Acolyte Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Have you seen this before?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I request to join your investigation, Rover. As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.

Morning Star I.desc: The crisis is over, but Rinascita still has a long road ahead of it...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Looks like Phoebe is swamped at the moment. Better give her a hand before she gets overwhelmed.)

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: No, it's all right. I can take care of it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Shouldering every responsibility can sometimes be irresponsible in itself.

lines.speaker: Calaris
lines.text: I couldn't agree more. Acolyte Phoebe, let us share the burden!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Leave the tasks in Septimont to me. I've gotten pretty familiar with the area.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ...Very well. I'll send over the locations and requirement shortly. Thank you, truly.

The Sailor's Treasure.desc: Not all treasure of the sea is left behind by pirates, some could have been left by ordinary sailors... or a captain.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: What do you make of the clues, Rover?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Finding that Gondola might be a good start.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Good idea. The sailor may have vanished, but if his Gondola is still here we may be able to find some clues.

Love in the Time of Fishing.desc: Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: W-wait...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...

Restore Plushie Village II.desc: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (What's this? The Plushies brought back a recipe for Baton Bread?)

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Rover, are you in Plushie Village?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah. I see a new member in the village. An oven Echo?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Oh, you've got sharp eyes. It's called Old Bake, an Echo for the apprentices in a bakery.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I happen to have a bread recipe. Can I ask Old Bake to make me some?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Hmm, that may be difficult.

The Adventures of Plushie Squad.desc: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Bubble and Old Bake always get cold feet when it comes to visiting new places. Maybe seeing some of the unique views beyond the village would help them change their minds.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Easy peasy, lemon squeezy.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: That's great! So...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: New adventures, here we come.

Restore Plushie Village I.desc: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor—a Tubpup.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Oh, Rover, you're here! Thanks to you, much of the painting's power has been restored. And look, a new friend has joined our little village!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: A Tubpup?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Yep. This is Bubble!

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Bubble used to live in Egla Town, but it's master moved to the city. Unfortunately, it was too costly to bring a Tubpup along.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: It's probably not a good idea to leave Bubble wandering around, so I brought it here instead.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (It's understandable to want a new tub for a new home. But it seems that Echoes are more than just furniture for people in Rinascita.)

Restore Plushie Village IV.desc: Finally, the restoration of the Plushie Village is complete! There will be a small celebration party and you're invited!

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Ah, Rover, here you are.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Are you doing this remotely now?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: You see, some Echoes are still acting strange, even though we've restored the painting to its full power. I'm asking HQ to send more field investigators to get it sorted out.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Honestly, things could have been a lot worse without your help!

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: The Sonance Caskets you've collected have kept the village from falling apart along with the weakening painting. Otherwise, a lot more Echoes would be acting weird.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: You gave me the chance to witness this beautiful scene where humans and Echoes live together in harmony.

Plushie Squad's Clean Return.desc: After a long journey, the plushie squad is a mess… Let's help them freshen up and get sparkling clean again.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: I'll leave this task to you, Rover. Let me know if you need anything!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That being said... I've never actually tried going through the morph painting in the village...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well... Here goes nothing.

Plushie Expedition Squad.desc: In Septimont, you received a message from Fulmine: A tiny plushie expedition squad from Ragunna has somehow arrived here too...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How did you guys get here?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: The Plushies have been trying to tell me something lately, but I didn't understand a word of it.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: So they grabbed my spare tablet, jumped into the Morph Painting, and just like that, they turned up in Septimont!

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Turns out some of these Morph Paintings are connected to each other. This is big. I could make a big story out of this!

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: This is exactly what I wanted to talk to you about! Could you try turning in a Sonance Casket? We need to confirm if the ones from Septimont can power the Morph Paintings too.

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Here's your food. Enjoy!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: *Sniffs* Oh what's that smell... it's so good!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: You're... Abby, right?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hi there... Gosh, this tastes amazing...

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The Vitreum Dancer suddenly lost control... Luckily, no one got hurt.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Now that I think about it, the frequency vibration I sensed felt a lot like... empathy.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Empathy...?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Well, maybe telepathy? Not sure. It's hard to explain...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Telepathy... Yes, according to legend, the Sentinel speaks directly into the mind of the Laureate. Could that be what happened?

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I see. A WingrayFlying Echo, that explains it.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wingray?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Yes, it's a type of Echo that can fly. People in Ragunna often use them to travel quickly between locations.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Let's use the Grapple to hitch a ride on the Wingray.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Zzz... Forgot to clock out...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ugh, that's rough! She's even thinking about her work in her dreams!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Okay... No problem. I still have plenty of time in my schedule...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Sheesh! Hey, wake up! Stop working!

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can only record what is plain to the eye.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But Rover, we need a new plan.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: ...Give me a moment. Ah, yes! Look at this!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: How could this be...

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: His garb suggests he's from the Montelli family. Could they be involved in this turmoil?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Indeed. But it's rare to wear a mask before the Carnevale. He must have wanted to hide his face.

The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (...What do you think I am? Not a chance! And I'm too sleepy to help, just wake me if there's any progress...)

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can only record what is plain to the eye.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Don't be hard on yourself, Mr. Fulmine. You've been a tremendous help. At least we're not flying blind anymore. But Rover, we need a new plan.

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: ...Give me a moment. Ah, yes! Look at this!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: How could this be...

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: His garb suggests he's from the Montelli family. Could they be involved in this turmoil?

Restore Plushie Village III.desc: You retrieved a photo from the sphere inside the morph painting, which reveals clues to a hidden past...

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: You really captured them in action during their adventure. Have you ever thought about doing some part-time photography for us?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover didn't take this picture. Anyway, the Plushies got super moody when they saw it. Any idea why?

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Ah, I see. Well, just from the photo, I can tell the photographer is pretty skilled. But if you want to know more...

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: Do you see anything, C-MOSS?

lines.speaker: C-MOSS
lines.text: *Humphs unwillingly*... *Humphs in thought*... *Humphs in painful thought...*

lines.speaker: Fulmine
lines.text: C-MOSS? Are you all right?

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: At the Margherita's Restaurant, you meet Carlotta.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Ms. Margherita, have you seen Ciaccona?

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Ms. Ciaccona... Hmm, she was squirreling off towards the harbor earlier. I thought that's where you were meeting, so I didn't say a word.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: She did look quite down, though. Never seen her wear such a gloomy face before.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Miss Margherita, one extra large Forte-astic Fizz & Freeze gelato, please. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Right away! You helped Rinascita through its darkest hour. Now it's my turn to make sure our heroes eat and drink like royalty!

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Here you go! Double the scoop, on the house! Unlimited refills!

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Look! Over there! Isn't that Brant and Roccia? Wow, the Troupe of Fools is putting on a show!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Hoist the sails, O humanity! The abyss and the summit have entwined. Your only path now is forward, bold and uncharted!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: You stand on the precipice. Now is the hour to decide your fate—to plant the seed of your highest hope and watch it bloom into tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Captain, why do you burn alone in your own flames?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: If you do not first become ashes, how will you rebuild?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Embrace your fire. Embrace your grief. Go into your solitude! I love those who dare to create, who strive to transcend, for in doing so, their old selves are destroyed. Yes, so they might reach the shores of a new life!

Through the Sea Thou Break.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Please forgive the lack of propriety. Now, travelers from afar, may I know your names?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Humph, hear that?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Whoa, hold up! My name's Abby! This is Rover!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Aw, c'mon, enough with the fancy talk!... My name's Abby, and this is Rover.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Hehe, Rover and Abby! Splendid! "All who step aboard, guests of honor be! With names exchanged, friendship's born at sea!"

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Ahoy, crew! Let's give our new mates a proper welcome!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Leviathan could use the Dark Tide to possess Abby, merge with Ovathrax, and eventually, complete Its rebirth.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (I'm alright, Rover.)

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: You've never questioned what Abby is, have you?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Never paused to wonder why it grows dizzy each time it absorbs the Dark Tide? You do already know what the Dark Tide really is...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Perhaps, once Abby merges with Leviathan, it will recall what it once was and find its "true self." If that's the risk you're prepared to take, I suppose I can revise my script accordingly.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Leviathan has long sought Its Harbinger, but you weren't Its first choice. That role was meant for Augusta, Septimont's current Ephor.

Through the Sea Thou Break.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Until the Carnevale, guest from afar. I hope you enjoy the show.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I'm honestly baffled... Was all that real or just a story?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hmm, that one gives off a mysterious vibe...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ah, who cares? The Carnevale sounds like a blast! Everyone's raving about it. You might even catch a chat with the Sentinel!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Then perhaps it is wewho must tear the old script and become the authors of a new one.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: No matter how noble your reason may sound, the crimes you've committed in Rinascita are far too great to ever be forgiven.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: I care little for my own fate. I am but a small footnote in this "grand repertoire."

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: One day, my role will, too, end. And if that finale serves to bring the curtain down with perfection and grandeur, I'd gladly add it to the "script."

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: However, my moment on stage has yet to come. The spotlight now belongs to the people of Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You wrote Avidius and all of Rinascita into a tragedy, just to prove a point.

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: Cristoforo approaches and greets you, mentioning a recent article from Ragunna that offers an unusual take on the "Golden Anthem" legend. While you and Ciaccona are separated in the crowd, Cristoforo appears next to Ciaccona, telling a story about a caged bird, as if hinting at something deeper.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Have you really made your choice? I look forward to the arrival of tomorrow, Miss Poet.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is this Ciaccona's sheet music? She was here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The vision I just saw seems to have been recorded from this...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Ciaccona mentioned she always writes down her melodies on manuscript paper. Could this be...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Golden Anthem...

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Uh... since when did you get all poetic?

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Amid howling winds, rising storms, and ghosts adrift, I heard the captain's call—

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Look! Over there! Isn't that Brant and Roccia? Wow, the Troupe of Fools is putting on a show!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Hoist the sails, O humanity! The abyss and the summit have entwined. Your only path now is forward, bold and uncharted!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: You stand on the precipice. Now is the hour to decide your fate—to plant the seed of your highest hope and watch it bloom into tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Captain, why do you burn alone in your own flames?

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: See? I wasn't lying!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Tacet Discords' frequencies are perpetually fading, inching toward their end.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Their only way to maintain their existence is to consume other frequencies as food.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Dark Tide and mist enveloping this isle have drawn in countless Tacet Discords. Their frequencies should have been enough to feed the dragon.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: If what you saw is true, then...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Order must've used some trick to control the dragon, making its frequency fade away faster than it should.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm fine. What I saw, though…

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Hmm... Sounds like the same thing happening to the people here.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: From what I've heard, many Ragunnesi have been having peculiar dreams lately. Even some of our Troupe members too.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: The details vary, but they all end the same way... the fall of Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: And it's not just in dreamland either... Rover, I'm not sure if you've heard, but there have been strange rumors appearing across Rinascita lately.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Even in Septimont, folks claim they've seen Tacet Discords not of this land in the wilds, or the ghosts of their ancestors.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Someone will need to carry it in first, to reach the Anchor Stone and reactivate it.... I'll do it. As a captain, navigating through uncharted waters is second nature.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispersfor long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Montelli traitors used Lycoris in experiments to turn Echoes back into Tacet Discords... If they were successful, the "ghosts" seen ten years ago may have also been created this way.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: "Ghost" is just a dramatic name given by the Ragunnesi for Tacet Discords. They look nearly identical to Echoes, especially in the mist.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: With your help, Grandfather has thwarted their plan. No corrupted Echoes will appear at this year's Carnevale.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Order has allied with the Fractsidus to control the dragon... From what I saw when I connected with its frequency, they might be planning to command it to attack Ragunna during the Carnevale.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: After the Tacet Discords took over this isle, the Order used them as an excuse to forbid any entry. It might be their way of concealing the dragon's existence.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: But without the Lycoris, the Dragon of Dirge is now off the table.

Sail Day, Captain!.desc: But worry not, Brant has come up with a wonderful plan as he puts something on you, and just like that, you've transformed into the superstars of tonight's Plushie Gathering, Cuddle Wuddle and Lottie Lost! He even considers catching you and Brant.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Look, there's something there…

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: May I have a look?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is that a letter? Does it mean anything to you?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Hmm, yes. On these seas, there is only one legend about "D."

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: The story of Drake, the Golden Captain.

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Anyway, this is for you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is this… Drake's scroll?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Exactly! I figured it would be a good memento of our adventure.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Oh, and due to your stellar performance, I'm officially naming you our troupe's "Honorary Captain," as witnessed by this map!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: When do we sail again?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: That depends on when the next adventure calls! You know that I'll be ready to join you, just say the word.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: The performance is excellent and merits applause, but...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But what? Is anything missing?

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: We still have to drink a toast to another better day! Are you up for a round, my friend?

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: I can still sense Abby's frequency, even if it's faint.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (What triggered Abby to come out? Something it could absorb? But then, why didn't it work?)

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: That dragon's behavior is odd. It never leaves its territory.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Long ago, this place was a sacred spot for the Order's pilgrims. Then the Dark Tide hit, and all those Reverberations left behind twisted things up.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: This "Dragon of Dirge," is a local Tacet Discord. It grows by feeding on the others.

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: I can still sense Abby's frequency, even if it's faint.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (What triggered Abby to come out? Something it could absorb? But then, why didn't it work?)

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: That dragon's behavior is odd. It never leaves its territory.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Long ago, this place was a sacred spot for the Order's pilgrims. Then the Dark Tide hit, and all those Reverberations left behind twisted things up.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: The Remnant Clouds from the sea of clouds drew hordes of Tacet Discords here. Now, their whispers fill the air, turning this once holy place of pilgrimage into the "Penitent's End."

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: This "Dragon of Dirge," is a local Tacet Discord. It grows by feeding on the others.

The One that Impresses.desc: In the fourth level of the castle, you find Pero, who has fused with Roccia.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: It's the hope that coldness can never extinguish, like ancient ice thawing in the spring. The ardent wish to guide people into a new spring... This is love! A love for peace and prosperity! Yummy!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Let's keep going. Abbowser must've stashed more good food.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Yes!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Pero says she enjoyed that play. The story reminded her of all of us and made her feel warm and fuzzy.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Good, I thought you might have found it boring.

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: A play of hope is never dull I'm feeling inspired. Want to hear my ideas?

Veils Off in Sun or Shadow.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Hmm, pardon me, but this lady by your side seems rather familiar...?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I am Zani. I work at Averardo Bank.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Ah, yes. You look quite chivalrous, if I may say so. Yet with your weary face, I'm afraid I can only dub you the "Sorrowful Knight."

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: That's quite fitting. Do I thank you for that?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Ahh, no need for the formalities. Allow me to re-introduce myself. I am Cristoforo, a humble playwright grappling with modern trends. Delighted to meet you.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Actually, I've been working on a script about the Blessed Maiden lately. The well-known Martyred Maiden, Fleurdelys.

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Friends, it's been too long. I gather you were also listening in on that conversation about the Golden Anthem's last work?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: What did you mean by Daemons?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: "Resentful of the Order's verdict, they committed to paper a curse upon Rinascita and Ragunna."

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: "Those favored by the Divinity were the most willing to raise the blade of rebellion, for they alone knew how to make Divinity bleed and doctrines crumble."

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: "Though they died in exile to a great fire, their resentment festered in their music and poetry, transforming into horrors known as Daemons."

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: "Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna."

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Let's celebrate together.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: When freedom is unchecked, the insidious evil of division takes root.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: People of the Sentinel, do not lose yourselves in these fleeting pleasures. Remember what unites us all...

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: And now, we await the Holy Maiden's return...

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: And so we arrive at the "happily ever after," yes?

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: But we do not live in a fairy tale. There is no playwright to script a happy ending for us... What lies behind the curtain is but a cruel jest, a dark satire.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Let me reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending. The Holy Maiden has long succumbed to darkness, drawing power from a heretical force and leading her people into depravity.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: And the minister, having uncovered this truth, has vowed to root out this corruption himself.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Righteous One, I come to cleanse Rinascita of a traitorous demon and avenge the blood debts of my people. Why raise your blade against me?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Rinascita teeters on the edge of collapse. Now, more than ever, we must uphold the tenets of Unity and Salvation.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: The path to deliverance lies within the Civilization Capsule. Entrust it to me. By the authority bestowed upon me, I will open... the gates to the divine Paradise.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: ...Bloodshed cannot be avoided. Blood must pay for blood. The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions.

What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Therefore, we must unify all beliefs, ensuring the purity and unity of our will to prevent another tragedy...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: I swear, my words are without deceit.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: I see in your eyes that you have walked further on the path of justice than I anticipated.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: O dear Sentinel... please forgive my transgressions.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: The Dark Tide brought us a bloodstained lesson. To keep our people from faltering, I bound myself to silence, locking away what I witnessed on that fateful day.

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: Yet given the past events, you choose not to trust him and reject the offer, upon which Fenrico throws you into the sea. She then reveals that Fenrico has the Threnodian's residual energy and offers a deal: since both of you seek to reclaim it from the Order, why not work together?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: The Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Ah, so you and the Fractsidus can't agree on how to split the Threnodian's residual energy.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: I serve Their will. It is the only true path.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: As for the hubristic faithless, they deserve no salvation... nor will they obstruct my course...

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Despite our shared enemy, you still choose conflict over cooperation.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Ha, I trust what I see. There is no need for me to ally with you.

Shadow of Glory.desc: Meanwhile, in an unknown place, Cartethyia steps into the same arena, her swords aimed at the playwright Cristoforo.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: But I must admit, I'm astonished you would endure all this for strangers and lands you've never set foot on.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I don't need any grand reason to slay a villain like you. The Threnodian once sought to pull the entire Rinascita into the Dark Tide, but It failed.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: And so will you.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Heh... Madam, surely you know you alone cannot undo my story.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Alone? Rover will come here and find a way to finish this.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: And I will make your so-called perfect play spiral out of control.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Waiting for the day thou shalt consume the world.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: O Righteous One!

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I shall depart without a word.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: The golden city in my childhood legend,

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Is swallowed by the abhorrent tide.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I whisper to my fleeting companion,

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: At the Cathedral of Mercury, Cristoforo reveals Fenrico's plan. In the confrontation, Fenrico suspect that Cristoforo was the one who secretly guided the Poets Society all those years ago.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Or is it... something else you seek?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Out of respect for our partnership, some things are better left unsaid.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Of course. As you will, Lord Fenrico.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Wait... You were the one who led the Poets Society to that lithograph, weren't you?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: I've heard whispers of your presence at Whisperwind Haven around that time. Whenever you were asked, you claimed to be seeking inspiration.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I've sensed a voice calling out to me from behind them... Could it be the Sentinel?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Say, it's really faint so I barely noticed earlier... Is that a Threnodian smell I'm getting from ya?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: The scent of a Threnodian...? You can perceive the Threnodian?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It's not an exact one-to-one with that big "Ova-thracula" meatball I had, but I'd never mix up a flavor I've already tasted.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: You've found Rover and safeguarded Septimont... It's like something out of a knight's tale. Hmm, no, wait... Gladiator's tale?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Phew! Finally, I can stick my head out! Rover, are you okay?!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm fine, Abby. What happened to you earlier?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I… wait, we're already in Septimont?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: I was just talking to you, and then boom! It felt like something just... covered me!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: First, it messed with my frequency, then... I just passed out. Wait! Cartethyia? And a girl I don't know?!

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Well, just holler if you need me.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Greetings, Righteous One. If unanswered questions have left you wary, allow me to guide the path before you.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: With the Divinity's blessing, I follow Their words, for I am bound to Their will.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Blasphemy! I see now how the faithless have led you astray, coaxing you to abandon the righteous path.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm not here to play games. Cut to the chase, what are you after?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Rinascita must be unified and purified, for only then can its people be free from fear and division.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Faith once united us. It was also what drove us to seek liberation... The path of civilization is never fixed. It shifts with what's being demanded at present.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And it's the people of a civilization who decide what they demand.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: ... As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Everyone has their tasks to do now... But in the future...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I want you to have this, Phoebe.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Imperator entrusted me with this relic. Within it is Rinascita's past, and... its future.

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc: Possessing the Resonance Ability to recreate past experiences, Ciaccona enables Rover to relive the encounter with Cartethyia, the Blessed Maiden who was supposedly martyred during the Second Dark Tide. While under the effect of this ability, Rover perceives the past meeting with Cartethyia from a shifted perspective.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: What is the meaning of this?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Someone used their Resonance ability to help me relive this moment, but this seems... unexpected.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: How did you first come to notice me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Sentinel—Imperator's voice guided me to you.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: You heard the Sentinel's voice? Then tell me, am I Their Resonator?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well, Imperator called you "the Lost," and Primus Fenrico claims you are the Resonator for Leviathan, the Threnodian.

Flames of Heart.desc: You begin to piece together everything you've learned about Septimont, Lupa, Cartethyia, Mya, the Dark Tide, and Arsinosa. When you touch the sword of Tercules, a Septimontian hero, Cartethyia's voice abruptly rings throught the air.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I struck a significant blow to the Threnodian within the story, but because I failed to prevent the corruption of the Central Hub earlier. It endured, drawing strength from that source.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Throughout this journey, I often saw the figures of Lupa and Mya overlap…

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: It seems the Threnodian was attempting to replace Lupa, hoping to use her to corrupt the Hub, siphon its power, and ultimately destroy Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Apart from the playwright, I also encountered two other Fractsidus leaders. One, a woman with a bandaged eye, the other a man with scars across his face.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Surely they must be Phrolova and... Scar. But how is Scar in Rinascita?)

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Unfortunately, I never had the chance to confront either of them directly. I saw them only briefly before they disappeared.

Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens.desc: When Phrolova points out that Fenrico is in disarray, you suspect he has fallen under the Threnodian's influence. The second Flashback of Phrolova, this time, you find yourself talking with Fenrico in Ragunna, revealing the true reason for the Fractsidus's involvement in the Carnevale: Deepening people's beliefs helps Leviathan gather and amplify Its power, paving the way for a successful separation of the Divinity, a shared goal between the Order and the Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Speak freely. What is it that you desire?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Travelers from far and wide, a grand celebration upon us... Such a convergence invites chaos, and I fear for Ragunna's stability.

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: Heh, I see your concern. Very well, allow me to lend a hand.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Oh? Are these outsiders also intolerable to you?

lines.speaker: Phrolova
lines.text: No. I simply noticed a new variable on the list.

When the Night Knocks.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

lines.speaker: Encore
lines.text: Here we come, Big Bad Demon!

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: I'll give this show a grand finale.

When the Night Knocks.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: I'll give this show a grand finale.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: If I can help then, I'll... I'll do my best!

When the Night Knocks.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: If I can help then, I'll... I'll do my best!

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It's time to end this charade.

When the Night Knocks.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It's time to end this charade.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Oh, to dance alongside you in battle... I can't wait any longer.

When the Night Knocks.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

lines.speaker: Lumi
lines.text: Hiya, Lumi's here!

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: This fight... better not disappoint me!

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: She is still resonating with... something.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: A Resonator's frequency is usually gone when they die, right? This doesn't make any sense.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There's something even stranger...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Cartethyia had her sword in hand... With her strength, how could she fall to an intruder like that? And... it doesn't look like she even tried to resist.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Sword of Divinity, sealed with a portion of the Sentinel's power... Could what we're seeing be a result of that power of separation being awakened?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Phew... the Dark Tide, huh? I ate some back at the hunting grounds. It tasted kinda funky... made me super sleepy. Ever since then, I've been having the weirdest nightmares...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Abby does... carry the Dark Tide's frequency...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Abby must have absorbed many other frequencies. So while the Dark Tide's frequency lay in wait... it was masked by the others.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It makes sense. You two share life and energy. As the primary in this bond, your frequency has been overriding Abby's... Leviathan planned for this.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Oh, hey! It smells just as "unnatural" as that big gigantor back in Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Sentinel of Jinzhou... If what our little Echo friend says is true, then the frequency that entered your Tacet Mark could be Imperator's powers.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Huh? But the Sentinel isn't even here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The power to split and manipulate space...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It is reminiscent of the moment of Tyrvine's creation. Only this time the place of confinement has become your Tacet Mark.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: But why would it do that?

A Fleeting Night's Dream.desc: A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by. A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Fine... I'll just go take another nap.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Hehe… Things have returned to normal, it seems. How delightful.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It's late… Would you care to come to my castle and rest for the night?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Oh, the pleasure is mine, my dear.

Morning Star III.desc: The kindness once sown now bears fruit.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Ah, Rover. One moment, I'm just finishing up with these rocks!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why are they having you break rocks? And this many?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: The man in charge of it wanted to help the Troupe of Fools unload supplies, so I switched with him!

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: No, no, no. Not at all! Mr. Fratello said all I need to do is "ignite" the hidden perseverance inside of me, and these rocks will be done in no time!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Here, leave it to me.

Morning Star Epilogue.desc: It's time to leave. Have one last talk with Lenore.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Restoration work on the main street is still ongoing, but everything's on track. You can leave it to us!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: When are you planning to reach Phoebe?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Hehe, actually, I wrote her a letter last night. It'll probably come as a shock to her that not only am I alive, but I've become a Resonator too.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You've become a Resonator?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Yes! While singing with everyone last night, I felt a strange power rising inside me. When I checked, there it was, a Tacet Mark!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So what's your Resonance ability?

Morning Star: Those Who Remain in the Ni.desc: Luther makes a surprise visit to the Old District and seems to be after someone. You soon realize who that someone is…

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If he is truly innocent, then all the more reason he should be standing trial.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Then should I...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Alessio will be the spark that ignites the Ragunnesi's rage. Meanwhile, the one who could calm the flames is already behind bars.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Who then will stop this rage from burning the innocent?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: How exactly do we define "innocent"...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's on your mind?

Morning Star II.desc: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Please, Rover. I must answer for my sins... If it's to die by your hand...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did you know that it was Medulius who saved you from the Dark Tide? He did it to thank you for your prayers.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Think of your parents who lifted you from the Dark Tide. The Acolytes who raised you. The Nimbus Sanctum ancestors who helped enlighten you. Even Medulius, who offered you a second chance.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You are the continuation of all their hopes.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lenore, it was Rinascita's kindness that carried you this far. This journey deserves a better ending.

Morning Star: Those Who Remain in the Ni.desc: There seems to be a commotion going on in the Old District, with a noblewoman surrounded by a crowd. She looks all too familiar…

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: The Septimontians don't seem to be bothered by it. Letting her go like that is practically a death sentence... What do you think, Rover?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where there's light, there's always shadow. But that's not an excuse to pledge yourself to the dark.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: For Septimont to march into a new age, it must cut ties with the mistakes of its past.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: ...Am I one of Ragunna's past mistakes, Rover?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: People need a way to let out their anger. But the Threnodian is too abstract, so they need a face to blame. Julia is their scapegoat.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm more worried about Julia ending up like Medulius than getting herself killed.

Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Rainbow.desc: You run into Lenore, an acolyte of the Order, standing next to an Aria Mummer. She seems to be in trouble...

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Oh, I nearly forgot. "Do not gnaw on a fool's worries." Yes, off I go!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hold up. What if I said I can help?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: I cannot accept such a thing! The Tenets of the Deep solemnly instruct, "A trial that is aided by an outside hand is no true trial." Verse 9, Chapter 12.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Consider it a collaboration. The musical records are yours, but the rest of the finds belong to me.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Uh, I mean... I'm sorry, but may I ask why you're offering to help me?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: So you're Phoebe's friend. How time flies... That young girl who once hid behind me has grown into a capable Acolyte. O Great Sentinel, is this part of your grand design as well?

Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm.desc: The time has come to unravel the secrets of the Forbidden Archive...

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: All I know is that the Sentinel gave us Rinascita as a home and the Common Echoes that help us live our lives. The order, guided by the Sentinel, saved me from the Dark Tide and gave me a name, a new life, and a place to belong.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What you've been told has been twisted by the Order to suit its own ends. The true song of your ancestors is locked away, and you, like so many others, choose not to see it.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: I still don't understand...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Order uses everyone's belief in the Sentinel to manipulate, deliberately erasing the history of Rinascita's first people.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Rover, this is very serious slander against the Order! According to the Tenets of the Deep...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hasn't your Primus told you everything he wants you to do in Tenets of the Deep? You've followed those rules without question.

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Rover! What a surprise to see you again so soon!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is this little pavilion the Minor Forbidden Archive?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Haha, you always have such a way with words. The Minor Forbidden Archive is underground, you won't see views like this down there. No, I'm actually at the Tidal Sanctuary to finalize my transfer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're leaving the Minor Forbidden Archive?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Yes... well...

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Rover, I owe you an apology for how I acted that day... I was stubborn.

Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm.desc: The time has come to unravel the secrets of the Forbidden Archive...

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: O Sentinel, please forgive this humble, wandering servant. Forgive me for being moved by such a forbidden thing.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, does the Sentinel here care about such little problems?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We'll talk about that later..

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Rover, what should I do? Should I report this music as heretical to the Order? Why do I hesitate? Am I losing my faith?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about the others?

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: We're good! The Lioness of Glory caught us! What a sight to behold!

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Dragon of Dirge lent its aid as well.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Alright. Let's all meet up ahead.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: And while the dark hero has sadly gone, our Laureate is here for us to cheer on!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Ahem...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
