lines.text: Well, it was such an epic fight. If I can spin it into a song, maybe it'll live on in the hearts of Ragunna and Septimont, and all of Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Through this song, the land will rise anew, and the names of all the fallen will never fade...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Heh, but there's another player in this tale...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: He was neither Ragunnesi nor Septimontian. Have you heard the story of this outlander?

The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier.desc:
=== Meeting Ciaccona ===
As Rover contemplates how to locate the Inverted Tower referenced by Imperator, Abby proposes an aerial approach, suggesting the cliff near Egla Town as a suitable launch point. Along the way, Rover encounters Ciaccona, a wandering bard dispatched by Carlotta to assist in the journey.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Well... I suppose this won't count as me getting distracted, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If Carlotta asked you to find me, has something happened?

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Lady Carlotta told me you encountered the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: She dispatched search teams soon after, but there's been no sign of Cartethyia since.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: That's why she asked me to use my Forte to recreate the frequency you experienced at the time, to see if any details you might have missed become clearer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Recreate the frequency?

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery. Ciaccona takes you to a moonlit shore, a place where Ragunna's poets and musicians are known to bury their instruments.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Try it!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's a real apple...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Later, when I finally decided to leave, I looked up through the gaps in the branches and suddenly saw a blooming flower atop a cliff.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Turns out, even without an apple, inspiration may yet strike. But if I hadn't stood there, I might've missed that unexpected burst of beauty.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: So… maybe this is enough. Let's put aside heavy thoughts and continue our walk with a clear mind.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm starting to understand why Carlotta calls you "Topaz".

All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Haha, looks like the legend of the very first Apex Duelist won't end with me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If you had bested me, you'd be on your way to becoming the next legend.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Haha, but no. That path isn't meant for me. I'm a wandering bard, remember?

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: I don't become the legend. I walk beside it, witness it, weave it into song, and most of all, tell its story.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: And the hero of this story is you, Rover, the Apex Duelist.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Look forward to the song I'll write, a song born from this duel, Rover!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The poison Leviathan leaves behind... Allow the Fisalias to cleanse it.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Aren't you coming to the Moon-Chasing Festival?

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: No. I'll stay here. Festivities don't suit the Ghost Hounds.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But people want to hear your stories.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Instead of just watching over them, letting them know you're here might bring them more peace of mind.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: ...I'll think about it.

All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Mysterious one? I never hid my identity from him. Maybe he just enjoys adding dramatic flair.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Are you here for a mission or something? This spot overlooks the Ephor's Palace...

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: You might have misunderstood. I did come here on a mission, but it had nothing to do with the Ephor. And the job's already done.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Just a habit from the field. High ground's easier for scouting, and less chance of drawing attention.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: More importantly, this place makes for a perfect stage for a duel with the Apex Duelist.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Take out your Terminal and let's see who walks away the victor.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: No one gets the "Ghost Hounds" to work for free. Abbowser needs to pay for breaking its promise. Plus, I need to collect our payment: 500 Cube snacks.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: I never knew I was worth so much!

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: I would've never been captured if not for the fierce electrical currents in the water.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: I never imagined the bounty on my head would be 500 Cube snacks! A new record, indeed!

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: ...No, you were only worth half a Cube snack.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Abbowser promised us payment and agreed to triple the amount for every hour of delay.

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: As it will take me.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Today, as yesterday...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: We weave time beneath the tide.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Swim, swim!

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Wretched yet lovely fish!

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Dream deeply in my fiction,

Flames of Heart.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: First, it messed with my frequency, then... I just passed out. Wait! Cartethyia? And a girl I don't know?!

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: Heh, you're lively. Your Echo's more boisterous than a Ta-da!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: W-what happened while I was out?!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Still, breaking me out right under Mingting's nose without setting off a single alarm... Delicious. Tell me, how did you come up with that little idea?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Let's just say it was inspired by the Somnoire. Imagination, after all, remains humanity's sharpest blade.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: As the Dark Tide spread and I was pulled in deeper, the mark of the Dark Tide you left in me allowed my frequency to merge with it...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Of course. And through Leviathan's power, I was able to "read" that frequency and "depict" you back into reality.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Leviathan's power of assimilation blurs the line between imagination and existence, turning fiction into fact.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: But of course, none of it would have worked until Leviathan slipped the Sentinel's leash and reclaimed the reins of the Dark Tide.

Lollo Campaign, Set Sail VI.desc: It's time for the Vault to assess Bakethoven's capabilities. Can its dream finally come true?

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Rover, you're here! We're all set.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Hope you don't mind if I watch too. I just finished up with work when you arrived, and I'm genuinely curious to see how this Echo performs.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: I just finished up with work when you arrived. I'm genuinely curious to see how this Echo performs.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Haha, of course, you're more than welcome to watch Bakethoven in action!

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: The appraiser is here as well. Shall we get started?

Memory Travelogue (Quest).desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: ...I'll think about it.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Rover, can you hear me? Where are you? Everyone's waiting for you at the Moon-Chasing Festival...

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: You should go now, Rover.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Until next time.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Lady Carlotta has a good rating for you. Securing a position shouldn't be an issue.

lines.speaker: Calcharo
lines.text: Thanks. I'll make sure to repay you.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: No need. I get a bonus for successful referrals.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Phoebe, we now need to take an inventory of the leftover plates, forks, and candles from the ceremony. Additionally...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Understood. I will help as much as I can.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: No need to worry about all that! I've already taken care of everything.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Lollo Logistics has already packed it all up! Mission accomplished!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: But we haven't counted everything yet...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: You two really have... very different personalities.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: That Septimontian Gladiator... Our scouts saw him advancing into the depths of Thessaleo Fells.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Lady Cantarella! Rover! Reinforcements have arrived!

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Thessaleo Fells... It's already... Attention! Deploy all Acolytes to set up temporary Resonance Beacons. Scattering the Light of Genesis will hold back the Tidespawn!

lines.speaker: Resolute Acolyte
lines.text: Acolyte Phoebe! A cluster of Tidespawn is marching toward the depths of Thessaleo Fells！

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Rover, Avidius is our mission.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: I'll use my Forte to diffuse the family's antidote. It should help to mitigate the Dark Tide's influence.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Rosemary has already dispersed the family's medicine in mist form. Thanks to that, treatment has been smoother than expected. The injured will be tended to shortly.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Repairs on the Genesis Nexus are still underway, but some damaged Common Echoes are already operational again.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: I'm actually feeling better... Phew, that almost got me. Guess there's no need to cleanse it after all.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Oops, it seems I accidentally released the enhancing smoke instead.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Try this one... It should suit you well.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Hmm... This is very different from the last bottle. It smells like... the sea. As if I have returned to the Black Shores... to... home.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Yes, you're right. I really like this perfume.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: I'm pleased to hear that. It seems I have a knack for finding the perfect match for others.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Now, please accept this as a gift to mark our first meeting.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Huh? But...

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I'm so sorry about all this. I never imagined that the whole anniversary would turn into such a mess!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Worry not. The ceremony is not finished yet. We can still light the candle to continue it.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Yes, you're right! It slipped my mind!

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: However, we still lack some essential materials. To ensure a truly grand ceremony, we need to plan very carefully...

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: That's alright, we can start the work first! Abbowser isn't done yet, so let's push forward. The materials won't be a concern.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Because from here on out, I'll make up for my mistakes with action!

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It appears your dispositions are quite different... Look over there.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: What have you done?!

lines.speaker: Abbowser
lines.text: Hey, stop hitting me! Wasn't this your idea?

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: My idea?!

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: I asked you to arrange everyone in the same level so they could get to know each other. I never told you to lock them up!

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: I never imagined a fish from the depths could dance with fire... A delightful collaboration, Lady Changli.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: It is always a pleasure to accept your invitation. Thanks to it, I was able to witness such a magnificent display of fire.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Indeed... But what if the fire were to burn beyond just these anniversary flames?

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: Oh? Then where does the Fisalia family intend to let it burn? Are you playing an offensive or defensive game here?

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Like ten espressos.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I do appreciate the "sleeping smoke." Now we can finish the game faster.

lines.speaker: Changli
lines.text: I look forward to having a proper chat with this Lady Cantarella, should we have the chance.

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: In return, should any complications arise, the Black Shores are to fulfill their side of the agreement and provide us with the necessary technical support.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: A Consultant active in Rinascita?

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That's right. Her name is Buling. An interesting young lady. Left quite an impression on me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So it is her...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why don't you let me handle contacting the Black Shores, Augusta?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We... talk from time to time. It'll help make things smoother for us.

By Moon's Fated Light.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Bruno has already filled you in on the Rosebearer matter, yes? How are the celebrations treating you?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Augusta, do you remember Iuno?

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Iuno?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yes, she was often by your side. The one with the bow like the moon. She joined our hunt for the Sovereign...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Everyone has forgotten... No, that's not it. Everyone says they've never even seen her before.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: But you, you remember her. You remember everything that happened. You are certain she is real and cannot exist in your memories alone.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Rover, your arrival is appreciated.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Iuno. We know each other.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

Shadow of Glory.desc: During this time, you ask her about Ephor Augusta and Priestess Iuno.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I kept seeing Lupa and Mya overlap with each other as well.)

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Brilliant performance, warriors.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Remember, this is more than just a title. It is a testament to your own strength and wisdom in overcoming your opponents. You've earned the right to claim it.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: This medal once belonged to a single champion, the last survivor standing in the ring.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: I divided it into two to remind you that...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Just as we fight alongside Echoes, the glory of Septimont is upheld by heroes who support one another to remain steadfast.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, (Righteous One).

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Each day to come holds more hope than the last.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Septimont will have many matters demanding our attention. Ragunna will be no different.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Leave Septimont to us. Ragunna's problems... Well, they're looking a lot more complicated than ours.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Yes, we saw it. The Anchor Stone has been activated. Sooner than expected...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: My family's potions are ready, but please, a word...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It's been crafted from the Threnodian's venom. Outside the corruption's reach, it induces hallucinations—warping your senses and clouding judgment.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: If you aren't immediately entering the Dark Tide, I advise you all not to drink it.

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Well, there you have it. That's the gist of it. Ugh, finally some time together, and now it's all ruined...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I don't understand. Given Augusta's prestige, the Senate has no real advantage in seizing power. What's their angle?

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: It all started when Augusta shook things up the moment she became Ephor. Especially in rooting out corruption within the Gladiator's Agon while ignoring the senators in the process.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Naturally, it ruffled some feathers. Some even accused her of "undermining the spirit of Gladiating." In reality, they're just upset their piggy banks got smashed.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: More importantly...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: This is exactly the kind of chaos Augusta wanted. That idiot!

By Moon's Fated Light.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Chaos won't disturb us here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sitting just like that, huh? You're still just as... spontaneous.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Shh, Unwritten.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: It's time for a rest. Come sit with me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I've never said it properly before, and I don't know if you fully understand it now... but now that I've found you, I will bring you back. I won't stop until I do.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Because you said it, I believe you.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Did you come straight from Ragunna?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I did. Has it begun here too? I see you're starting evacuations.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: An unannounced High Tide. But that term doesn't even begin to cover it.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: No signs. No patterns. The Dark Tide's spawn are surfacing at random... even outside the City of Septimont.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: As for me, I'm helping out here. Someone has to stop the panic from turning into a stampede.

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: If we can stir up the mess in its gut, even with something small, we might just throw him off balance. And then, maybe we can wrest the Earthrend Wedge back and readjust it to—

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Terrible timing... Is there any other way to reach her?

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: It's the Dark Tide...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The entire frequency range is under its control. In other words, we're completely cut off here.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Tch, how vexing.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: The Dark Tide's inside...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: You're asking if I can brew enough to carry all of us into the Journeying Paradise... If we're ready to face Leviathan.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Yes. It's been a long time. I never imagined I'd see my past like this.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hmm... I'm curious...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: About Manes Deep and the Oak Hollow?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: ...The name Fabianum once stood for glory.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: As Septimont's frontline against the Dark Tide, it held the honor of receiving legends like Fabius, Atilius, and Valeria.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Rover... Keep your wits about you once you're inside the Dark Tide.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Don't worry! I'll stick with every step of the way!

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Just remember, you're not going in alone, Rover. When the time comes, we will be right behind you.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: If you're ready. Step forward.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Lady Cantarella, how many of your family's potions remain?

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: You're asking if I can brew enough to carry all of us into the Journeying Paradise... If we're ready to face Leviathan.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Rover, this is Rinascita's fight. It is neither your duty to shoulder it alone, nor our desire to see you do so. We will not have you face the Threnodian alone.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The Priestesses foresaw this, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." If that is our fate, we must meet it head-on.

The One that Impresses.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Pero, stop scaring people.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Nope, Pero is wrong! It's all real, and it's all stories!

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Oh, what's your name?

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: ...Roccia.

lines.speaker: Cosmos
lines.text: Roccia! You and Pero must be the captains of the Cube Adventure Squad! I'm the vice-captain of the Wooly Adventure Squad. We should play together!

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Photo time's over.

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Ms. Margherita!

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Well, hello, hello! If it isn't Rover and Ciaccona!

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Oh, Miss Ciaccona is a regular around here, you know. I've even asked her to perform a few times. Helps bring in the crowds!

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Actually, I've come to ask a favor of you today, Ms. Margherita. I'm sure you've heard the rumors circulating lately...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: About the Poets Society's legacy. There's something important we'd like to share. Could you help us gather everyone?

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Not a problem at all! Did you make any big discoveries? I'm so curious about what actually happened. It's driving me nuts!

Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest).desc: While you and Ciaccona are separated in the crowd, Cristoforo appears next to Ciaccona, telling a story about a caged bird, as if hinting at something deeper. Cristoforo's words echo in Ciaccona's mind.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: This speech you made just now... You're implying the poets of the Golden Anthem were framed and their works deliberately misinterpreted?

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Exactly. Someone used the story of the Golden Anthem to stir the public's curiosity. This is what created the Daemons.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: If memory serves, official records of the Order of the Deep state the poets were charged with blasphemy against the Sentinel.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Surely you're not suggesting this was all the Order's doing? I dare say... such remarks would be considered a grave crime punishable by banishment.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Are you from a noble family? The city's elite have a habit of siding with the Order.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Haha, I'm afraid you misunderstand... I admit I do get that question quite often. I am but a traveling playwright.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: But if he's not here, then I'll seek out the "Blessed Maiden"... or Rover.

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Hello there! You are...

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: From Huanglong, right? I assume from the style of your clothing. Are you travelling? Rinascita does offer some marvelous views...

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Sir Leon? And this is...?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Qiuyuan.

lines.speaker: Leon
lines.text: I might not have survived if not for this kind soul from Huanglong.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: My deepest gratitude for your aid.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Tacet Discords have appeared in the city without the slightest forewarning—

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: But that's not the whole story.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: I can sense lingering frequencies in a place.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: The Sentinel is no more, the Blessed Maiden is gone, and now the Dark Tide descends...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You are outnumbered.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: You said you met with Mingting's officials. That means you had an audience not just with Grandmaster Liang, but with the Grand Marshal, too.

A Stranger in a Strange Land.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: What happened to him?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: He fell into Ovathrax's abyss.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: And shared my fate...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Maybe when we first met, he still held on to a shred of goodness. But even so, it didn't stop his end from coming.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: You should have killed him when you had the chance.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: History grants no second chances. And the dead do not return.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Just as we were about to take the potion and enter the Dark Tide, the Fractsidus triggered its surge. Leviathan pulled us into Its illusion.

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: But... the Echoes swallowed by the Dark Tide protected us. They brought us the time we needed to drink it.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The Priestesses foresaw this, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." If that is our fate, we must meet it head-on.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Rinascita will not falter just because a few of its leaders are gone. Its people will rise.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: We'll meet again in the Paradise and end this together... Leviathan will fall

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: Rover, we all understand the burden you carry. We are grateful.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: This calamity... ends here. For good.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: That Primus got what he wanted. He fulfilled the fate he desired for Rinascita.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: The Threnodian's creatures have been defeated. They never broke through our defenses. With the Dark Tide now receding, it seems that all is resolved.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: I only played a small part. It was the courage of these warriors that truly held the line.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: Luuk Herssen reviews your report: your frequency is stable and you're not in immediate danger, but the portion already lost cannot be traced.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Ah, what a rare visitor. I assumed the Void Storm, those Voidworms, and your admission would've kept you too busy to drop by.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Fractsidus have contacts inside the Academy. They're planning an attack on the Research Institute.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: That's... certainly surprising news.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: And what do you need from a school doctor like me? Or... should I say, why come to me at all?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Because I'm still new to the Academy. Professor Mornye isn't around, and I have no way to judge if I'm passing the message on to the right person.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: And you trust me?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: The activation sequence was used only to seal hatches and lock equipment. After that... nothing.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can you see who activated it?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Hold on... Yes. Clearance belonged to Clemente.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (The one who gathered the droplets...?)

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: That's all I can pull for now, but the Academy will run a full investigation later. I'll keep you in the loop.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Good. Keep me posted.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Even for the Fractsidus.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're saying the fall of Helios wasn't their real goal?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: It was one of several. After your journey in Huanglong and Rinascita, I'm sure you've come to realize their true aim.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Threnodian. Aleph-1.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Correct. Given the Threnodian's unique nature, it's sure to catch their attention. Moreover, Aleph-1 is closely linked to the Stridergate, which may be our ticket to outer space.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Spying on the Fractsidus is risky. Why would I have chosen you for this task?

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Their Grand Architect tipped us off about their plans in Lahai-Roi, that he will play a game with us.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: It seems the "game" she referred to is this riddle event our students are so fond of.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: We've already tracked the participants. The effects of these riddles are already spilling into their real lives.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Some abandoned their research projects. Others are lashing out at classmates... and a few have lost control entirely.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: These students have all become pawns in the Fractsidus's little show.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're one of them, Sigrika.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: I've been flooding their desks with reports. Your Academy investigation record, your latest test scores from Rabelle College, and a full physical adaptability eval I wrote myself...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And? Were they rejected?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: We got a meeting. But when that much money's involved, conflicts of interest make everything move very slowly.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Unlike Jinzhou or Rinascita, they've got far too many "cooks" in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm worried we don't have that kind of time.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Exactly. Which is why we're going to strike first. Besides, things have changed.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Things will get busy again soon. You'll need to stay focused, but not wound up like a spring. Stress leads to bad calls.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I've rested up. Don't worry.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Good. I'm a psychiatrist, after all. Happy to know my patient is actually following my advice for once.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I can't really relax until this is over.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: I see. I sympathize, but can't say I approve. Once this is all settled, remember to give yourself a break.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: As for the Exostrider plan we discussed earlier, there's been a development.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Ah, Rover, perfect timing. We were about to go look for you if you took any longer.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why's everyone...

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Happy graduation! Hmm, I never thought I'd be saying that to you so soon.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Is that regret I'm getting from you?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Saying goodbye to an old friend again will always be cause for regret. But in itself, graduation is a good thing. It's the start of something new.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: I've seen off plenty of graduates over the years. Each time, including this one, I'm struck by the same sentiment. All that bright hope and energy... that's what has kept me here in Lahai-Roi all this time.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: If I remember correctly, you're heading back to Jinzhou, yes? That city over in Huanglong.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: That's right.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Something else on your mind?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: She's vulnerable to external frequency interference. That unique Tacet Discord you mentioned seems to be targeting that weakness. Pouring salt in the wound.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is there a treatment?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Conditions like these don't have a quick fix. Recovery comes from a sense of safety and support, as well as time.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: All we can do is to hold space for her. The real work of healing must come from within.

Snack Deficit Syndrome.desc: Based on your feedback, Luuk Herssen has refined his waffle recipe once more. Yet, the fresh batch vanished mysteriously just two minutes after he left! What kind of being could act so fast? To recover the stolen treats, Luuk Herssen has sent you a "commission." Head to the infirmary and begin your investigation into this Case of the Missing Waffles.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Could it be that calico cat?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Nicely deduced. If it's a small campus animal, one that can easily stay out of sight, it's no wonder it avoided the cameras.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If that cat is the culprit... it couldn't have finished the entire plate on the spot.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: But when I returned to the infirmary, the plate was empty.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Looks like it packed the rest and left. Question is—where?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: [System Notification] Unknown Contact: Abnormal Missing Waffle Case Detected—Please confirm your identity ASAP to obtain Reward Points. Immediate mobilization of Human Resources or Appointed Assistant Rover is recommended for on-site investigation. Otherwise, your Reward Points w

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Where did this push notification come from?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Well, well. The system alert formatting really did make it look convincing. Hello, Rover. Would my "Appointed Assistant" choose to accept this mission?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: We have a missing waffle case on our hands, and the suspect is still at large.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: You know I can see your name in the contacts, right?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Oh, I can't believe you figured it out! Looks like I need to work on my system alert formatting.

A Fluffy Prescription.desc: Luuk Herssen messages you that while he was relaxing at the celebration and scouting for potential adopters, the kitten got spooked and slipped out of its cage. A "criminal" like this cannot be allowed to roam free! For the safety of waffles everywhere, head to the teaching building, track down this fluffy fugitive, and bring it back to the infirmary.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I mean, "It can really help people unwind."

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: So this is the break you want me to enjoy?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's just my thought. It's up to you.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: To be honest, I don't find the idea unacceptable. But bringing a new life into my own is something I shouldn't take lightly...

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: For instance, the cat would need its own space to explore, clean water, nutritious and balanced food, and of course, enough toys to play with.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: My temporary booth got crowded so quickly, and the cat got so scared that it escaped during a cage transfer.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Which way did it run?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Looks like it was headed toward the teaching building. I normally would have caught it, but it's just so crowded today...

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: The volunteers are managing the crowd, and I'm occupied as well. Could you bring it back to the infirmary? It should feel comfortable with you around.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Understood.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Sorry to trouble you. I'll be back in a minute!

Immunodeficiency of Snacks.desc: In the final stage of your detective game, you have deduced the identity of the thief who made off with the waffles in under two minutes, but the important waffles remain gone. Where would a tiny feline suspect hide its spoils? "A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed." Following this lead, head to the preparation team's warehouse with Luuk Herssen.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Well, it's starting to feel at home now.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Since the Academy allows animal adoptions, let's take it to the shelter.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: The standard animal adoption process for students is rather complicated. But there are ways to navigate it more smoothly.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: For example, we could start with background checks for students and support staff. Then, we could invite a select group to the adoption event....

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: …So you already had everything figured out on the way back?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: The young have the luxury of thinking one step at a time. But as adults, we always have to think a few steps further.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Feel free to come by and see it when you're free.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Should I take some waffles?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: As a doctor, I have to advise against it. Your company is more than enough.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: If we surrender to its cuteness, I may have to face a dire consequence.}}

The Heartbeat of Life.desc: With the New Solar Celebration concluded, Luuk Herssen has stayed true to his word and taken a well-earned vacation. To mark the start of his break, he has prepared a fresh batch of waffles and invited you over. How will the new waffles taste, and is the doctor getting along with his new feline roommate? Head to the Infirmary to catch up with Luuk Herssen.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Perhaps some cats aren't really cut out for being indoor pets. The fact that it keeps coming back probably means it already considers this home.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Do you think it will always come back to you?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Maybe... Or maybe not. Well, it's not like I can have a counseling session with a cat and have it open up to me.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: For such a free-spirited little creature, there's no controlling it. Perhaps all I can do is give it the space to be free and go wherever it pleases.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So that's why you're not forcing it to stay.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Yes. It's a lot like life itself. We can only control so much, but there's so much more we can appreciate.

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: We both deserve a good rest and some relaxation before the next one arrives.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: We're not done yet...

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Let me guess, did Lucilla ask you to handle the cleanup? Or were you given some kind of unavoidable assignment?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: Well... sometimes these two can actually be the same. All I can do is wish you luck from over here.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Are you on vacation too?

phone.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phone.text: I wish I could... But unfortunately, I still have some cleanup to finish and prepare for the upcoming Dark Side trip.

Waffle Therapy.desc: To match the warmth and wonder of the New Solar Celebration, Luuk Herssen has baked a fresh batch of waffles. A message arrives at your Terminal riding a beam of sunlight—an invitation as soft as a waffle and as rich as a latte. It's such a sunny day. While you have a moment, head to the infirmary to try Luuk Herssen's latest creation.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: The New Solar Celebration is in full swing. The venues must be so lively right now. So, have you had a chance to join in the fun?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Already did.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: I've heard the decorations there are just lovely. Makes me want to go take a look myself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Haven't had the chance to go yet.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Regardless, it's a rare festive occasion. Go and have some fun. Take some time off.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So are you going?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mornye?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: My, my. Already caused a stir in the training grounds? Color me impressed.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I'll have people clean up the aftermath. You can carry on as you see fit.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You were monitoring my comms with Mornye?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You're a person of special interest. Of course we keep an eye on your movements.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: "We"?

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is it influencing them?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Maybe... the signal...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: President Lucilla?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: ...Hello? Can you hear—

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Find the clock... leave... wait for you outside...

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'm concerned other students might be getting similar riddles.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Very well. We'll trace it.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Focus on your investigation and be careful.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: And you realized she was a fake when she said, "Should finding an answer really be so important?"

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You got it all right... Amazing how much you learned just from that single card.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: To me, your memories play like a film. I can pause and study them frame by frame.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: So, what happened after the fake Sigrika revealed herself?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Then... there was a rabbit. I remember chasing it, the same one I saw right after entering the Dark Side.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I see. Thank you, Rover. I think I've found what I needed.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Sorry to bother you at this hour, Rover.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: The President using cute emojis? No way. Who are you, really?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Well, seems our dear student has quite an "interesting" bias against the faculty.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Maybe I should add a new course. Startorch Guidelines: From Strangers to Confidants.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: As for its final exam, what about "How to spend a wonderful day with your teacher"?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Jokes aside. Let's get down to business. I want to discuss the Academy's Dark Side with you.

The Flaming Red from Tomorrow.desc: After the Dark Side incident comes to an end, Lucilla meets with Hiyuki at the auditorium. Lucilla suspects that the Fractsidus may be plotting something far more dangerous behind the scenes...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Long story short, we've found traces of Aemeath's frequency.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: In the active Voidmatter zone beneath Lahai-Roi. Do you remember that white-haired miko you met, the one with the blade?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: She's been helping us out with the investigation lately. Like you, she's trying to track down any sign of Aemeath.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Long story short, we've found traces of Aemeath's frequency.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: In the active Voidmatter zone beneath Lahai-Roi. Do you remember that white-haired miko you met, the one with the blade?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: She's been helping us out with the investigation lately. Like you, she's trying to track down any sign of Aemeath

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There's something else. I need a favor.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Go on, Rover.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Fractsidus is lying low. Even after failing in the Dark Side, they could move the moment the Stridergate opens.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah. That's what's on your mind. Well, I have an update. Remember Sigrika's friend? The… somewhat lackadaisical one?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You mean Denia?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That's the one. She's gone missing. Our investigation points to her being the agent the Grand Architect referred to.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Are you back?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Still trying to wrap my head around everything.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Yes, I'm back. About the Exostrider...

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: It's alright. We already know. Your safe return is what matters now.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Anyway, come meet us at the Research Institute. Everyone's been waiting for you.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Got it.}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I need to stop by the Conference Hall before heading back. Care to walk with me?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: *A tired sigh*

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: When was the last time you slept?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Can't remember.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The last time you ate?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Are you hanging in there alright?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I could ask you the same.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Let's regroup ASAP.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Agreed. The space here seems to be constantly shifting. We'll need to rendezvous in a memory vivid enough for me. Keep this photo I'm sending over.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Find a suitable place. You know what to do... And keep your wits about you, Rover. Don't get yourself lost in a memory.}}

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're all here...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah, Rover. I knew everyone would want to see you off, so I rounded up whoever I could.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: So, Rover... which one are you?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: You can bet I'll be back.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Heh, I knew you'd say that.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What do you think?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: You've always been a tricky one to read, but I think that for you, the answer doesn't even matter.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: That's because you're definitely coming back.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I'll keep digging, but I should warn you: the New Fed's been gathering intel on you lately. Seems like you've caught their interest.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Seems like you also find them a handful to deal with.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You're not wrong. I don't know what's piqued your sudden interest in New Fed history, but you need to be careful.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ugh. New Federation, New Federation. Ever since that review conference, it feels like I can't go a day without that name popping up.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Oh, speaking of which, a student mentioned today that a perfumer girl from the Federated Cities was spotted on campus.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Either my students aren't getting enough sleep, or that perfumer isn't... The Federated Cities haven't been a thing for decades.

So as the Melting Snow Desires.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: If you're free, meet me at the Academic Affairs Office.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Understood. I'm on my way.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Got it. I'll head over now.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Wait... Something just came up. You know, the usual pointless reporting and corporate rhetoric.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Hiyuki will meet you there instead.}}

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Thanks for backing Lenie up, Rover. You went out of your way.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You did, too.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Hehe... It's my job to look after my students. I owe you one for this, actually.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Let me buy you a drink sometime.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is that even allowed at the Academy?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Absolutely. This is what we call "adult discretion." Perfectly above board.}}

\"Life is Beautiful\".desc: After a long period of relentless work, Lucilla has finally carved out a good stretch of time off. Before the next busy season sweeps in, she seizes the chance to fulfill her old promise: watching that long-delayed film with you. "Time waits for no one. The final screening begins now!"

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Rover, if you could only remember one thing a day, what would you choose?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's hard to decide.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Yes. It's something we can't answer until that day comes.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So what did Laurene choose to remember?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: She told herself, "I must never, ever give up."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She's brave.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Feels like the perfect time to watch that footage. What do you say, hero?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Sure. When?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Tomorrow afternoon at one. I'll meet you outside the auditorium.}}

\"Department of Engineering Repair Scene.desc: On a day that started out like any other, you receive an unexpected message. The mere fact that the ever-busy Lucilla reached out at all is a rarity in itself. She brings two pieces of bad news: one concerns you, and the other... well, that concerns you, too. "If a movie trailer were written this way, I'd accuse the PR department of being lazy. Then again, some of the best films start exactly the same way."

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Figures. They're always so reliable.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So what is it, exactly...?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Footage from my Pioneer Association days, when I was leading a research team. Recorded on a bodycam.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Some of the data was damaged in an accident. I thought it was lost forever.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You must really miss those days.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I miss every day that's already passed.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Well, I've got a double dose of bad news. Which would you like first?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I simply want good news.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Then let's start with the lesser of the two evils.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: First up, my search for the perfect movie to share has come up empty.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: That's fine. We can take our time.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: I agree. Now, the other one. My projector broke down in class yesterday.

\"Life of a Resonator\".desc: Even with her schedule packed to the brim, Lucilla still made time to point you toward the Academy's finest view. Gardens are often where stories unfold—be they horror or romance—but on this campus, the faculty ensures they remain strictly for relaxation. Head to the garden and admire the greenery so meticulously tended to by the support staff. "Awaiting my message? I'm afraid I really am swamped this time."

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Just as you can't change a movie by wishing at the screen, conventional treatments won't work for memory-type Resonators. She can only find her way out by herself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How long would that take?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Maybe by tomorrow morning. Maybe a lifetime.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So she's...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Applying to quit the Academy.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Life here has simply become too heavy for her.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Oh right, you mentioned coffee keeps you up. How about trying some plant-based milk instead?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'm interested.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: The Academy swears by it for anyone needing to relax. Might be worth a shot.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Not really interested.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: That's too bad. I'll just have to find something better to recommend next time.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Got a little time today?

\"4½\".desc: Lucilla has hit a snag trying to pick the right film. She invites you to help her navigate the "vast sea of movies" to find the perfect one. Head to the library and pick out a film that catches your eye. "The movies we love are always connected to us in some way. Sometimes the link sparks an instant memory. Other times, it's like dust on a film reel, hidden in shadows the naked eye can barely perceive."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Have you watched it?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That one? Not yet.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Too much going on. I'm not ready for distractions.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why don't we watch it when you are free?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That sounds lovely. Once I'm done with the things at hand, let's watch it together.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds good.

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: Since we'll be watching together, why don't you pick one?

phone.speaker: Lucilla
phone.text: It's a deal then. I'll meet you at the library.}}

\"Festivals Don't Encore\".desc: The New Solar Celebration belongs to the students, not the faculty keeping order, and certainly not the president overseeing it all. You've grown used to Lucilla's packed schedule. That one movie you watched together seemed to be the only leisure she could steal. But today, just outside the venue, you spot her looking remarkably relaxed... "How's that for a teaser?"

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: So I've arranged for reliable people to watch over things. No need to panic.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So, what really brings you here…

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Simply to enjoy the festival.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Now, now, relax those shoulders, Rover. The New Solar Celebration doesn't come often. It'd be a shame to miss it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The venue's lively. You should check it out.

Roaming Till the End.desc: The Star Bouncing game has come to an end. It's time to meet the person behind its creation..

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Well, even I find myself craving something fresh to break up the daily grind every now and then. And honestly, with so many brilliant students around, I never have to look far for a spark of inspiration.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So adding Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks into the game was also part of your plan?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: It works like a catalyst. Otherwise, the game would be far too boring and bland.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And Dr. Luuk?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: That's none of my business. He signed up for it himself.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: He volunteered to make sure everything stayed under control. Makes sense to me. It's his invention, after all.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: You don't plan to misbehave too, do you?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's not why I'm here. The Exostrider is critical not just to the Collective, but to all of Lahai-Roi. I wouldn't act without authorization. Not for "my own" sake.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This is a gift from someone the miko once protected. Handmade. Think you could pass it to her?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And tell her I do want to save Aemeath. More than anything. But I don't want anyone else getting hurt for it either.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Hah... You two might actually get along. Which is saying something. Hiyuki doesn't exactly do small talk.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Both of you have a "savior complex." As an educator, I'm here to tell you that isn't a good thing.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: …I can call forth the power sleeping within.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What invoked the one we saw before?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I have no idea... I tried to trace the source, but those runes seemed to come from nowhere.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's worth a closer look. We should go back into the Dark Side.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Then we're going to need this.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hello? Can you hear me, Didi? Wake up. It's Sigrika. Time to work.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Everything matches. I'm spotting every Royan rune site in Bjartr Woods on this map.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (But what about the other coordinates...)

Beneath a Melting Night Sky.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: What a terrifying thought, Nia...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Taste aside, the operational procedure was very clear about food intake. I should check with Arman...)

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: I'm just going through the motions... She can eat it for me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I happen to know a team that specializes in desserts. We could order a cake from them if you want.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What kind of style are you thinking of?

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you check on her for me? I've been asking N.A.N.A. for updates, but she tells me the same thing every time... I'm worried.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Got it.

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: Appreciate you, Senior! ヾ(ﾟ▽ﾟ)ノ}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (So that's why she was drowsy in class... She's been staying up late tutoring other students.)

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: You know... like, "So long, Startorch cafeteria food," or "Goodbye, student life"...things like that? Sometimes when I'm drowning in assignments, I daydream about moments like this...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I wish I could stay longer here at the Academy...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: You'll get your chance! Besides, I heard President Lucilla say she wants to invite you back as a teaching assistant.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's time to meet what's ahead of me.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Oh, you haven't changed a bit, Senior. Always got something you want to do.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: And that's a good thing!

Sunny Season.desc: Now that Denia's gone missing, Arman invites you to discuss something about her at the Research Institute.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: It's been the kind of day that when I look back, I'll be able to say with confidence, "I'm finally on the path to making my dreams a reality!"

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Mmm. I know what you mean, Senior.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Lately ... whenever I have a moment to myself, I keep thinking about that afternoon we spent with Denia.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: That's why I wanted to meet you today.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: There's something I really want to make sure with you.

A Perfect Day for Flying.desc: Even an island that has slumbered for years may hold sights that have withstood the test of time. At Sigrika's invitation, your journey into the unknown begins...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hmm... These statues... I've seen them before.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Are they Royan?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: That's right... But something feels strange...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The statues and the shadows below the ice... They're facing different directions.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hehe, I know how to solve this! My family taught me this trick!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Alright—drumroll, please! Currie's about to save the day! All we have to do is rotate these shadows until they're in the same direction as the statues.

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: Senior!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What's going on?!

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: Senior!

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: Oooh, I'm so sorry! The reception here is terrible...

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: Why does it keep sending the same message over and over?!

phone.speaker: Sigrika
phone.text: I didn't mean to do that. I swear!

Ground Engravings.desc: Sigrika is practicing tirelessly at the training grounds, striving to sketch every rune with absolute precision. The weight of everyone's expectations propels her forward, but her nerves have stretched thin, tense as a bowstring pushed past its limit. Even so, she presses on, unaware that her stubborn determination is pushing her toward a suffocating mire...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: How did I miss something like that before? After all the practices I had…

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Maybe you just needed a breather.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: ...But I don't think I've fully mastered it...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: So resting… is an important part of learning too?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Okay then, let's go watch birds!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Yep! It's the breeding season of Blubbin Puffin! They're everywhere on campus!

Creases on Paper.desc: Sigrika returns to her room. Her moments of vulnerability in the Academy's Dark Side replay on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with embarrassment. Even hugging her favorite plushie can't stop the blushing. (This is so humiliating... No, Sigrika! You have to apologize to Senior and the others who were worried about you.) With that thought, she opens your chat window on WavesLine.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Sorry for worrying you all!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Relax. No need to be anxious.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Okay! I'll try to adjust!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: By the way, are you free now, Senior?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I have a present for you. As an apology and a thank-you.

Essence of Tranquility.desc: Sigrika sits in silence on the rooftop. The wind, which once brought her endless inspiration, now only brushes past her, stealing her warmth. Her heart of gold has grown heavy, each beat a soft whimper. Please, stop crying out, she prays, but it is to no avail. Just then, Sigrika hears the sound of your footsteps.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Though you told me not to think about it, I still ran away and hid myself here…
