lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Professor Lucilla, Dr. Luuk, and me, we're all here to help.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So, allow yourself to step away and rest a little before you find the answer.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: …Then, can you stay with me a little longer?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Thank you.

Imprints of Wings.desc: Sigrika leads you to a certain rooftop within the Academy. To any passerby, it looks completely ordinary. But only she knows just how many "spirits of freedom" love to pause and rest on this unassuming place. Every bird visiting the area carries its own character, but their size makes them easy to miss. Spotting them takes a sharp eye. She has one, undoubtedly. And so do you.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Okay... I'll just have to take more until I get a good one myself!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You really like birds, don't you?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Mm-hmm! They're beautiful. And free.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Most of all, they're brave. They know exactly where they're flying to.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: You have some that journey across entire continents, from pole to pole... and others that will brave storms to find a place they call home.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: And they're not born knowing how to fly. There's always that first leap from a great height, that very moment the wind rushes through their feather for the first time.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Mmmhmm...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Lucilla mentioned the Academy approved your request to keep the graffiti.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yep. Totally thought they'd shoot it down. But it sailed right through every system review...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Could that have been... Lucy?)

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Looks like someone gave us a secret helping hand on their way out...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: We'll make sure this special gift is kept safe.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I never used to tell her any of that. But the moment I finally did, it felt like a shadow lifted.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds like everything's moving in the right direction.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Yeah! And I haven't slowed down either.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: There's so much I still want to do. And I'm gonna do it. One thing at a time.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: I think this is the answer I've found for myself!

By Sun's Burning Hand.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Augusta spoke of the great surge we are about to face.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: The Ephor speaks the truth.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: And... this year's High Tide has come later than usual, which bodes ill.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: It's a shame even the sharp ears of the Senate could not chisel through the high walls of Tetragon Temple, to hear the whispers beyond...

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Heh, is this an auspice of calamity, or a prelude to a new legend? Only time will tell...

By Moon's Fated Light.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Ha, there's no one else here. No need to put on an act.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (He doesn't look like he's lying, but this is the first time I've been here. Priestesses, Tetragon Temple... Could this be Iuno's doing?)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (For Avidius here, Iuno has also never existed. Whatever she did in the past is now my doing. That's why he thinks I'm behind all this.)

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Ha... Hahaha... At this point, what do I have left to hide?

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: I always thought I was the hero who conquered Manes Deep. The one more worthy of ruling than even Augusta.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Until the day I led the charge to Murmurstown, determined to stop my comrades from falling to the Dark Tide and prove I had what it took to be king. I walked to the door I had passed a thousand times only to find—

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: That's a long story. Let's speak of more pressing matters. Are you after the Thundering Mephis as well?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: No. I'm tracking someone else.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Silver hair and violet eyes... cloaked in cursed, shadowlit flame. So you seek the one they call "Discord Slayer."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Discord Slayer? Sounds like you know something about her.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Yes, she's on my radar. I suspect the recent Tacet Discord outbreak in Ragunna City is tied to her presence.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: Your Grace hasn't heard? It struck not long ago.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: By the Light of Imperator... REPENT!

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: It's... the Light of Genesis?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Looks like the judgment is clear.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: These hollow existences don't need your mercy.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Protect the Civilization Capsule. That's what they're really after.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Good, all locked and loaded. Now if you'll excuse me... Someone's got to teach the Dark Tide some manners.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Huh? No... Hold on now―

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: And you, Rover... If your resolve is true, be ready. When the time comes, I'll guide you to Paradise.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: See you all in "Hell."

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: The Tidespawn are retreating to the center! They're all inside the Ward's perimeter! Augusta!

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: Will you suffer in silence beneath Fate's poisoned arrows, or rise to defy this world's endless trials? I, too, await your final answer.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: You brought ruin to Rinascita. You think you're just walking away?

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: My stage lies elsewhere. In this scene, I am but a herald.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: But since you're so eager, I'll leave you with one final clue. I've never had much fondness for overwrought dramatic irony.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: The Dark Tide has already tainted the Civilization Capsule. It no longer requires the Threnodian's authority to be opened… Just a single drop of the Tide's nectar will suffice.

lines.speaker: Cristoforo
lines.text: So tell me, how could an existence born of the Dark Tide ever serve as its "Anchor of Reality"?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: I suspect... the one corrupted might not be "you."

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Phew... the Dark Tide, huh? I ate some back at the hunting grounds. It tasted kinda funky... made me super sleepy. Ever since then, I've been having the weirdest nightmares...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: Abby does... carry the Dark Tide's frequency...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Abby must have absorbed many other frequencies. So while the Dark Tide's frequency lay in wait... it was masked by the others.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It makes sense. You two share life and energy. As the primary in this bond, your frequency has been overriding Abby's... Leviathan planned for this.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Manipulating the air to form a wind trail... Is that your Resonance Ability?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: One of them. I have the Tacet Discord Harpyia within me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Not an Echo, but a Tacet Discord itself... So you can absorb them directly?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: You can say that. Balor is one of many.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: One of many... Now I'm really curious about you and your abilities.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: If we live through this, maybe I'll tell you. But right now...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why are there so many enemies here?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Leviathan's kindred. It created them Itself. Nothing more than empty husks.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What should we do? Should we avoid them?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: No, we slay them all.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: They need no mercy. Their rest awaits.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: So the trail's gone cold. I'm not giving up, but our current leads aren't very promising.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well, since we're already here, might as well enjoy the party.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: ...Hmm, there's no reason we can't do both. Maybe this party has more clues everyone's too busy to notice. I'll look around.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Where is Chimera?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It's right here.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Lupa gave me a piece of that candy. I just shoved it into Chimera's mouth.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The effect is lingering, so it'll be stuck in this shape for a while.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So, Warrior! Where are you heading next?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Next...

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: It was Leviathan's voice. Something has... awakened It.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: It's very likely Avidius. Right now, everything is riding on us finding him.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: That Septimontian Gladiator... Our scouts saw him advancing into the depths of Thessaleo Fells.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Leviathan may have drawn from these subconscious beliefs, "aligning" with those desires to fabricate a false future and afterlife within the Dark Tide-the illusion of the Journeying Paradise.

lines.speaker: Cantarella
lines.text: If that's true... once the people's belief in the End Times reaches its zenith, their consciousness will align entirely with Leviathan's vision. Like Gilberto, and the others who were fully corrupted...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Its power of assimilation will grow stronger, until the line between imagination and reality vanishes. The Journeying Paradise will descend upon the world, just as before.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: ... When it does, every soul in Rinascita will be unified under Its control. No thoughts. No will. Just blind devotion... No different from the Tidespawn.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: You saw it in the illusion. It cast aside the Sentinel's form and took on Cartethyia's. That means... The first step in her plan is complete.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Leviathan is still watching the real world. Because of the "Mark of the Dark Tide," It can read your thoughts. So for now... we can't share the full plan with you.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Let's deal with the mess first! Plenty of time to catch up after!

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: One Obelisk remains on the northeast...

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The nature of the Dark Tide and Leviathan... I see where we are now.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Rover! You're here.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Rover, this is Rinascita's fight. It is neither your duty to shoulder it alone, nor our desire to see you do so. We will not have you face the Threnodian alone.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: The Priestesses foresaw this, "The Dark Tide will erupt and engulf all of Septimont." If that is our fate, we must meet it head-on.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Wait... An intense frequency suddenly... It's moving toward the western front!

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: ...Is this the best the mighty Gladiators of Septimont can offer?

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: A grand finale deserves grandeur! How can such a dull act satisfy the audience?

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Scar
lines.text: Did you really think you could stand against us alone?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Steel yourself...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Defy the prophecy. Rise above fate again.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: If the road ahead is dark, then let this soul—

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Where's that Gladiator from Septimont?

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Sir Avidius made it out of the rift before you.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: But... he didn't look great. Kept muttering about needing to "stop the crisis," then off he went, like a man on fire.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: ...Give me your hand.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: I left a mark on Avidius during our fight earlier. With Balor's power, I can tap into his sight. We'll find his trail.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: They are linked to the Chrysalis above. Destroying them will weaken the Threnodian's hold.

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Copy that!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.

lines.speaker: Augusta
lines.text: That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Phoebe
lines.text: Repairs on the Genesis Nexus are still underway, but some damaged Common Echoes are already operational again.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Leave the residual Dark Tide frequencies to me.

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Leave the residual Dark Tide frequencies to me.

lines.speaker: Brant
lines.text: Alright, crew! Come lend a hand!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Roccia
lines.text: Pero's got a whole mountain of tools over here... Like this rapid adhesive gun!

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Margherita
lines.text: Here you go! Double the scoop, on the house! Unlimited refills!

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: I can't manage this on my own. Want to split it?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: "You don't have to carry it all yourself. Sometimes, it's okay to lean on someone else." Wasn't that your line?

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: So, one side each?

Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: The other Bloombearers have already headed back to rest. They burned through every drop of strength out there. Once we've handed off the Threnodian's Gem to Tethys... I might even allow myself a few hours of real sleep!

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: If it weren't for the Black Shores, we'd have been completely ensnared by Leviathan's schemes. On behalf of the people of Rinascita, please accept our deepest gratitude.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: This is what the Black Shores does. We're just glad we earned our keep.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: This might be the first real conversation we've had since everything ended. Thank you very much, Galbrena.

lines.speaker: Cartethyia
lines.text: It's a shame I'm not able to absorb the Threnodian's Gem, not in my current state.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: The effect is lingering, so it'll be stuck in this shape for a while.

lines.speaker: Lupa
lines.text: So, Warrior! Where are you heading next?

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Surely you didn't think we'd fall apart without you? We Ragunnesi are made of sterner stuff than that. We handled those creatures just fine.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: This Feilian Beringal... When the "core" was destroyed, the other Tidespawn lost their form. For now, the Vault is secure. At least until the next wave spawns.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: I'd set up Order Terminals around the perimeter though. They'll detect humanoid mimics and prevent new Tidespawn from forming here.

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Might I ask...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: Where's that Gladiator from Septimont?

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Hand over the Civilization Capsule.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: ...So the Civilization Capsule is your goal after all. Lost your patience, have you?

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: Death is the fruit of transgression. To resist it is to defy the will of the Divinity.

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: You? You and your Divinity cannot end me...

lines.speaker: Galbrena
lines.text: And these Dark Tide shams... Today, you face your reckoning.

lines.speaker: Fenrico
lines.text: I am the Enlightened One, anointed by the Divinity and crowned by Fate itself.

lines.speaker: Iuno
lines.text: Come back soon! (I'm only asking for the sake of everyone else!)

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: ♪Lulala! Lululala!♪

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: Ah! It's you, Rover! Long time no see!

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: ♪It's just the effect of that candy. But it's not so bad, is it?♪

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: ♪It's like... stumbling upon another version of myself.♪

lines.speaker: Ciaccona
lines.text: ♪Maybe it'll spark some new inspiration!♪

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: You can find her guide KU-Roro in the Haven of Sprouts. It may know something.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll go check it out. Knowing Chisa, she usually doesn't act without purpose.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: The situation in Honami has stabilized. Think I could apply for a field investigation?

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: You can, but be careful. That Sonoro still hides more questions than answers.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: It's been so many years... I can finally return to my hometown.

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: An old clock... its hands are still ticking.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Someone I knew left it here. She believed time flowed strangely in this Sonoro. Used timing devices to find a loophole. So I brought it to the base.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Someone you knew? Was she... also from the outside and got pulled into this Sonoro?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: You could say that. I don't know who she is exactly, but she understood this place far better than I do.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: She suspected the Sonoro doesn't just loop. It also has a different inner time flow than the outside world. To test her theory, she took apart countless clocks and logged everything. Even her wristwatch was...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...Her wristwatch?

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Now this place feels more like home than the world out there.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It just takes some time to get used to an unfamiliar enviornment.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Just ask the Black Shores to help you keep digging. With enough time, you're bound to find those connections again.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Since you're here, would you walk with me? I'd like to see what Honami looks like now... together.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Any particular places you have in mind?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I haven't come up with an exact plan yet. Specific routes, time of travel, rest locations... None.

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I thought maybe...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: There were complications. Took me a while to get here.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Phew... I'm just glad you're safe.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: When you came through, did you notice anything strange?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Strange? Not really. I felt a little dizzy, but otherwise, it was normal.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (So I was the only one pulled into that strange dimension...?)

phone.speaker: Chisa
phone.text: Where are you...

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Sorry for worrying you. I'm at the Academy now.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'll find you as soon as I can.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I ran into some trouble, but I've arrived safely at the Academy.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I'll come find you soon.

phone.speaker: Chisa
phone.text: Rover!

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Chisa.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Mm, I'll keep these students safe.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: When I saw you return from the Stridergate, I wasn't sure if I should say something comforting... I thought you would—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't worry. I don't have time for self-pity.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll leave things here to you, Chisa. It's time for me to get back to my own mission.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Right. See you later!

phone.speaker: Chisa
phone.text: Contact me if you need any help.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Don't worry. I'll see you later.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: See you once the mission is over.

phone.speaker: Chisa
phone.text: Alright. See you then.}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What about you, Chisa? What have you heard?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Me? Actually, I don't know the specifics of what's happening. I just wanted to help...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (So it's all just hearsay for now...)

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: This... reminds me of the party we had with everyone at Shashou Cafe.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: How so?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Back then, all I wanted was to finish what I needed to do in Honami. No regrets. Then go home to see my parents.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah, I remember you telling me.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Yes. I'd even prepared myself for a final goodbye. But then we ended up coming here together... In a way.

Stranger Things in Honami/Story.desc: After the end of Honami's looping crisis, Chisa heads to the Black Shores to recover. Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City. Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to help rebuild the Shashou Cafe.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: These are more actionable leads than the victims' psychological states... Apologies. I got caught up in thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't worry, you're making perfect sense, Chisa. Let's follow up on this.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Okay. We need to watch for anyone else investigating this, and identify those present at the scenes before the unexplainabe events occurred.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I find it strange too. But... there is no way to fix it for now.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The next stop after Honami should be...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: It's Startorch Academy, right?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: We'll meet you there, Passenger.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: When the time comes, let's fight side by side once again.

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yup! All thanks to our pals at the Black Shores! They've been working nonstop to install all kinds of devices. And with the connection getting stronger, I finally managed to slip through when the rift popped back up and... Wait...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: A new face! Hiya! Is she coming with us?

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Gotta hand it to ya, I love what you guys did with place. Feels like a mini festival in here!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Oh, you're here. Namipon and I are just making finishing touches to the party.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Welcome aboard, Abby.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Well, hello there, Chisa. It's nice to see you again. You're all so kind, you know. Say, whatcha got on the menu—

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Chisa's the Acting Manager today, and she'll be our host for the opening party.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wait a minute... Something smells funny about this guy!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: This frequency isn't Echo or TD. Feels like it's hiding a whole mixed bag in its fuzzy tummy!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: You say that, but I don't trust it. Hey, ain't there a whole lot more of you around here too?

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Would you like to join us in putting up the decorations, Passenger?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: And it's completely ignoring me! Now it even chats up Rover like they're old buddies or something...

Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: To find the right path again, we have to reconnect with the Tower. And that means—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Finding a frequency that shares its source with the Tower.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Like this! The Longings from Honami's Left Behind. They're what woke me up, and they'll guide us to the Tower.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Namipon and I have been collecting them for a while. It hasn't been easy. My ability... still isn't where it needs to be. But we've managed to rule out some wrong routes. We're narrowing it down.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: No, it's not about ability! You just haven't fully learned to filter out the negative emotions while collecting.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So you collect them ... with this bottle?

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: If not mistaken, the sounds will become clearer once you've adjusted it to the right frequency.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Let's give this a try then.)

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Hmm, that doesn't seem right. Try the other way.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (In that case...)

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Oh, oh! There you go!

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Besides, we still haven't found the source of this anomaly... Let's keep up the good work, Passenger.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Speaking of anomaly... Do you know Dorothy, Namipon?

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Dorothy? You mean the Illusia, Passenger?

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: We have her dream to thank for allowing us to use Echoes here. My power alone wouldn't have made it possible, that's for sure.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (So it looks like she was serious about lending us a hand. But everyone still sees her as an Illusia, though...)

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Passenger?

Stranger Things in Honami/Story.desc: After the end of Honami's looping crisis, Chisa heads to the Black Shores to recover. Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City. Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to help rebuild the Shashou Cafe.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: I did hear a few stories… How about we head to the Commercial District next? The trail might be cold, but it's better than just chasing rumors.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Namipon... How come the Left Behind can perceive these Lament phenomena now? Before, they didn't even realize they were all already dead.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Oh, that... Well, after you and Chisa stopped the looping Lament in the city, the Waveworn Phenomena affecting the Left Behind was weakened.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: They still linger in Honami because of their attachments, but now they can think more clearly, almost like they did in life, until those attachments finally fade.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I see... So that's why they're becoming self-aware.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Mhm! By the way, we've gathered enough materials from our exploring to fix up a few facilities. Be sure to take a look when you get a moment, Passenger.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I am detecting a unique frequency from this radio...

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: It has formed a connection with Lahai-Roi on the other end of the rift.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Once it's all fixed up, I can piggyback on this frequency and plot coordinates from there to Honami.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Understood. With established coordinates, you will be able to navigate your way within the rift.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: The Black Shores will also assist with stabilizing the rift to ensure your safety as much as possible.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: ...Should you decide to travel to Lahai-Roi. To Startorch Academy.

When the Unknown Thrums.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: The coordinates have all been calibrated. A smooth landing, guaranteed!

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: The tunnel is stable, but only wide enough for one person at a time.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I see. Then please let me go first.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: Oh, don't get all serious! You can visit during your holidays.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: I'm the cafe's mascot. Call me Namipon.

lines.speaker: Buling
lines.text: Hello, Namipon. You show the way? Been walking until my legs go jelly. Need to sit and rest a while.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Interested in trying a little "germination test," Chisa? A little eval I host, just for the brave.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Eval as in...?

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Defeat me, or be defeated.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Is this... some kind of tradition in the Black Shores?

lines.speaker: Camellya
lines.text: Relax, dearie. Don't get worked up just yet. Hehe, you can show me your dance moves once you're fully recovered.

Flowing Starlight in the Iris.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

lines.speaker: Namipon
lines.text: So this is where the radio went...

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: What's with all that noise it's making?

Ashinohara's Legendary Miko.desc: Platya calls and asks to meet you at Rabelle College. It seems she has something she wants to discuss...

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: You haven't formally requested assistance. That tells us you want to handle this yourself. And we trust you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: After what happened to Aemeath... and with the threat of Aleph-1, I know now isn't the time to be putting everything on the line.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I've made up my mind. I will bring her back. That's my burden, and I can't drag the Collective or the Black Shores into it.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: If you're sure that's what you want to do, then please, let us help. Okay?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yeah. Of course.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But you didn't come all this way just to say that, did you?

A Miko's Preferences.desc: It seems the "Lady Miko" is intentionally keeping her distance, and Platya starts to notice. But even if they never meet, she still wants to give her a gift. You can think of one person who might have an idea where this "Lady Miko's" preferences lie...

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: Other people's?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yes, like someone from your hometown. Or people here in Lahai-Roi connected to the Ghost Miko legend.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: That's true. More input means more ideas.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Maybe I can ask Chisa. She stayed in Honami for a long time.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (She should know something about this miko.)

The Film-Loving Ghost Miko.desc: You catch wind of a “Film-Loving Ghost Miko” urban legend in the Academy's group chat. You decide to head to the screening room to check it out.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: You mean...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The people closest to the legend are the ones spreading it, right?

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: True. According to those students, the Lady Miko might appear in the club room after 11:00 tonight. So I was thinking...

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: Yes. Even if it's just a legend, I want to try.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: Rover, let's meet in the club room after 11:00 tonight.

The Rescued Researcher.desc: Rumor has it, a few expedition researchers owe their lives to a mysterious "Lady Miko." Platya passes you the coordinates of one camp, and you head there to see what clues might be waiting.

lines.speaker: Platya
lines.text: What is it, Rover?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Nothing. I think your guess is right. I met her before while resolving one of the Academy's incidents.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I was curious about who she was back then, but the person I was with at the time said...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: "About that miko lady you're curious about..."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: "My lips are sealed on that, I'm afraid. A President has her principles, not to mention the Academy's safety protocol. But one day, you'll see her again."

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Don't give me those puppy dog eyes. Even if you went and asked the President yourself, she wouldn't tell you.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah, Rover's here. I'll brief on the situation.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: President Lucilla! Whaddya need us for? And what did you mean by "the one from afar who touches 'truth'"?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Why don't you take a guess? It means exactly what it says.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...The one from afar is me.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And the "truth" that reveals the door of dreams is...?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: The "truth" has waited for you here for a very long time.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Your guess is as good as mine. Leaving? Hm, see ya.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Hi, Denia! You know where Sigrika's at?

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Here for her help too? You'll have to get in line. She's been running herself ragged with all these riddles lately.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: She's after "Minerva's Treasure" too? But isn't her sorting exam coming up? How's she handling all that?

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: You'll have to ask her. She's the one who has to live up to the whole "Heliodic Six successor" thing.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Personally? I'd just let it all go. Life would be way easier that way.

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Chuuu?!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Hic—you sound like a Soliskin now!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: This is so much fun! Maybe we should share them with others too!

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: ...Do you want some water?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sigrika wants you to try this.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Why does your voice sound like that?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Just try it, Denia! Please?

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: …I refuse. The last time I tried your candy, I was shooting rainbow beams out of my eyes and mouth for four minutes and thirty-five seconds.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Rover... I sent you away... So why...?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So it was you, Denia... the one who pushed me out of Voidspace.

Beneath a Melting Night Sky.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: I'm running out of time. Some things deserve a proper ending—with a good day.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (An ending... What is she planning to do? But in her current state...)

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: What, doesn't feel safe even if you're around? Then put another collar on me, or a bomb. What's one more, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...I'll see what I can do.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: You mean that? But people at the Academy, do they know...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Spacetrek Collective never made your identity public. So for that day, you'll still be the Academy student Denia.

lines.speaker: Denia
lines.text: Rover, isn't there anything else fun to do?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Anything else fun...

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I've found a few of the students. I'm sending their coordinates to your Terminal now.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: We're counting on you to bring them back, Rover}.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Status report, Professor Mornye.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The launch orbit has been confirmed. The Drive Replica is projected to launch in 16 hours, at which point it will initiate Duskveil.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Then we evacuate every remaining soul in Lahai-Roi before that window closes.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Check the ships at the Roya Frostlands port, in addition to the escape pods.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: We don't know how long Duskveil will hold. No one stays a second longer than necessary.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: But that's alright. Everyone, please refocus. Let's go over Lixian's board work—

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: As you can see, Mr. Aalto, this is our signature "Sleep Learning Program."

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Oooh! Very impressive! Ahem... How about we move on to the next stop?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: After you.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Now we're about to show you some Augmented Resonance projects developed by our Synchronists.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Among them, the unmanned vehicle prototype shows exceptional promise across multiple market sectors—

Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: We found you, Chisa!

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: ...Ah, hello.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: One moment. I'm analyzing this piano. If we integrate an electric grill into it and map each key to a control knob...

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: ...Apologies. I was simply occupying my time after getting lost.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: How did you end up here, Chisa?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: The reason is unclear. I was en route to submit a project to the Student Council, but a debate was occurring, so I was waiting nearby.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: That's what's strange to me. But Professor Lucilla only had Rover come, so maybe it's not as serious as we think?

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Why do I feel like asking Senior to come means the opposite?

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Oh, Senior! Come back and visit us when you get the chance, okay?

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Even though your "time" at the Academy has ended, Rover, ours will keep moving forward.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I believe that there will be a day when we'll share time together again.

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: You see everything you've experienced since arriving in Solaris, along with scenes you don't recall, scenes featuring Mornye. Mornye hands you the finished Cassette tape, explaining that it serves as your ID and a Terminal that warns of Void Storms.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That artificial sun they spoke of...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: In simple terms, it's our plan to replace the "sun" you see in the sky.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You're planning to replace the Exostrider's Drive? Is that what the New Solar Ceremony is about?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: You remember...? Did the Black Shores tell you this?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's the talk of the Academy now.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Right. Replacing it is critical to reactivating the Exostrider. And really, we can't stay wrapped in its warm light forever.

Ode to the Second Sunrise.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm fine now, Mornye. Sorry to worry you. You must need to get back to the Spacetrek Collective, right?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: That's okay.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But you just...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: You looked... shaken just now. I'll stay with you. If it involves more frequency loss, I'd like to stay close to transport you to the infirmary.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Transport me?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Mornye, where are you?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Has the feast finished already?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Yes, it is.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: I'm sorry if I worried you.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I couldn't find you. I was worried.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: But... I'm the professor, and you're the student. It should be my place to worry about you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (I'll bide my time. The right moment will come.)

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Has something happened, Mentor?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I see. So the Reactor Drive's Core survived the crash?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It must be the key to reactivating the Exostrider. Of course, then the official stance is that it be returned. Startorch Academy and the Roya would both agree on that.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: But, as you said, curiosity from the Institute is inevitable—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mornye?

Gold Suspended in Shadows.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mornye, we need a safe zone. Now.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I've located one already.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Chisa.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: This is...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Can I see it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll give it back in a moment. Mornye, do you see what's special about it?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: This ID number... I saw it in the student file during her inspection. This is Aemeath's own Cassette. It's been stored in the Depository since she went missing.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why did you want to bring this now?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Mentor, you're back!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: We were just in contact, but yes... I am back.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Must've been signal interference in Void Space. I only just received your messages.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: I see... I'm just glad you're back. We can talk about everything else once you get to the Institute. Are you feeling alright?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Don't worry, I feel perfectly fine.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: That's a relief... In that case, come over to the Institute first.}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why didn't you wake them up?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: This class is difficult to follow, so it's normal for some to drift off. Still, it's rare for the entire class to go like that.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: If only I could make my lectures more accessible...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This isn't your fault.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It's like metal fatigue. These students are being tempered and pushed to their limits over and over. Eventually, the metal just snaps.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Should I have woken them? Reprimanded them? Or offered them assurance...?

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It's just... this is the second time I'm seeing you off from Lahai-Roi.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm sorry I've forgotten our past time together.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Don't be. I know you had your reasons, and I don't feel disappointed.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: But last time you left, you said that Lahai-Roi will continue forward on its own feet. I've carried those words with me ever since.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: So this time... may I be the one to offer a proper farewell?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: By all means.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Mentor, I looked into this Somnoire you mentioned... it seems to be some kind of dreamscape, correct?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: It's usually guarded by two Gatekeepers. They make sure no Nightmare Tacet Discords or other frequencies cross into our reality.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Whenever there was a problem in the past, we handled it.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But we've never come across a frequency able to rewrite space itself... Has the Academy been affected?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: At this stage, the door's area of influence remains limited.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The Academy has cordoned off a danger zone and instructed everyone to keep their distance.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: The door itself poses no direct threat. However, an abnormal frequency leaking from behind it is slowly contaminating the surrounding environment.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What do you mean by "contaminating"?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Abnormal frequency?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: It's rewriting the frequency of anything it comes into contact with, assimilating it as part of itself.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: ...As of now, we haven't found a way to stop it.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Abnormal frequency, a door... This has the Somnoire written all over it.

Broken Dimmr Heart.desc: In the Voidmatter-contaminated area of the Twilight Woodlands, you discover Helios's prototype, a machine thought lost long ago in a Void Storm.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Mornye, what's your take on this Augmented Resonance tech?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: My research in this field is limited, but based on Professor Warren's theories...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: If the conditions are right, the Augmented Resonance framework could actually shield instrument signals from any electromagnetic interference from the Etheric Sea.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I see... By the way, how did you know about the valve issue?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Professor Anselm mentioned it to me on Wavesline before I left.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Mornye, I found this device with a student named Lenie. Does it look familiar?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: It might be the prototype developed for the Helios Project. Where exactly did you find this, Mentor?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: The Twilight Woodlands, in the Dimmr Plains.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: I see. That prototype... it was actually lost in an accident during the initial testing. Vanished into a Void Storm. We've had no trace of it since.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: An accident? Do you remember what caused it?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Hmm... the official records are light on details. But the conclusion at the time was an anti-Voidmatter system meltdown triggered by an unstable "Augmented Resonance" flow.

Energy Supplement Trial Report.desc: While the students immerse themselves fully in the Celebration, the faculty are run ragged keeping the gears turning. Even with thirteen different projects juggling for her attention, Mornye still finds a spare second to send a message checking in on you. To return the favor and help the ever-restless Mornye finally catch her breath, bring her the specific food she requested.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: How is it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: At first, it's sweet, like Dusk Honeypot… then smoky fish, followed by a greasy Skelecanth aroma. It's a creative flavor.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: That's a relief…!

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: My apologies for getting carried away... I mean, if you like this, I can reserve a box for you when the development finishes.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Thank you for your insight. After replenishing energy, my mind feels sharper.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: And... I'm feeling more relaxed. Resuming work in this state should be more productive.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: So you might take it easy now, Mentor. There's no need to overexert yourself.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Understood, Professor Mornye!

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Surprise

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Since you say so, Mentor… please do take a professor's advice seriously!

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Okay. Don't worry.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: That's a relief. I hope I haven't disturbed you.

Environmental Variable Adjustment.desc: Not long after your brief encounter at the library, Mornye sends you another invitation. The message is a word-for-word replica of her last one. It seems she is attempting to recreate your previous meeting to validate a specific theory. Head to the library to meet Mornye and assist with her experiment.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Ah, sorry. I didn't realize you had arrived.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did I interrupt your work?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Not at all. That was my mistake.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I promised I'd only use fifteen minutes of your time. I should be using it more efficiently.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You look troubled. Can I help?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: No, it should be fine as long as you're here.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: What's new?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Just want to inform you that all Dark Side parameters are stable now. No significant deviations are expected for the foreseeable future.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Didn't this conversation happen before?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: My apologies.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: I was attempting to recreate the previous scenario to improve my work efficiency.

Abnormal Dopamine Secretion.desc: Mornye has sent you another invitation. Unlike your previous meetings, she has carefully selected a location designed for relaxation: "Lush vegetation and an open view." Can she obtain the experimental results she seeks in this new environment? Head to the Golden Spiral and meet Mornye.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: …Sorry. Did I confuse you?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: When it comes to people, you have to try to understand the emotional aspect.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Understand the emotional aspect?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's right. Just leave it to me.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Lush vegetation and an open view should promote "relaxation."

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Okie dokie. Shall we go now?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Yes. I'll wait for you there.}}

Standardized Happiness.desc: After some careful preparation, it is your turn to send an invitation to Mornye. Upon receiving it, she seems a bit nervous—she doesn't have much experience simply "hanging out" with others. As her Mentor, this is your moment to lead the way. Head to the screening room with Mornye to watch the film you specially selected for her.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: So "understanding the emotional aspect" involves… watching a movie?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yep, I figured you haven't watched many.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: …If by "movies" you mean edited videos, then I'm familiar with observing experimental records.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Do you like movies?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I see. Then I'll watch carefully, just like you do.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Hmm... have to watch?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I've already come up with a good way to address the problem you mentioned last time. Wanna come?

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Okay.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: Will this involve a lot of talking to people? If so, I may need to script the entire conversation in advance.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: No preparations needed at all.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Just come with me. Think of it as a brand-new adventure.}}

Sylph at Twilight.desc: Mornye has sent word that her research is finally complete. After several twists and turns, the prototype of "Sylph" has finally been unveiled. Her brief message barely hides her excitement. She wants you to be the very first person to see it. Head to the Research Institute and share the joy of Mornye's hard-won success.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Though it's only a prototype, it functions perfectly. While it's not suited for mass production, I hope it can still help you capture a memory you truly cherish.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (The memory I truly cherish… I'm curious myself. Using it once should be okay… as long as I don't abuse it.)

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sure. Let's try it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Alright. Powering on. Recording started...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Ah, wait! I forgot to delete my sample data!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Someday, we'll meet again.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: The prototype of Sylph is complete. I want you to be the first to see it.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: On my way.

phone.speaker: Mornye
phone.text: I'll be waiting in the lab.}}

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: There are too many unfinished reports and not nearly enough time… Besides, her theory may lack universality. I may be an outlier.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sounds like you've got the perfect opportunity to test it right now.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: …You're right. A theory isn't proven or disproven until it's tested.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Mmhmm. You too, Rover.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Sustained research requires a clear mind and a steady supply of sugar to keep your brain fueled.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: That's why a good, sweet coffee is always the perfect late-night beverage.

Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You need to take a "bad" rest.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: No matter what happens, you, me, Rover, Dr. Luuk... we won't let the Dark Side ruin the Academy.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: I'm coming with you. Finding people is one thing, hauling them back is another. It'll be faster if we take my motorbike.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Status report, Professor Mornye.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: The launch orbit has been confirmed. The Drive Replica is projected to launch in 16 hours, at which point it will initiate Duskveil.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Then we evacuate every remaining soul in Lahai-Roi before that window closes.

lines.text: We don't know how long Duskveil will hold. No one stays a second longer than necessary.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Yep, we even threw together a little welcoming thing.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Oh, you rascals... Alright, but follow my lead. If this auditor is a by-the-book type, then we—

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Ah, Rover. I knew everyone would want to see you off, so I rounded up whoever I could.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: You weren't gonna just shoot us a WavesLine and dip, were ya? That'd be cold!

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: The cat, the dog, even the Soliskin I can follow. But the tag signature... what's the story there?

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Hehe, well...

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: All units that have completed your missions, report back to the Research Institute immediately.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: Team 6 confirms return.

What Burns Beneath Frostlands.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Figures. The activation pulse must've drawn it in. We need to find another way...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yeah. Plus, I can feel that fat worm zeroing in on our frequency.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: We split up.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Okay, I'll draw it away. The other arrays are yours!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Be careful.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Relax—
