However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Let's get started! We can eat while we talk!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Of course, come on in. I already tidied up my dorm, so sit wherever you like!

Ode to the Second Sunrise.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: From its structure, it looks like a canister that can both store and emit energy.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Ugh, it's so stinky!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It smells just like that giant worm you fought! Didn't we deal with it already?!

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Giant worm... You mean the Voidworm?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: I see. It's capturing frequencies with high precision, storing energy data.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It's based on ecological models, tracking activity in natural environments, and reconstructing that data mathematically.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Mentor, Abby. You made it.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, it's been a minute—Huh?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wait a sec. Mornye, what's up with that weird smell on ya?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Smells kinda like a Tacet Discord, kinda like a machine... but it's different from Exoswarm...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Uh... but I can't tell what it is exactly.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: ...That smell might be coming from the frequency sample I just collected.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: See? I ate it. But I have no idea what happened. (I'm not the mastermind, but I know who is.)

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Pfft! Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: ...That last part? Who said that?

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: What I'm trying to say is I really don't know what happened! (But I do know who's responsible for this!)

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Let me make this clear. (I'll keep telling the truth anyway.) This candy's effect is very serious... (And I know you're not going to go easy on me.)

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: She hasn't gone far. Probably watching us from the shadows.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She seemed... like her grip is slipping.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: She was already like this when I last encountered her. Shortly before the Voidmatter surge.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hiyuki, when you fought Denia, did you see anything like a shadowy hand?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Then Denia was behind the incident beyond the Stridergate.)

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: I am staying behind for you. To the very end.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Are you still in the underground sector?

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: Glad to know you are alright.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: How's the situation on your end? Need any help?

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: It is proving difficult. As the Voidmatter intensifies, locating people has grown increasingly challenging...

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: Do not worry about me. Go. Join Lucilla and the others.}}

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: She is not here. She is likely still at the Review Hall.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Thank you. I'll look for her there.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What for?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: If I had been more helpful, perhaps the outcome would have been more satisfying.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This was her battle. You and I have already done our best for her.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why's everyone...

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: To bid you farewell.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Mentor, I...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: ...No matter what difficulties lie ahead, Startorch Academy will always have your back. I... We will all be waiting for you here.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: So go. Don't worry about us.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Huanglong... What a shame. Should the opportunity arise, I would like to visit.

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: I will be departing in a few days as well.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Is this a joint op with the Spacetrek Collective?

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: They will arrange a way to "ship" me there. After that, I will be on my own.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: You're going alone?

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: I will ask the Collective to find a way to "send" me there.

phone.speaker: Hiyuki
phone.text: All eyes are watching Ashinohara now. In Lucilla's words, it is a "complicated and troublesome adult world." And the appearance of the Miko of Flaming Sakura would only complicate things further.

So as the Melting Snow Desires.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Their plans for Denia and me may have failed, but it proves one thing. They have found a way to harness Threnodian power.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Spying from the shadows... that does sound like them. Thank you, I'll be careful.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: By the way, how is Denia?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: She is still undergoing treatment and remains unstable. The Collective seem to have special arrangements for her. I wished to visit, but Lucilla said I am the one person who cannot...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Well, it was your blade that struck her down.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: In that strike, I used the frequency you left within her. The one that "separates." That was what freed her from the Threnodian's control.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Did you have that candy?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: ...I did.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Then you—

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: But sometimes the full titles of their projects are so lengthy I suspect they were designed to be forgotten.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So that muttering earlier was... studying?

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Reading, memorizing terms... Rover, do you...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sorry. That's one area I can't help you with.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: I see... No matter. The night is long. I will remember what I can.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's easy. Leave it to me.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Your assistance is appreciated, Sir Avidius. The residents from Egla Town have all been accounted for.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: I am simply fulfilling my duty.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (Strange... I clearly sensed the Dark Tide's presence around here. So why does everything seem normal?)

lines.speaker: Zani
lines.text: Gunfire. We've got intruders.

The Bygone Shall Always Return.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

lines.speaker: Carlotta
lines.text: Be careful. Her abilities... are not normal.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: ...All this? By her hand?
Fiction and reality are starting to blur. Don't put your faith in appearances.
That... is what they really are.

lines.speaker: Avidius
lines.text: The Dark Tide can corrupt, and you carry its power. What proof do we have this isn't your doing?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: What happened to you?!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Your frequency's been leaking everywhere! I tried plugging it from the inside, but it didn't work.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Eurgh! No, this is no good... How about this!

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It stopped... it stopped... for now. I gotta... I gotta rest...

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: It may be instinctual.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Dr. Luuk did say this Exoswarm-like "shell" shares a frequency link with the real Aemeath.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Or it could be the "shell's" residual instinct. Cassettes are proof of a student's identity. Or it could be a weak signal sent from the Aemeath beyond the Gate. We can't determine which theory is correct yet.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: However, this does remind me... carrying a Cassette into an unexplored Void Storm zone follows standard exploration protocol. Do you have yours?

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Turns out, decoding what the Exostrider burned into your Cassette was way tougher than the Institute thought. They only just finished today!

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Over here, Rover! Everyone's waiting for you!

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Chisa
lines.text: I believe that there will be a day when we'll share time together again.

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Which means! This isn't some sad, teary "goodbye forever" moment—

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: It's another brand new "beginning" that belongs to us.

At Dream's Edge.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: Hm, you've got the same mark on your hand, Rover. Lemme guess – ain't a coincidence?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: It's called a Tacet Mark. It shows up when a Resonator's power kicks in.

lines.speaker: Lucy
lines.text: Did... something just fly out of it? How's that possible?

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: I WANT ONE!

lines.speaker: Rebecca
lines.text: How many eddies for the talkin' plushie?! I'll buy one right this second.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Who're you calling a plushie?! I'm an Echo! Rover and I go way back.

Morning Star II.desc: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Oh, Rover. You have no idea how grateful I am! Oh, and who might this be?

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: Hello. I am an Acolyte of the Order, Lenore. Any harsh work or dirty job you have, do feel free to send them my way!

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Aggressive. I like it!

lines.speaker: Maji
lines.text: Well, if you say so, Rover. Let's all do our part in restoring the Old District to its former beauty!

lines.speaker: Lenore
lines.text: All right!

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: As for Aemeath... I think Dr. Luuk's proposal is viable.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: You mean using the Exoswarm-like "shell" that appeared in the cockpit to look for her?

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: Yes. The connection between frequencies will help. Rover, bring "her" with you when you activate the Exostrider.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Sure. While I'm there, the Black Shores will need to keep a closer eye on Lahai-Roi.

lines.speaker: Shorekeeper
lines.text: I understand.

Starlights from Yesterdays.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: The Black Shores will keep a team on standby here at the Institute. If you need our support, just say the word.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Thank you. We couldn't have built the data framework this quickly without your team's expertise.

lines.speaker: Valentina
lines.text: Lahai-Roi is a top priority. A joint call by the Shorekeeper and the Tethys System... Oh. Professor Mornye, your guest has arrived.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Ah... you're here.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Is that the way to the Stridergate?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Yes. This temporary passage will take you to the Dimmr Plains, deep within Bjartr Woods.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: If you need anything, you have but to reach out.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: With all that said, don't forget to share your experiences with us once you're back in Huanglong.

lines.speaker: Luuk Herssen
lines.text: Safe travels. Send us a WavesLine when you have the time.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Thank you, everyone. Well... Off I go, then.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Ah, yes. Lucilla mentioned a "special" arrangement for you. Do look forward to it.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: To bid you farewell.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Mentor, I...

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: ...No matter what difficulties lie ahead, Startorch Academy will always have your back. I... We will all be waiting for you here.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: So go. Don't worry about us.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: Huanglong... What a shame. Should the opportunity arise, I would like to visit.

lines.speaker: Hiyuki
lines.text: If you need anything, you have but to reach out.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Either way, ball's in your court, Rover. Our undercover auditor!

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: I'm sorry for the incidents today.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Please don't be. It was a rewarding day. Those young Synchonists left a great impression on me. Speaking of which, is Lenie gonna be alright?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: She's fine. Dr. Luuk is taking her to the infirmary. And at this hour, allow me to walk you to your room.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: No need for that. Dr. Luuk showed me the way earlier. Actually... you look like you're the one who could use a rest. Rover, why don't you walk the President back instead?

lines.speaker: Lucilla
lines.text: Alright, then. See you tomorrow morning.

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Oh! Uh, right. I'm Aalto. Haha... You guys really know how to roll out the red carpet.

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Nice to meet you, honored sir! I'm Sigrika, from the Preparatory Program. Thank you for coming to tour the Academy!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Hello, hello! And please, just Aalto is fine. No need for that "honored sir" stuff...

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Got it. I'm a Roya, you know! And I just want to say the Academy has been so wonderful to my people. We're all working together to make the world a better place!

lines.speaker: Sigrika
lines.text: Oh! And there are lots of Roya students in Rabelle College too! Everyone works so hard!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Uh? Huh...

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: If it's no trouble?

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Alright. In the last lecture, we proved that the Ruehl Equation holds true for Type-II Synth Armaments. Today, we'll move on to their Tuning Stability Constants.

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: Lixian, could you please write the final derivation from the last lecture on the board?

lines.speaker: Lixian
lines.text: Yes... Professor..

lines.speaker: Mornye
lines.text: While she gets started, let's do a quick review. Waleo, what is the standard medium used to measure Tuning Stability in a lab setting?

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: I should be the one saying that to you. Anyway, we need a plan for—

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Great, another grand plan. Why'd you gotta make everything so complicated?

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: What the—?! How's that—?!

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Helloooo, Mr. Aalto! This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance to invest in the Exostrider Project. I suggest the Black Shores chips in... this much!

lines.speaker: Aemeath
lines.text: Or, you can just patch me through to the Collective's board. I'd be happy to handle the negotiations myself!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: Is this... Aemeath? I can't believe she just hacked a Black Shores Terminal!

We Choose the Sky.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: You're telling me you've modified every bike here? That's insane.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: Well, Waleo's been in the expedition motorbike program since day one. These bikes here are basically his family!

lines.speaker: Waleo
lines.text: Soulmates.

lines.speaker: Lynae
lines.text: So, whaddya say, Auditor Aalto? How about you order ten as a starter pack!

lines.speaker: Aalto
lines.text: (Ten soulmates sold in a pack, huh...)

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Suisui!

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Well, well, look who it is... I knew something good was going to happen when I left the house today.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: I wanted her to come with me, but she said she's busy. She's been holed up in her study all morning. I know, I know... My little sister is all grown up now, with her own plans to keep.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Now you two have to try this Water Moon Bun! It's best fresh out of the oven, like right now.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Wow! Check these out! And all those there! Can we really eat all this?

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Of course! It's my treat today, so help yourselves.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Before coming to Jinzhou, I'll admit I was a little nervous. After so many years apart, I wasn't sure we'd still be the same people we remembered. I never imagined...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yangyang said the same thing to me.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Oh? Did she now...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You two are a lot alike, you know.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Are we? In some ways, perhaps. In others, not so much.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She's determined. She's never wavered or doubted her own choices.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Hehe. Looks like Dumpling has taken a liking to you.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You seem cheerful.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Oh this is nothing. If I really put my mind to it, I could make Xuanfang Hold every bit as lively as Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Although I do like the feel of this place. It's less flashy, maybe... but the people are kind. Genuine. Is Jinzhou like that too?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Next time there's a chance, Yangyang and I will give you a proper tour of Jinzhou.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Oh? And when exactly is this "next time?"

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: To think, that man sowed chaos on such a scale in Xuanfang, yet Mengzhou City Hall shows so little concern... Makes you wonder, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: I am. That's where I shine. You have bigger fish to fry. Like tracking down a certain Mengzhou Sentinel I once made a deal with.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: She never told me where She was, but I've always had the feeling She was close to Xuanfang Hold. And wouldn't you know...

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: The Elseway Shroud I entered before has appeared again.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Sentinel is our best chance at understanding what's happening in Xuanfang.

phone.speaker: Suisui
phone.text: Anytime you miss me, just take a peek. A little insight into my comings and goings, hm?

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: That was a unique situation. I needed to know where you were and if you were still alive. But now...

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: If I need to check on you, I'll reach out first. Using that to see where you are should be for emergencies only.

phone.speaker: Suisui
phone.text: All right, I was only teasing, darling. I know how you are. The locator has a range limit anyway, so it'll be useless once I'm in Mengzhou City.

phone.speaker: Suisui
phone.text: Speaking of which... I left in such a hurry that I forgot.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Forgot what?

A Chill Day Out.desc: After business done, Suisui apologizes for involving Rover with work, but Rover consoles her that there is still plenty of time left to continue their carefree day together.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: I still remember the time Father brought back a little jade bird for me. She clearly loved it, but all she said was, "If my sister likes it, then I'm happy too." She never once asked for one herself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Yep, that sounds like her.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Right? That's just how she is—always putting others first, never giving a second thought to herself.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: But I can't have that. I'm her big sister, and a big sister's duty is to make sure her little sis is well-fed and well-dressed.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So you gave her the jade bird?

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Nope. I took her to the market a few times, and we finally found one that looked just like it.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I do. And I understand the urgency of the matter. Now that Rover is here, I'll brief you both directly.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Recently, multiple people have gone missing across Jinzhou. All leads point to Xuanfang. Yangyang and Chixia were tasked to investigate Xuanfang Hold together. Chixia returned gravely wounded, and we've heard nothing from Yangyang.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: The moment I learned of this, I dispatched messengers via alternate routes to the Mengzhou City Hall, but they have yet to report back. I also tried sending elite Midnight Rangers to scout Xuanfang Hold once more, but their gates are sealed shut. No one knows what is happening in

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Xuanfang Hold... Of all places.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Magistrate, may I ask if this frequency is the same as the one you gave to Rover?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Mm... Yes, the spectral pattern matches exactly.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Then, about the Sentinel of Mengzhou... do you have anything more to share?

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: I am afraid I have little to offer. In recent years, Jué has shared very few updates regarding Hsin, and I can't confirm that what I do know is even true.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: However, if She summoned you to the Land of Xuanfang, then that soil must hold a deep significance for Her.

lines.speaker: Jinhsi
lines.text: Jué once mentioned that Hsin separated Her tail to create multiple Prisms of Fate. Each one contains a fragment of the Sentinel's power. If one is hidden in the Hold, it's no coincidence...

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Rover, I will meet you at Huaxu Academy shortly.

lines.speaker: Sanhua
lines.text: ...We're counting on you, Rover.

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: There was a girl. Yangyang. Said she was an Outrider for Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. Two days ago, during the civilian evacuation, she traveled with us.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's her. Do you know where she is now?

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: No. She volunteered to draw a large group of Autopuppets away so we could get the civilians into the Hold. We lost her after that.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: I sent a few scouts to search the Eastern Xuan Peaks area, but we failed to locate her trail.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I see. Another dead lead...

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: ...Do you have anything on you that's connected to her?

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: I was wondering, did you come here alone?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: No. I had a companion. We got separated before I ran into you.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Was it because of the Disorienting Fog? Aren't you worried about her?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I am... But we agreed we'd stick to our own goals unless things got really bad.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: She knows what she's doing. This fog won't stop her.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Is that so... Then we should pick up the pace too.

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: The Paragon's report to the Ministry of War mentioned a Nethermancer who has been a great help... That must've been him, right?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Xianling is a small village. The young ones grow up together. You cannot help but know each other.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Intendant, my apologies for the earlier offense... The Ministry of War's rules say you still need an escort to enter the Sanctum...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll go in with her.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: I have no objection.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: The Prism of Fate grants its bearer the authority to enter the Sanctum. Your presence there may be the variable that shifts everything.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And Qingxiao?

The Wind Before the Storm.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Once everyone is gathered, we move.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I met the village chief just now. He wishes for this sword to be kept with the Xuanfang Wardens.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: A sword? At a time like this? Retreat will be dangerous enough. I'd ask everyone only to protect themselves and those beside them, not cold steel.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Then I will carry it myself, for now.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: You... Fine. Do as you see fit.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I also never properly thanked you for saving me. And for giving me a room to rest.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: You two...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Liang-Liangyu—?! You're here too—

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: (I've been standing here for a while...)

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Are you okay, Yangyang?

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: They did. Thanks to you.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Watcher Liangyu, reporting for duty.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Liangyu? But your injuries...

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Do not worry. My injuries have mostly healed. I was only staying at the Ministry of War because the medics insisted on quiet rest.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Word is, those roaming Tacet Discords have begun to close in on the Hold. I will not let you face this alone.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: We will fight together. The new Xuan Triad... Well, duo, for now. I will not let Qingzhi and Duzhong down.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Yes. Shoulder to shoulder, once more.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, do you smell that? Something weird is nearby. Sniff, sniff... Huh?

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Uuugh... Rover, she's lookin' at me funny!

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: In all my travels across Huanglong, I've encountered many Tacet Discords and Echoes. Yet never one quite so curious.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Yessiree! So uh... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Big time what now? Anyway... hi there. Nice meeting ya, I'm Abby.

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Paragon Qingxiao?!

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Forgive me. I should have come sooner.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Censure Court... it's growing...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Muyu... he's probably hiding in that one.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: The assault grows fiercer by the moment. My sword formations will not hold long. We must end this quickly.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: If you can find the one pulling the strings... go. Strike the root of this evil.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Paragon Qingxiao, my apologies for disturbing your cultivation. But there's been an emergency... It requires your attention.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It's no trouble. What's happened?

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Someone tried to break into the Sanctum. We've detained her, but she claims to hold the Sentinel's token. Except... it's not in any of our records. No way to verify it.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Token...

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Did she say where she came from?

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.

As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The Censure Court... it's growing...

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Muyu... he's probably hiding in that one.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: If you can find the one pulling the strings... go. Strike the root of this evil.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: What troubles you?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The figure in that old portrait... is that you and a Xuanling Bird?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Yes. It never could settle. Always pecking at my hair.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: (If I remember right, Xuanling Birds have been extinct since the Fortress and Gorges War two centuries ago...)

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: No need for formality. A Cultivator seeks to live long and see true. Age holds little meaning to me now.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: Rover, I write to you thus: The skies are clear today, the breeze is gentle, and the weather is most pleasant. Since our hurried parting the other day, I have been occupied handling the Tacet Discords. If you have the time, would you care to visit the training hall? There is some

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: You don't have to write WavesLine messages like letters. You can just talk normally.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: Understood. I only recently learned how to use WavesLine on the Terminal, so I'm still familiarizing myself with the proper etiquette.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: It's okay. Now that you've added me, we can chat whenever. You'll get the hang of it.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: Thank you.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: My training hall is at the summit of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Are you available?

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: If the way of music speaks to you, I hope you will play it often.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Thank you. I will not decline such a gift.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Even if you did, I would still insist that you take it.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Should you ever have questions about the qin, you may come to me. I will teach you.}}

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: No... Hsin.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: But let's return to the matter at hand.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: ...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: New training hall?

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: Yes, only just raised, with room enough for the disciples to practice the sword.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: A whole new training hall already? That's my Master.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Count me in for a visit, then. I'm available right now.

phone.speaker: Qingxiao
phone.text: Wonderful.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Master, this manual... you left it at Yuan's Flavors. I came to return it.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: ...I was planning to retrieve it myself. I did not expect it to fall into your hands.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: The techniques in it remind me of my own. What is its connection to you?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It's a long story... Long ago, a village girl found this manual while tending livestock. She treasured it above all.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: In her spare time, she practiced with a branch in place of a sword. She had no teacher, just the pages. But over time, she grew skilled.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: That fortuitous training saved her when Tacet Discords destroyed her home.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: ...Very well. There is no need to worry about me. The flowers are in full bloom right now. You should stay a while and enjoy the view.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This melody you're playing... It sounds like you're in a good mood.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Perhaps. As I looked out over the Land of Xuanfang this morning, I happened to see clouds and mist ascending in the distance. A truly auspicious sign.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It seems our journey to the Sanctum has finally resolved much of the karma left behind since the Fortress and Gorges War.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: How do you feel now?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: ...Very well. There is no need to worry about me. The flowers are in full bloom right now. You should stay a while and enjoy the view.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: This melody you're playing... It sounds like you're in a good mood.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: Perhaps. As I looked out over the Land of Xuanfang this morning, I happened to see clouds and mist ascending in the distance. A truly auspicious sign.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It seems our journey to the Sanctum has finally resolved much of the karma left behind since the Fortress and Gorges War.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: How do you feel now?

Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Could it be... that the Atelier has held a grudge against the Sentinel and Xuanfang Hold after being turned down?

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: To wait two hundred years for revenge? That Muyu is certainly patient, if nothing else.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: No... While I can't say for sure, I believe his motives run deeper than a simple grudge.

lines.speaker: Yangyang
lines.text: Manipulating the Autopuppets to cause chaos may only be one step in his plan. So far, only one place in Xuanfang remains untouched by rogue Autopuppets and Tacet Discords...

lines.speaker: Qiuhong
lines.text: ...The Hold itself.

lines.speaker: Suisui
lines.text: Given the sheer value this Hold represents to this land, it's only natural that he would set his sights on it.

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's your only condition?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Yeah, well... if we trip over any Sanctum relics or Hsin's secret stash of treasure, maybe toss one my way? Hah. Kidding.

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: The old coot made me promise that when he kicks it, no grave, no marker, no nothing. Tch, live clean, die clean. He locked himself away in some Mirage Realm, lamp and all.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Jingran, I think it's time... to give you this back.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Nah, keep it. Call it a souvenir. Thing ain't worth much, and the Resonance Energy stuck to it just burnt out anyway.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: I mean, I could charge it up for ya. Maybe... three months. Tops.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Knock off throwing your life away, would you?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Ain't many things in this world I give a crap about. But I gotta say, lately... I've finally met someone interesting.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Jadie?

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Hold on, who's that?

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: (Didn't she say it would react if Hsin the Moon Fox wanted to do something against you?)

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Arbiter?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'm fine. Just a bit dizzy from the emotional whiplash. Let's keep moving.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Mm... this Labyrinth reaches into one's very soul. You have lingered in my Heartscapes for too long; some discomfort is natural.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?

Song of the Heart Sword.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: I believed he sought to extract the mainframe's core data. But to break my restrictions, he weaponized the Reverberations to collapse the mainframe itself.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hold on. Back in the Sanctum, the Prism of Fate flickered. Was that you? Did you guide us into the Xuanyuan Domain?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Only by stopping Muyu's chaos from within, together with my power, could we minimize the harm that spilled beyond.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: One more thing. Is the Hold's control mainframe actually Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule? Muyu certainly believed it was.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Not entirely. It is merely one small part of it...

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: This situation exceeded even my calculations. Fortunately, you two were there. You saved Xuanfang from far greater loss.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Forgive me for forcing those memories upon you. I couldn't bring myself to tell you the truth before.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: What's happening in Mengzhou?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Safe, for now. As long as I am still here and the Capsule holds, they won't dare make a move.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If you are a fractal form of Hsin the Moon Fox, then what of the real Sentinel...?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: It will return once the Civilization Capsule is fully repaired.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why didn't you ask the other cities for help?

Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: I felt a change within the Nexus. It seems the seal on the last vestige of emotion has been lifted.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I was entrusted to deliver it to you.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: The Feeling Capsule...

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Hi, Hsin!

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: We finally get to meet! All that searching for a gap in the Capsule to sneak this recording in was worth it.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.

Past Dreams, Traced Seals.desc: Entrusted by Hsin, Suoming invites you to revisit the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. Although you still have many questions about Hsin's intentions, you embark on the journey once more...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hsin. Suoming and I are at the Simulacrum Nexus.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: I suppose you have seen those phantoms by now, Arbiter?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I understand if you want to keep this from Suoming, but at least tell me what you're planning.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: To put it simply, I'd like her to meet the Ten Seals again... but truth be told, I am unsure if this is the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Perhaps this is nothing more than forcing her to experience the pains of her past. Or perhaps she has simply kept all that longing locked away inside her heart.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So that's why you asked me to accompany her, just in case?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Arbiter! Where the Fox chases the Moon, all partings fade away!

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: That's the Moon Fox Society's code, isn't it? The next line goes: Where the Fox turns the wheel, fortune follows!

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: Just so. Seems the Arbiter is a member of the Moon Fox Society too.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Hm? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: Hsin
lines.text: The Arbiter doesn't know? No initiations into the Moon Fox Society for you then, hehe.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: If memory serves, they're very fond of you. Fanatical, almost. Wait, did you actually go to meet them?

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: ...Why didn't you stop me? Coulda squeezed him for more info, if you'd wanted.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Matters of revenge, only the wronged can decide.

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Besides... his corpse is not without use.

lines.speaker: Jingran
lines.text: Here. You lot'll put it to better use than me.

The Nethermancer's Requiem.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: Ah... Lady Suoming. What brings you to Xuanfang?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: So, you are the Jinzhou Patroller seconded to Mengzhou?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Don't misunderstand. I'm not here for the Atelier's affairs.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs governs the Sentinel's business. You being here... Could it be—

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: You already know all you need to know. Take care.

lines.speaker: Yinlin
lines.text: See you around, Rover... If we're lucky.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Paragon Qingxiao. You know Hsin the Moon Fox well. You understand what this token signifies.

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: That's... a Vermillion Lock...

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: It is a covenant. A deal between Hsin the Moon Fox and me. The time has come for Her to honor it. But as things stand, She may not even be able to save Herself.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: We don't have much time.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: Paragon, what does all this mean...?

lines.speaker: Qingxiao
lines.text: It is Hsin's frequency within that lock. She speaks the truth.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: And that's precisely why the Fox Shadow's behavior is so strange.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: ...You suspect it's not acting on Hsin's will?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Indeed. If that great shadow is the anomaly itself, then what has become of Hsin, who ought to be in control of this place?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: And this is...?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: A Providence Lock. Should Hsin the Moon Fox seek to do anything against you, it will react.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Why are you giving me this?

Past Dreams, Traced Seals.desc: Entrusted by Hsin, Suoming invites you to revisit the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. Although you still have many questions about Hsin's intentions, you embark on the journey once more...

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Arbiter, was that Hsin the Moon Fox just now?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Uh-huh. She was the one who projected the phantoms of the Ten Seals here, and got worried it might be too much for you...

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: So she asked me to keep you company.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: I see... Have you finished taking the photo? Shall we move on, then?

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: You can spend time with them a little longer if you want. We're in no rush.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: No need to worry about me. Understanding what was on Her mind is more than enough.

phone.speaker: Suoming
phone.text: Hsin the Moon Fox asks that we reach the Simulacrum Nexus and complete... a certain task. I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: Understood, Seal Master! Where should we meet?

phone.speaker: Suoming
phone.text: That title... I'm afraid I hardly deserve to be called that by you, Arbiter.

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: No problem. Where should we meet?

phone.speaker: Suoming
phone.text: Let us meet before the Manifold Sanctum. That way, we can head straight into the Simulacrum Nexus after our discussion.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Arbiter.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Talking to them?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Mm. I was telling them how Suhsin made a Ninth of its own.

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Looking back, if it hadn't been so impatient, if it hadn't put words about letting go in Ninth's mouth, perhaps—

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I don't think it would've swayed you. If anything, using the Ten Seals Covenant against you would have done the opposite, wouldn't it?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Hehe. You hold me to quite a standard, Arbiter. But it's true. They're sealed in my Locks. I would not be deceived.

Simulacrum of the Heart.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

lines.speaker: Liangyu
lines.text: You know this is the Sentinel's Sanctum. How dare you trespass?

lines.speaker: Suoming
lines.text: Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.text: Make yourself comfortable in the lounge for now. Once I've finished with the souls at this stop, I'll get you checked into your compartment.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: I'll come with you.

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.text: Oh? No, really, you don't have to. You're a passenger. You should be enjoying the ride.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: But I'm not dead. There's still a lot about this train I don't understand. I think it's better if I stay close to you.

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.text: ...You make a fair point. I haven't the faintest idea what might happen to a living person left alone on this train.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: All the more reason for us to look out for each other. You're the only one here I can actually talk to.

A Bouquet for Tomorrow.desc: A stranger from a distant land has been searching for a Bloom Bearer of the Black Shores in Xuanfang Hold. From him, you learn that an alteration has occurred within the Somnoire, one which may be connected to the New Federation. You decide to investigate and uncover the truth...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: That's right! Bet you know what Echoes are, right, Lily? Well, I'm one-of-a-kind among 'em!

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.text: So you've been inside Rover this whole time... Abby. That's a cute name.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: C-Cute?! Rover, you hearing this? Who goes around calling this majestic force of nature that...

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: My gut tells me your trust isn't misplaced.

lines.speaker: Lily
lines.text: Well... let's save the rest of your and Abby's story for dinner. We've still got plenty of time ahead of us.

Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: And the reason the Capsule is incomplete is precisely because these emotions are all tangled up.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Understanding these emotions is the key to restoring the Feeling Capsule.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: ...Hehe.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: In this story, I'm about to become the ruler of Xuanfang Hold and lead everyone in launching those magnificent Cloud Shuttles into the sky.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: You wouldn't want to miss out on such an interesting ending, would you?

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Well, then, since we're in a story, I think the appropriate line should go something like—

phone.speaker: Rover
phone.text: I found both of the Feeling Capsule's pieces.

phone.speaker: Xuanqing
phone.text: Goodness, you work fast!

phone.speaker: Xuanqing
phone.text: I'll handle putting them back together. You know where to find me!}}

Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Tuntun... Thank you.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Hey, didn't you say you just wanted that Capsule piece back? So why did it disappear like that...?

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: It... violated the Nexus's directive it was created with. So the Nexus erased it.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: Because it wanted to keep this for itself.

lines.speaker: Xuanqing
lines.text: And just like that, the Feeling Capsule and I are whole again.

lines.speaker: Abby
lines.text: Aha! I knew it! I knew you smelled too much like that fox to be a coincidence!

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: How do you see it, Rover?

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Mm. Sounds like the way to go.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
lines.text: Er? M-me? I, um... I think it does make some sense.

lines.speaker: Rover
lines.text: Looks like I can only play creative now.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: That's right. There are so many more paths to be explored, Rover. Try to observe them carefully.

lines.speaker: Xiangli Yao
lines.text: And if you find yourself in need, just let us know. Mm-hmm!

lines.speaker: Qiuyuan
lines.text: Mm. Sounds like the way to go.

lines.speaker: Zhezhi
